Wird Yawm al-Aḥad Sunday J U M P T O P R AY E R 1–10 11–20 21–30 31–40 61–70 71–76 41–50 51–60 O P E N I N G · R E C I T E D E A C H D AY al-ḥamdu li-llāhi wa-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʻalā sayyidinā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadin rasūli Allāhi wa-ʻalā ālihi fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi All praise is for Allah, and blessings and peace be upon our master and patron Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, and upon his family, in every glance and every breath, by the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses, wa-raḍiya Allāhu ʻan shaykhaynā sayyidī Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi and may Allah be pleased with our two shaykhs: my master Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, wa-sayyidī ʻabdi l-ghaniyyi Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi wa-arḍāhumā 4

and my master ʻAbd al-Ghanī Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, and may He make them well pleased, wa-jaʻala l-jannata mutaqallabahumā wa-mathwāhumā and make Paradise their resort and their abode. wa-nfaʻnā Allāhumma bi-jāhihimā ʻindaka yā Allāhu And benefit us, O Allah, through their standing with You, O Allah. Allāhumma innī uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday kulli nafasin walamḥatin wa-ṭarfatin yaṭrifu bihā ahlu s-samāwāti wa-ahlu l-arḍi wakulli shayʼin huwa fī ʻilmika kāʼinun aw qad kāna uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday dhālika kullihi O Allah, I offer to You, in the presence of every breath, every glance and every blink with which the people of the heavens and the people of the earth blink, and of everything that is in Your knowledge, whether it is yet to be or has already come to be — I offer to You, in the presence of all of that, [the prayers that follow]. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā janna laylu d-dayājī O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as the night of deep darkness draws its veil, 5

wa-aqbalati l-bawākhiru bi-l-ḥujjāji · wa-sabbaḥū li-llāhi fī l-mafāwizi wa-lfijāji and the ships sail in bearing the pilgrims, and they glorify Allah across the wastelands and the mountain passes. Allāhumma yā man malaʼa sirruhu l-qulūba wa-khayruhu n-nawāḥiya O Allah, O You whose secret has filled the hearts and whose goodness has filled every region, ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-ʻāqibi l-māḥī send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Last of the Prophets (al-ʻĀqib), the Effacer of disbelief (al-Māḥī), wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ḥuffanā bi-l-khayri wa-l-falāḥi and upon his family, and grant peace; and surround us with goodness and success. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā tarannama ḥādin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as a camel-driver sings his chant, wa-ṭāfa ʻākifun wa-bādin · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim abada l-ābādi and resident and visitor circle the Sacred House, and upon his family, and grant peace, forever and ever. 6

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin saʻdi s-suʻūdi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the felicity of felicities, wa-imāmi l-wufūdi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā nuffidha sh-sharʻu wauqīmati l-ḥudūdu and the leader of the delegations, and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as the Sacred Law is carried out and the prescribed limits are upheld. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi sh-shāhidi fī yawmi l-mashāhidi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet, the witness on the Day of Witnessing, wa-ʻalā ālihi bi-ʻadadi kulli rākiʻin wa-sājidin and upon his family, by the number of every one who bows and prostrates. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tajʻalunā nuḥibbuhu kathīran wa-nashkuruka kathīran wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim taslīman kathīran 7

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that makes us love him abundantly and thank You abundantly; and upon his family, and grant abundant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-ḥilmi wa-ṣ-ṣabri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of forbearance and patience, wa-l-iḥsāni wa-l-ajri · wa-l-barri wa-l-khayri · wa-n-nahyi wa-l-amri · wa-lfutūḥi wa-n-naṣri and of beneficence and reward, and of righteousness and goodness, and of prohibition and command, and of conquests and victory. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʻalā rayḥānatayhi mina ddunyā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and upon his two fragrant flowers of this world, ṣalātan nafūzu bihā fī l-mamāti wa-l-maḥyā with a blessing through which we triumph in death and in life, wa-nanālu bihā khayra d-dīni wa-d-dunyā · wa-sallim taslīman kathīran and through which we attain the good of religion and of this world, and grant abundant peace. 8

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khātami l-anbiyāʼi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets, wa-khayrati l-aṣfiyāʼi · wa-akrami l-kuramāʼi · wa-khayri man aqallathu lghabrāʼu and the choicest of the pure ones, and the most generous of the generous, and the best of those whom the dusty earth has borne, wa-aẓallathu s-samāʼu · alladhī taʻaṭṭarat bihi l-arjāʼu and whom the sky has overshadowed, through whom all the regions were perfumed, wa-njalat bihi l-ḥawbāʼu · wa-mtaddat minhu l-ʻulamāʼu wa-ṣ-ṣulaḥāʼu and through whom distress was dispelled, and from whom the scholars and the righteous drew their sustenance. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan man ṣallā ʻalayhi bihā najā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which whoever sends blessings upon him is saved, 9

wa-yastanīru bihā l-ḥijā · yakūnu nūruhā li-ṣudūrinā shifāʼan and by which the intellect is illumined, its light being a healing for our breasts, wa-lishayṭāninā wijāʼan wa-liʼasqāminā dawāʼan · wa-liqulūbinā jalāʼan and a restraint upon our devil and a remedy for our ailments, and a burnishing for our hearts. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ṣabara ʻalā adhā jufāti l-aʻrābi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, who bore patiently the harm of the coarse Bedouins, wa-kāna yadʻū lahum bi-l-hudā wa-ṣ-ṣawābi and used to pray for them to be given guidance and what is right, ḥattā rafaʻa rāyata l-ḥaqqi wa-jaʻala l-bāṭila fī tabābin until he raised the banner of truth and cast falsehood into ruin. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan taghfiru bihā dhanbī O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which You forgive my sin, 10

wa-tasturu bihā ʻaybī wa-tuṣliḥu bihā qalbī and by which You conceal my fault and set my heart right; innaka anta Allāhu rabbī · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan tuʻīdhunī bihā min sharri kulli sharrin wa-salbin truly, You are Allah, my Lord; and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing by which You protect me from the evil of every evil and every act of plunder. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan taftaḥu li-l-khayri abwāban O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that opens doors to goodness, wa-tamlaʼu ṣ-ṣuḥufa thawāban · wa-taruddu ʻan qāʼilihā sharran waʻadhāban and fills the scrolls with reward, and turns away evil and punishment from whoever says it, wa-yulhamu bihā fī l-qabri jawāban wa-ṣawāban and by which one is inspired in the grave with an answer and with what is right, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā sāqa r-rīḥu bi-amri Allāhi saḥāban 11

and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as the wind, by the command of Allah, drives clouds along. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ṣallayta ʻalayhi biṣalātin fāqat jamīʻa ṣ-ṣalawāti O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, upon whom You have sent blessings with a blessing that surpassed all blessings, wa-anzalta ʻalayhi l-āyāti l-bayyināti · wa-ayyadtahu bi-l-muʻjizāti l-bāhirāti and You sent down to him the clear verses, and supported him with the dazzling miracles, wa-ʻarajta bihi ilā fawqi sabʻi samāwāti and made him ascend to above the seven heavens, wa-faraḍta ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ummatihi khamsa ṣalawātin and made five prayers obligatory upon him and upon his community. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sayyidi s-sādāti O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the master of masters, wa-manbaʻi l-barakāti · wa-maʻdani l-kalimāti ṭ-ṭayyibāti 12

and the wellspring of graces, and the mine of goodly words, wa-sirāji l-ḥawālika wa-ẓ-ẓulumāti · wa-jalāʼi l-kurūbi l-mudlahimmāti and the lamp of the pitch-black nights and the darknesses, and the dispeller of the dense, dark afflictions, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-aṣliḥ lanā l-aḥwāla wa-ṣ-ṣifāti and upon his family, and grant peace; and set right for us our states and attributes. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan ashhaduhu bihā shuhūdan khārijan ʻani l-maʻqūlāti wa-l-ʻādāti O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which I behold him with a vision that transcends the rational and the customary, fī jamīʻi l-awqāti wa-l-ḥālāti · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-jʻalnā min ahli shshuhūdi wa-t-tajalliyāti at all times and in every state, and upon his family, and grant peace; and make us among the people of inner vision and divine self-disclosures. 13

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin Kaʻbati l-qāṣidīna li-l-faraji O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Kaʻba of those who seek relief, wa-tarwīḥi n-nafsi wa-l-araji · idh huwa awjahu shafīʻin usriya bihi wa-ʻaraja and the refreshment of the soul and the sweet fragrance, for he is the most eminent intercessor, who was taken by night and ascended; fa-bihi Allāhumma farrij ʻannī farajan sarīʻan naṣilu bihi ilā ḥaqqin bi-lā ʻiwajin · wa-ʻuluwwin ilā aʻlā d-daraji so through him, O Allah, grant me swift relief, by which we reach a truth without crookedness, and an ascent to the highest of the ranks. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan miskuhā ʻalā r-rūḥi yafūḥu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing whose musk wafts over the spirit, 14

wa-l-muṣallī bihā shawqan ilayhi yabkī wa-yanūḥu ilā an yatawajjaha ilayhi wa-yarūḥu and whoever sends blessings with it weeps and laments in longing for him, until he turns toward him and sets out, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ʻalā sayyidinā Ādama wa-sayyidinā Nūḥin and upon his family, and grant peace; and upon our master Adam and our master Noah. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī nazala l-ghaythu biduʻāʼihi fa-ufʻima l-wādī O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, at whose supplication the rain came down and the valley was filled to the brim, wa-ʻammati l-barakatu kulla ʻākifin wa-bādī and grace spread over every resident and visitor, wa-labisa l-kawnu ʻinda mawtihi thawba l-ḥidādi and at whose death the universe put on the garment of mourning. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā rajaʻa li-llāhi shāridu 15

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as one who has strayed returns to Allah, wa-rudda li-khayri s-subuli wa-l-mawāridi · bi-faḍli Allāhi taʻālā lladhī yastaḥiqqu jamīʻa l-maḥāmidi and is brought back to the best of paths and watering-places, by the bounty of Allah, the Exalted, who deserves all praises, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-qadri faḍli Allāhi taʻālā ʻalā kulli rākiʻin wa-sājidin and upon his family, and grant peace, in the measure of the bounty of Allah, the Exalted, upon every one who bows and prostrates. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yaqrubu bihā l-baʻīdu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which the distant one draws near, wa-yashulu bihā sh-shadīdu · wa-yalīnu bihā kulla qalbin qāsin kamā alanta li-Dāwuda l-ḥadīda and through which what is hard becomes easy, and through which every hard heart is softened, just as You softened iron for David, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā yubdiʼu Allāhu wa-mā yuʻīdu 16

and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of what Allah originates and what He brings back. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi r-raḥmati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of mercy, ṣalātan tunawwiru bihā baṣarī wa-baṣīratī with a blessing by which You illuminate my sight and my insight, wa-tuṣliḥu bihā ẓāhirī wa-sarīratī · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim innaka ʻalā kulli shayʼin qadīrun and by which You set right my outward and my inward being, and upon his family, and grant peace. Truly, You have power over all things. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan mā khaṭarat ʻalā khāṭirin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that has never crossed any mind, tajmaʻu ṣalāta kulli bādin wa-ḥāḍirin gathering together the blessings of every nomad and every towndweller, 17

wa-tuḥīṭu bi-ṣalawāti l-awāʼili wa-l-awākhiri · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ilā yawmi tublā s-sarāʼiru and encompassing the blessings of the first and the last, and upon his family, and grant peace, until the Day when secrets are put to the test. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tajmaʻu faḍla jamīʻi ṣṣalawāti O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that gathers the merit of all blessings, bi-qadri faḍli Allāhi ʻalā l-wāqifīna bi-ʻArafātin ṣalātan taḥfaẓunī bihā fī lḥayāti wa-baʻda l-mamāti in the measure of Allah’s bounty upon those who stand at Arafat, a blessing by which You protect me in life and after death, ṣalātan uḥāṭu bihā min faḍlika bi-r-raḥamāti wa-l-barakāti a blessing by which I am encompassed, out of Your bounty, with mercies and graces, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi ṣ-ṣāliḥāti wa-l-ḥasanāti and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of righteous deeds and good deeds. 18

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī futiḥat bihi aqfālu lqulūbi fa-nfataḥat wa-samiʻat ḥikama rabbihā fa-anābat wa-khashaʻat O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, through whom the locks of the hearts were opened, and so they opened, and heard the wisdom of their Lord, and so turned to Him in repentance and became humble, wa-ʻalā saḥāʼibi r-riḍwāni nhallat wa-sakabat and upon the clouds of good pleasure they poured down and streamed forth, wa-anābat li-rabbihā l-arwāḥu fa-tābat wa-rajaʻat and the spirits turned to their Lord, and so repented and returned, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā stanārati l-qulūbu bi-āyāti l-Qurʼāni idhā tuliyat and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as hearts are illumined by the verses of the Qur’an whenever they are recited. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ajlā l-yahūda wa-l-aʻādī 19

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who expelled the Jews and the enemies, wa-dammara kulla ẓālimin wa-ʻādī · wa-ashhara l-islāma fī l-qurā wa-l-bilādi and destroyed every oppressor and aggressor, and made Islam known in the towns and the lands, wa-hadā n-nāsa ilā l-ḥaqqi wa-s-sadādi and guided people to truth and rectitude, nabiyyi n-najdati wa-l-jihādi · wa-s-suyūfi l-ḥidādi · wa-n-nujubi l-jiyādi the Prophet of valour and striving, and of the keen-edged swords, and of the noble and excellent steeds. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin saʻdi s-suʻūdi wa-raḥmati lwadūdi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the felicity of felicities and the mercy of the Most Loving, wa-nabiyyi sh-shuhūdi · wa-wafiyyi l-wuʻūdi · wa-muqīmi l-ḥudūdi and the Prophet of witnessing, and the one faithful to promises, and the upholder of the prescribed limits, 20

wa-sharīfi l-judūdi · alladhī jāʼa bi-r-rukūʻi wa-s-sujūdi and the one of noble ancestors, who came with bowing and prostration, wa-qātala ahla sh-shirki wa-l-juḥūdi · alladhī kāna yakhruju li-muqābalati lwufūdi · li-akhdhi l-mīthāqi wa-l-ʻuhūdi and fought the people of polytheism and denial, who used to go out to meet the delegations, to take the covenant and the pledges. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣāḥibi r-rūḥi l-ʻāliyati lmarḍiyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the possessor of the lofty, well-pleasing spirit, wa-n-nafsi ṭ-ṭāhirati z-zākiyati wa-z-zakiyyati · wa-sh-sharīʻati l-muyassarati l-ḥanīfiyyati dhī l-maqāmi l-maḥmūdi l-amjadi and of the pure, virtuous and innocent soul, and of the upright Law made easy; the possessor of the praised station, the most glorious, wa-ṣ-ṣirāṭi l-mustaqīmi l-mumahhadi · wa-th-thanāʼi l-jamīli l-muraddadi and of the straight path made smooth, and of the beautiful praise ever repeated, 21

wa-naṣri l-ḥaqqi wa-l-liwāʼi wa-s-suʼdadi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli muslimin muwaḥḥidin and of the triumph of truth, and of the banner and supreme eminence, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every Muslim who affirms Allah’s oneness. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika wa-ḥabībika wa-raḥmatika li-l-ʻālamīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, Your Beloved and Your mercy to the worlds, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi and upon his family, and grant peace, in every glance and breath, the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses, ṣalātan anālu bihā maghfirataka wa-raḥmataka wa-riḍwānaka wa-ḥusna lkhitāmi with a blessing through which I obtain Your forgiveness, Your mercy, Your good pleasure and a good ending, 22

wa-rḍa Allāhumma ʻan aṣḥābihi · wa-rḥam ummatahu fī l-ʻālamīna innaka ḥamīdun majīdun and be pleased, O Allah, with his Companions, and have mercy upon his community throughout the worlds. Truly, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, ḥabībi Allāhi wa-raḥmati Allāhi the Beloved of Allah and the mercy of Allah, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi ṣalātan anālu bihā maghfirata Allāhi wa-raḥmata Allāhi wa-riḍwāna Allāhi wa-ḥusna l-khitāmi and upon his family, and grant peace, in every glance and breath, the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses, with a blessing through which I obtain the forgiveness of Allah, the mercy of Allah, the good pleasure of Allah and a good ending, 23

wa-rḍa Allāhumma ʻan aṣḥābihi wa-rḥam ummatahu fī l-ʻālamīna innaka ḥamīdun majīdun and be pleased, O Allah, with his Companions, and have mercy upon his community throughout the worlds. Truly, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi tanshariḥu ṣ-ṣudūru O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, through sending blessings upon whom the breasts are opened wide, wa-yuṭradu sh-shayṭānu ʻannā wa-yaghūru · wa-yujlabu l-faraḥu bi-llāhi was-surūru and Satan is driven away from us and vanishes, and joy in Allah and gladness are brought in, wa-tandafiʻu ʻannā l-maṣāʼibu wa-sh-shurūru · wa-yaʻẓumu bihā th-thawābu wa-l-ujūru and calamities and evils are warded off from us, and through it rewards and recompenses grow great, 24

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ahli l-faḍli wa-l-burūri and upon his family, and grant peace, the people of virtue and righteousness. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalāta l-ʻizzi d-dāʼimi wa-lfaraji l-qarībi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing of enduring might and imminent relief, nabiyyuka l-muqarrabu ilayka wa-raḥmatuka l-ḥabību Your Prophet, brought near to You, and Your mercy, the Beloved, wa-sirāju qulūbi l-muʼminīna wa-wasīlatuhum ilayka yā mujību and the lamp of the hearts of the believers and their means of approach to You, O Responsive One, ṣalātan man ṣallā bihā ʻalayhi lā yukhdhalu wa-lā yakhību with a blessing by which whoever sends blessings upon him is neither forsaken nor disappointed, wa-ʻajjil lanā Allāhumma fī qaḍāʼi ḥawāʼijinā bi-amrika l-ʻajībi and hasten for us, O Allah, the fulfilment of our needs by Your wondrous command, 25

wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi bi-ʻadadi thawābi kulli ʻabdin munībin and grant peace to him and to his family, by the number of the reward of every servant who turns to You in repentance. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin bi-ʻadadi n-nakhīli l-bāsiqāti O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, by the number of the towering date palms, wa-l-ḥabbi wa-n-nabāti · wa-l-anhuri l-jāriyāti · wa-l-amwāji l-mutalāṭimāti and the grains and the plants, and the flowing rivers, and the waves that crash upon one another, wa-l-aʻyuni n-nāẓirāti · wa-s-sufuni l-jāriyāti · wa-l-kalimāti ṭ-ṭayyibāti and the gazing eyes, and the sailing ships, and the goodly words, wa-l-anfāsi wa-l-laḥaẓāti · wa-biʻadadi l-māḍiyāti mina l-ḥarakāti wa-lātiyāti · wa-ʻadadi sukkāni s-saʻīri wa-l-jannāti and the breaths and the moments, and by the number of movements, those that have passed and those yet to come, and the number of the dwellers in the Blaze and in the Gardens. 26

Allāhumma yā nūru yā raḥmānu yā raḥīmu O Allah, O Light, O Most Merciful, O Ever-Merciful, ṣalli ʻalā nūrika s-sārī fī maʻānī asrāri l-kalimāti send blessings upon Your light, which pervades the meanings of the secrets of the words, wa-raḥmatika l-ʻāmmati li-jamīʻi l-makhlūqāti · wa-nabiyyika lladhī tasharrafat bi-mawlidihi l-araḍūna wa-bimiʻrājihi s-samāwātu and upon Your mercy, which embraces all created beings, and upon Your Prophet, through whose birth the earths were ennobled and through whose ascension the heavens were ennobled, wa-adim dhālika ʻalayhi bi-qadri anwāri t-tajalliyāti and perpetuate that upon him, in the measure of the lights of the divine self-disclosures, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · wa-ṣubba ʻalaynā bi-jāhihi l-khayra wa-l-barakāti and upon his family, and grant peace; and pour upon us, by his exalted standing with You, goodness and graces. 27

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi tuktabu l-ḥasanātu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, through sending blessings upon whom good deeds are written down, wa-tughfaru s-sayyiʼātu · wa-yasʻadu lladhī yuṣallī ʻalayhi fī l-ḥayāti wa-lmamāti and misdeeds are forgiven, and whoever sends blessings upon him is fortunate in life and in death, wa-tatanazzala ʻalayhi mina Allāhi r-raḥamātu wa-l-barakātu and mercies and graces descend upon him from Allah, wa-yanjū min sāʼiri l-aswāʼi wa-l-mukaddirāti and he is delivered from all harms and vexations, wa-yuḥfaẓu bi-ḥifẓi Allāhi fī jamīʻi l-ḥālāti and he is guarded by the protection of Allah in every circumstance, wa-yuḥfaẓu bi-s-salāmati mina Allāhi bi-n-najāti and he is preserved with the safety that comes from Allah, through deliverance, 28

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā maḍā wa-mā huwa ātin and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all that has passed and all that is yet to come. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā r-rūḥi l-akbari l-muḥīṭi l-jāmiʻi li-l-asrāri ẓ-ẓāhirati wal-khafiyyati O Allah, send blessings upon the Greatest Spirit, the AllEncompassing, who gathers together the outward and the hidden secrets, al-fātiḥi li-kunūzi l-maʻārifi r-rabāniyyati · al-mughtarifi min biḥāri l-maʻānī ṣ-ṣamadāniyyati the opener of the treasures of divine gnosis, who draws from the oceans of the meanings of the Eternal Refuge, al-muqtabisi li-qābisin mina l-anwāri l-ilāhiyyati who takes a burning brand from the divine lights for the one who seeks a flame, sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-ḥabībi l-awwali li-l-ḥaḍrati l-ʻaliyyati our master Muhammad, the First Beloved of the Exalted Presence, wa-r-raḥmati l-ʻuẓmā l-mursalati li-l-ʻawālimi l-ʻuluwiyyati wa-s-sufliyyati and the greatest mercy, sent to the upper and lower worlds, 29

bābi Allāhi l-maftūḥi li-kulli qādimin the door of Allah, open to everyone who comes, wa-faraji Allāhi l-mamnūḥi li-kulli dhī farajin and the relief of Allah, granted to all who are in need of relief. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin bni ʻabdi Allāhi ʻabdika wanabiyyika wa-rasūlika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, son of Abdullah, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-aṣḥābihi lladhīna jāhadū fī sabīlika ḥaqqa l-jihādi fa-raḍīta ʻanhum wa-raḍū ʻanka and upon his family and Companions, who strove in Your way with true striving, so that You were pleased with them and they were pleased with You, wa-anzalta th-thanāʼa ʻalayhim fī muḥkami l-kitābi “tarāhum rukkaʻan sujjadan yabtaghūna faḍlan mina Allāhi wa-riḍwānan sīmāhum fī wujūhihim min athari s-sujūdi” 30

and You sent down praise of them in the firmly established Book: “You see them bowing and prostrating, seeking bounty from Allah and good pleasure. Their mark is on their faces, from the trace of prostration” (Qur’an 48:29). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-manṣūri lmuʼayyadi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet who is granted victory and strengthened with support, mani smuhu Muḥammadun wa-maḥmūdun wa-Aḥmadu whose name is Muhammad, Mahmud and Ahmad, ṣalātan fī kulli ḥīnin tazīdu wa-tatajaddadu with a blessing that increases and is renewed at every moment, ṣalātan bihā mina t-taqwā atazawwadu with a blessing through which I take my provision of piety, wa-laka yā rabbi bi-ʻibādatika atawaddadu and to You, O my Lord, I seek to endear myself through worshipping You, fa-bi-waddika yā wadūdu asʻadu · wa-binūrika li-l-khayri arshadu so by Your love, O Most Loving, I find happiness, and by Your light I am guided aright toward goodness, 31

wa-biṭāʻatika fī l-khuldi ukhalladu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan akūnu bihā fī l-ʻayshi l-arghadi and through obedience to You I am made to abide forever in eternity, and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing through which I live the most plentiful and pleasant life. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khayri man ramā l-jimāra O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the best of those who cast the pebbles, wa-khayri man waqafa bi-ʻarafata wa-li-llāhi shakara and the best of those who stood at Arafat and gave thanks to Allah, wa-ṭāfa bi-l-bayti l-ʻatīqi wa-stalama r-rukna wa-qabbala l-ḥajara and circled the Ancient House, touched the Corner and kissed the Stone, wa-khayri man ṣāma wa-qāma wa-li-llāhi jāhada wa-ṣabara and the best of those who fasted and kept vigil in prayer, and strove for Allah and were patient, wa-khayri man qaraʼa l-kitāba wa-rattala s-suwara 32

and the best of those who recited the Book and intoned the surahs in measured tones, ṣalātan bi-ʻadadi r-ramli wa-l-madari · wa-ʻadadi l-ghaythi wa-mā qaṭara with a blessing by the number of the sand and the clods of earth, and the number of the rain and of all that has fallen drop by drop, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ahli l-khayrāti wa-ẓ-ẓafari and upon his family, and grant peace, the people of good works and triumph. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan wa-salāman yanhallu ʻalayya ghaythuhumā min wābili khazāʼini raḥmatika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family, and grant peace, with blessings and peace whose rain pours down upon me from the downpour of the treasuries of Your mercy, yā man khazāʼinu raḥmatihi ṭawʻa irādatihi wa-amrihi lladhī huwa bayna lkāfi wa-n-nūni O You whose treasuries of mercy are at the disposal of His will and of His command, which lies between the Kaf and the Nun, aghithnī bi-raḥmatika l-ʻuẓmā lladhī arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna 33

come to my aid through Your greatest mercy, the one whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds, fa-lā ahliku wa-anā ashhadu laka bi-l-waḥdāniyyati wa-lahu bi-r-risālati waanta khayru r-rāḥimīna “samiʻnā wa-aṭaʻnā ghufrānaka rabbanā wa-ilayka lmaṣīru” and so I shall not perish, while I bear witness to Your oneness and to his messengership, and You are the Best of the merciful. “We hear and we obey. Your forgiveness, our Lord! And to You is the final return” (Qur’an 2:285). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sirājika l-munīri l-anwari O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your radiant lamp, the most luminous, wa-faḍlika l-kabīri l-akbari · wa-badri samāʼika ẓ-ẓāhiri l-aẓhari and Your great bounty, the greatest, and the full moon of Your sky, manifest, the most manifest, al-khāḍiʻi li-jalālika wa-kibriyāʼika fī maqāmihi l-fākhiri l-afkhari who is humbly submissive to Your majesty and grandeur, in his splendid, most splendid station, 34

alladhī ātaytahu s-sabʻa l-mathānī wa-l-Qurʼāna l-ʻaẓīma wa-l-kawthara to whom You gave the seven oft-repeated verses, the Great Qur’an and al-Kawthar (the Abundance), wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī ṣ-ṣubḥi idhā asfara wa-l-layli idhā adbara and upon his family, and grant peace, in the morning when it brightens and in the night when it recedes. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin dhī l-wajhi l-munīri l-waḍḍāʼi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the possessor of the radiant, resplendent face, alladhī tabārakat bihi l-arḍu wa-sharufat bihi s-samāʼu through whom the earth was endowed with grace and the sky was ennobled, alladhī bi-tawḥīdi Allāhi qad jāʼa who came with the affirmation of Allah’s oneness, wa-hadā l-khalāʼiqa ilā l-millati l-ḥanīfiyyati s-samaḥāʼi and guided created beings to the upright and tolerant faith, 35

dhī l-ḥilmi wa-l-karami wa-l-wafāʼi · alladhī bi-barakatihi yaḥṣulu sh-shifāʼu the possessor of forbearance, generosity and fidelity, through whose grace healing is obtained, wa-bidaʻwatihi yanzilu l-ghaythu li-l-fuqarāʼi · wa-takhḍarru baʻda siwādihā l-ghabrāʼu and through whose supplication the rain comes down for the poor, and the dusty earth turns green after its blackness, wa-adim ṣalātaka ʻalayhi mā dāma minka ʻalā khalqika l-khayru wa-ssarrāʼu and perpetuate Your blessings upon him for as long as goodness and prosperity continue to come from You upon Your creation, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim taslīman nadkhulu bihi fī zumrati s-suʻadāʼi and upon his family, and grant peace, a peace through which we enter the company of the fortunate, wa-naslamu bihi min mawāridi l-ashqiyāʼi and by which we are kept safe from the watering-places of the wretched. 36

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-mushammiri ʻan sāʻidi l-jiddi fī l-jihādi fī sabīlika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who rolled up his sleeves with earnest resolve in striving in Your way, ḥattā rafaʻa rāyata l-islāmi · wa-kassara l-aṣnāma until he raised the banner of Islam, and shattered the idols, wa-daʻā ʻabīdaka ilā tawḥīdika fa-jāʼū ṭāʼiʻīna wa-akhlaṣū li-llāhi muslimīna and called Your servants to Your oneness, and they came willingly and devoted themselves sincerely to Allah as Muslims, wa-adhdhana muʼadhdhinu t-tawḥīdi bi-Makkata fa-ajābathu l-qulūbu wa-larwāḥu and the muezzin of oneness gave the call to prayer in Mecca, and the hearts and spirits answered him, wa-fariḥa l-baytu l-ʻatīqu wa-l-ḥaramu · wa-njalat ʻani l-bayti khurāfātu ljāhiliyyati and the Ancient House and the Sacred Precinct rejoiced, and the superstitions of the Age of Ignorance were cleared away from the House, 37

wa-ẓahara t-tawḥīdu fī l-fardi wa-l-jamāʻati and the affirmation of Allah’s oneness became manifest in the individual and in the community, wa-kassara sayyidunā ʻAliyyun raḍiya Allāhu ʻanhu ṣanama khuzāʻata and our master Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, smashed the idol of Khuzaʻa; “wa-qul jāʼa l-ḥaqqu wa-zahaqa l-bāṭilu inna l-bāṭila kāna zahūqan” wa-ṣallā Allāhu ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · wa-jzihi ʻannā aḥsana l-jazāʼi “And say, ‘The truth has come and falsehood has vanished. Truly, falsehood is ever bound to vanish’” (Qur’an 17:81); and may Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family, and grant peace, and reward him on our behalf with the best of rewards. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-makhṣūṣi bishafāʻati faṣli l-qaḍāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, who was singled out for the intercession for the decisive judgement. 38

Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin imāmi l-mursalīna wa-l-anbiyāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the leader of the Messengers and the Prophets. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bi-barakati qawlihi nārat ṣudūru l-ʻulamāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, through the grace of whose words the breasts of the scholars were illumined. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī min baḥrihi sharibāti l-fuqahāʼu O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, from whose ocean the jurists drank. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī dhahabat biṭalʻati ṣubḥi jabīnihi ẓ-ẓulmāʼu 39

O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, at the appearance of the morning of whose brow the darkness departed. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin raʼīsi l-khulafāʼi waṣ-ṣulaḥāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the chief of the caliphs and the righteous. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī taʻaṭṭarat biqudūmihi l-arjāʼu O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, at whose arrival all the regions were perfumed. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin asʻadi s-suʻadāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the most fortunate of the fortunate. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin abī ṭ-ṭāhirati zZahrāʼi 40

O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the father of the pure and radiant al-Zahra’. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī kāna yuḥibbu l-masākīna wa-l-fuqarāʼa O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, who loved the destitute and the poor. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sayyidi l-baṭḥāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the master of the valley of Mecca (al-Baṭḥā’). Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sharīfi l-ajdādi wa-lābāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, of noble grandfathers and fathers. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ahli baytihi lmuṭahharīna ahli l-ʻabāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad and upon the People of his House, the purified, the People of the Cloak. 41

Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣāḥibi t-tāji wa-lliwāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the possessor of the crown and the banner. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin amīri l-umarāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the commander of commanders. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣāḥibi l-miʻrāji wa-lisrāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the possessor of the Ascension and the Night Journey. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥabībi rabbi l-arḍi wa-s-samāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the Beloved of the Lord of the earth and the sky. 42

Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin maljaʼi l-muḥtājīna wa-l-ghurabāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the refuge of those in need and of strangers. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sākini r-rawḍati lghannāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the dweller in the lush Garden (al-Rawḍa). Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sakhiyyi l-yadayni bi-l-ʻaṭāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, generous with both hands in giving. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣafwati l-mawlā mina l-aṣfiyāʼi O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the elect of the Patron from among the pure ones. 43

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin bni ʻabdi Allāhi bni ʻabdi lmuṭṭalibi bni Hāshimin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, son of Abdullah, son of Abd al-Muttalib, son of Hashim, maʻdini asrāri qulūbi l-awliyāʼi wa-l-ʻārifīna the mine of the secrets of the hearts of the friends of Allah and the gnostics, wa-manhali wāridāti l-ʻubbādi wa-dh-dhākirīna · imāmi l-qiblatayni and the watering-place of the spiritual inflows of the worshippers and those who remember Allah, the leader of the two directions of prayer, wa-sayyidi l-kawnayni · wa-khayri l-farīqayni · wa-thānī thnayni lladhī minhu l-ḥasanu wa-l-ḥusaynu and the master of both worlds, and the best of the two groups, and the second of two, from whom came al-Hasan and al-Husayn, al-ladhāni humā qurratu kulli ʻayni the two who are the delight of every eye, abī l-qāsimi wa-z-Zahrāʼi · wa-khātami l-mursalīna wa-l-anbiyāʼa 44

the father of al-Qasim and al-Zahra’, and the Seal of the Messengers and the Prophets, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan wa-salāman yamlaʼāni l-arḍa wa-s-samāʼa and upon his family, and grant peace, with blessings and peace that fill the earth and the sky. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, wa-ḥabībika wa-raḥmatika li-khalqika · nabiyyi r-raḥmati lladhī tuftaḥu bi-ṣṣalāti ʻalayhi abwābu l-khayrāti and Your Beloved and Your mercy to Your creation, the Prophet of mercy, through sending blessings upon whom the doors of good things are opened, wa-tatanazzalu l-barakātu wa-tustajābu d-daʻawātu · ʻadada man maḍā min khalqika wa-mā hū ātin and graces descend and supplications are answered, the number of those of Your creation who have passed and of what is yet to come, 45

ṣalātan taʻummunā anwāruhā bi-l-barakāti wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā sārati z-zuwwāru ilā rawḍatihi llatī hiya afḍalu r-rawḍāti with a blessing whose lights envelop us with graces; and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as visitors journey to his Garden, which is the most excellent of gardens, wa-mā nālū min rabbihim ghufrāna s-sayyiʼāti and for as long as they obtain from their Lord forgiveness for their misdeeds, wa-mā dallahum bi-barakatihi ilā sabīli l-khayrāti · wa-ḥafiẓahum ʻan sabīli s-sayyiʼāti and for as long as they are guided, by his grace, to the path of good things, and kept back from the path of misdeeds. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī saṭaʻat shamsuhu ʻalā aʻyuni l-qulūbi fa-abṣarat O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose sun shone upon the eyes of the hearts, and so they saw, wa-nhalla ghaythu ḥikamihi ʻalā arḍihā fa-htazzat wa-rabat 46

and the rain of his wisdom poured down upon their earth, and so it stirred and swelled, wa-ttaṣalat bihi l-arwāḥu fa-anisat · wa-qshaʻarrat bi-shuhūdihi l-ashbāḥu fa-nashaṭat and the spirits were joined with him, and so found intimacy, and the bodies shuddered at the vision of him, and so were roused, fa-huwa shamsu l-qulūbi wa-ghaythuhā · wa-bahjatu l-arwāḥi wa-unsuhā for he is the sun of the hearts and their rain, and the delight of the spirits and their intimacy, wa-sāʼiqu l-arwāḥi li-saʻdihā · fa-ʻalayhi minka ajallu ṣ-ṣalawāti and the one who drives the spirits on to their felicity; so upon him from You be the most exalted blessings, wa-atammu t-taslīmāti · wa-aʻẓamu l-barakāti · wa-ajzalu l-ʻaṭiyyāti and the most perfect peace, and the greatest graces, and the most abundant gifts, 47

wa-azkā t-taḥiyyāti l-ʻāṭirāti · mā staqāmat li-rabbihā l-anfusu ṭ-ṭāghiyātu and the purest of the fragrant salutations, for as long as rebellious souls become upright before their Lord, wa-hamat bi-wablihā l-muʻṣirātu l-hāṭilātu · wa-ʻalā ālihi l-mubārakīna waazwājihi ṭ-ṭāhirāti and the pouring rain-clouds shed their heavy rain, and upon his blessed family and his pure wives, wa-adim dhālika ilā yawmin tubʻathu fīhi l-amwātu and perpetuate that until the Day when the dead are raised. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, alladhī nawwarta bi-baʻthatihi ẓ-ẓulama l-ḥawālika the one by whose mission You lit up the pitch-black darknesses, wa-nasharta bihi d-dīna fī sāʼiri l-mamālika 48

and through whom You spread the religion across all the realms, wa-akhrajta bihi n-nāsa mina ẓ-ẓulumāti ilā n-nūri and through whom You brought people out of the darknesses into the light, wa-rafaʻta bihi ʻanhumu l-aswāʼa wa-sh-shurūra and through whom You lifted from them ills and evils; fa-huwa nabiyyu l-barri wa-r-raḥmati lladhī kashafta bihi ʻan khalqika ljuḥūda wa-ẓ-ẓulma for he is the Prophet of righteousness and mercy, through whom You removed denial and injustice from Your creation, fa-stanārat bi-anwārihi l-ummatu · wa-tanazzalat ʻalayhā raḥamātuka so that the community was illumined by his lights, and Your mercies descended upon it, wa-ʻammat ʻalayhā barakātuka · wa-lawlāhu mā raḍīta ʻanhum and Your graces enveloped it, and had it not been for him, You would not have been pleased with them, wa-lā naẓarta bi-r-riḍā ilayhim · fa-huwa bābu riḍāka li-man raḍīta ʻalayhi nor looked upon them with good pleasure; for he is the door to Your good pleasure for whomever You are pleased with, 49

wa-bābu t-taʻarrufi li-man taʻarrafta ilayhi and the door of Your making Yourself known, for those to whom You have made Yourself known; fa-lawlāhu mā quriʼa l-Qurʼānu · wa-lā samiʻa bihi insun wa-lā jānnun for had it not been for him, the Qur’an would not have been recited, nor would any human or jinn have heard of it. wa-adriknā Allāhumma bi-jāhihi bi-sarīʻi luṭfika wa-ʻaẓīmi unsika And reach us, O Allah, by his exalted standing with You, with Your swift gentle kindness and Your great intimacy, yā man ānasa ʻibādahu l-abrāra O You who have granted intimacy to His pious servants, bi-wāridāti l-maʻārifi wa-l-anwāri · wa-sallim Allāhumma ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman nanjū bihi fī l-ḥayāti wa-baʻda l-mamāti through the inflows of gnosis and lights; and grant peace, O Allah, upon him and upon his family, a peace by which we are saved in life and after death, yā rabba l-arḍi wa-s-samawāti · yā wāsiʻa r-raḥmati yā kathīra l-khayri wa-lbarakāti 50

O Lord of the earth and the heavens, O One of vast mercy, O One of abundant goodness and graces. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin dharwati sanāmi kulli majdin tālidin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the crest of the hump of every ancestral glory, wa-aʻbadi kulli ʻākifin wa-ʻābidin · wa-akhshaʻi kulli rākiʻin wa-sājidin and the most devout of every devotee in retreat and of every worshipper, and the most humbly reverent of everyone who bows and prostrates, wa-afḍali kulli mawlūdin wa-wālidin · alladhī alāna ṣukhūra l-qulūbi ljawāmidi and the most excellent of everyone born and of every begetter, who softened the rocks of the rigid hearts, wa-jamaʻa aṣnāfan mina l-bawādī awābida and gathered together many kinds of desert folk, wild and untamed, fa-aṣbaḥū bihi ikhwānan fariḥīna mustabshirīna so that through him they became brothers, glad and rejoicing; 51

wa-lawlā huwa mā jtamaʻa ʻākifun wa-bādun and were it not for him, resident and visitor would not have come together, wa-lā ʻamarati l-qulūbu wa-l-bilādu · fa-huwa l-jāmiʻu li-sh-shatāti wa-lmuʼallifu bayna kulli maḥsūdin wa-ḥāsidin nor would hearts and lands have flourished; for he is the one who gathers what was scattered and who reconciles every envied person with every envious person, ṣallā Allāhu wa-sallama ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-ʻalā aṣḥābihi wa-kulli muʼminin wa-ʻābidin may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and his family and his Companions, and every believer and worshipper. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nadhīri lladhī andhara nnāsa wa-ḥadhdharahum O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the warner who warned the people and cautioned them, 52

wa-hadāhum wa-bayyana lahum · wa-qāma bi-amri Allāhi ḥaqqa l-qiyāmi wa-lam taʼkhudhhu lawmatu lāʼimin and guided them and made it plain to them, and carried out Allah’s command as it truly ought to be carried out, and the reproach of no reproacher ever took hold of him, wa-naṣartahu bi-r-ruʻbi wa-aḥlalta lahu l-ghanāʼima and You aided him with terror and made the spoils of war lawful for him, afṣaḥu l-khuṭabāʼi l-mundhirīna · wa-sayyidu waladi Ādama ajmaʻīna the most eloquent of the orators who warn, and the master of all the children of Adam, ṣāḥibu bayʻati r-riḍwāni kathīru l-barakāti the one to whom the Pledge of Good Pleasure was sworn, abundant in graces, sayyidu th-thābitīna fī l-jihādi wa-l-ghazawāti ṣāḥibu abī bakrin wa-ʻUmara wa-ʻUthmāna wa-ʻAliyyin the master of those who stand firm in striving and in the campaigns, the companion of Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman and Ali, 53

jaddu l-ḥasanayni n-nayyirayni · wa-abū z-Zahrāʼi sayyidati nisāʼi l-ʻālamīna the grandfather of the two radiant Hasans (al-Hasan and alHusayn), and the father of al-Zahra’ (Fatima), the lady of the women of the worlds, aʻlamu l-ʻālamīna bi-rabbihim · wa-akhwafu l-khāʼifīna mina Allāhi l-ʻaẓīmi the most knowing of the worlds about their Lord, and the most fearful of those who fear Allah the Magnificent, kathīru l-bukāʼi wa-d-dumūʻi wa-l-khushūʻi · wa-s-sujūdi wa-r-rukūʻi abundant in weeping, tears and humble reverence, and in prostration and bowing, wa-s-sahri wa-l-jūʻi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallim kamā ṣallayta ʻalā sayyidinā Ibrāhīma and in wakeful vigil and hunger, and upon his family and Companions, and grant peace, just as You sent blessings upon our master Abraham, wa-ʻalā āli Ibrāhīma · innaka ḥamīdun majīdun 54

and upon the family of Abraham. Truly, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan wa-salāman lā yanḥaṣirāni ʻadadan O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, blessings and peace that cannot be confined by number, wa-lā yanqaṭiʻāni abadan tushriqu bihimā baṣāʼirunā bi-anwāri qurbihi and that never cease, and through which our inner sight shines with the lights of nearness to him, wa-tunawwiru bihimā abṣāranā bi-barakati ḥubbihi · yā nūra s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍi and through which You illuminate our eyes by the grace of love for him, O Light of the heavens and the earth. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṭibbi l-qulūbi wa-dawāʼihā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the healer of hearts and their remedy, wa-ʻāfiyati l-abdāni wa-shifāʼihā · wa-nūra l-abṣāri wa-ḍiyāʼihā 55

and the well-being of bodies and their healing, and the light of eyes and their radiance, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim “rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā wa-ghfir lanā innaka ʻalā kulli shayʼin qadīrun” and upon his family, and grant peace: “Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us. Truly, You have power over all things” (Qur’an 66:8). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kafīli man āmana bi-llāhi warasūlihi wa-ṣṭabara O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the guarantor of whoever believes in Allah and His Messenger and perseveres, wa-ṭāfa bi-l-bayti l-ʻatīqi wa-ʻtamara · wa-ntahā ʻammā nahā Allāhu ʻanhu and circles the Ancient House and performs the lesser pilgrimage, and refrains from what Allah has forbidden, wa-qāma bi-mā bihi Allāhu amara and carries out what Allah has commanded, wa-athnā ʻalā Allāhi khayra thanāʼin wa-shakara and praises Allah with the finest praise and gives thanks; 56

sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī nshaqqa lahu l-qamaru our master Muhammad, for whom the moon was split, wa-anzala Allāhu ʻalayhi l-Qurʼāna dhā l-āyāti wa-s-suwari and upon whom Allah sent down the Qur’an, with its verses and chapters, ṣalātan taqḍī lanā bihā l-waṭara with a blessing by which You fulfil our needs, wa-tamnaʻunā bihā min kulli sūʼin wa-sharrin and by which You shield us from every harm and evil, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi amwāji kulli baḥrin wa-naharin and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the waves of every sea and river, wa-ʻadadi qaṭarāti kulli ghaythin wa-maṭarin and the number of the drops of every downpour and shower, wa-ʻadadi awrāqi kulli zarʻin wa-shajarin and the number of the leaves of every crop and tree, ṣalātan yafraḥu bi-llāhi qāʼiluhā wa-yusarru with a blessing whose reciter rejoices in Allah and is made glad, 57

wa-yuḥfaẓu min kulli sūʼin wa-sharrin and is protected from every harm and evil. Allāhumma yā bāsiṭa l-yadayni bi-l-ʻaṭāyā O Allah, O You who extend both hands with gifts, yā dāfiʻa l-kurūbi wa-l-khaṭāyā O You who ward off afflictions and transgressions, ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika wa-rasūlika lladhī khtartahu fa-kāna n-nabiyya l-mukhtāra send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, whom You elected, and so he was the Elect Prophet, wa-ṣṭafaytahu fa-kāna min afḍali l-muṣṭafayna l-akhyāri and whom You chose, and so he was among the most excellent of the chosen, the virtuous, alladhī akhadhta l-ʻahda lahu ʻalā n-nabiyyīna wa-l-mursalīna bi-l-īmāni wan-naṣri for whom You took the covenant from the Prophets and the Messengers, to believe in him and to support him, 58

wa-aqsamta fī kitābika bi-dhātihi idh hiya afḍalu dh-dhawāti and You swore in Your Book by his very being, since it is the most excellent of beings, wa-bibaladihi idh hiya afḍalu l-bilādi and by his city, since it is the most excellent of cities, wa-biʻaṣrihi lladhī huwa ashrafu l-ʻuṣūri and by his era, which is the noblest of eras, alladhī sharrafa d-dunyā bi-ẓuhūrihi · wa-anārahā bi-nūrihi afḍalu man mashā ʻalā l-ghabrāʼi wa-khayru man aẓallathu s-samāʼu who honoured this world by his appearing, and lit it with his light, the most excellent of all who have walked upon the dusty earth and the best of all whom the sky has overshadowed, alladhī bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi tunālu r-raghāʼibu the one through sending blessings upon whom the things longed for are attained, wa-tudfaʻu l-maṣāʼibu · wa-tanzilu l-khayrātu · wa-taʻummu l-barakātu and misfortunes are warded off, and good things descend, and graces spread far and wide, 59

ḥabībuka wa-niʻma l-ḥabību · ash-shafīʻu fī khalqika wa-niʻma sh-shafīʻu Your Beloved, and what an excellent beloved he is, the intercessor for Your creation, and what an excellent intercessor he is, afḍalu man aṭāʻa Allāha wa-dhakara Allāha the most excellent of all who obeyed Allah and remembered Allah, wa-āmana bi-llāhi wa-daʻā ilā Allāhi and believed in Allah and called to Allah, an-nabiyyu l-ʻarabiyyu l-qurashiyyu · wa-rḍa ʻan aṣḥābihi wa-rḥam ummatahu fī l-ʻālamīna · innaka ḥamīdun majīdun the Arab Prophet, the Qurashite; and be pleased with his Companions, and have mercy on his community throughout the worlds. Truly, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṭibbi l-qulūbi wa-mudāwīhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the healer of hearts and the one who treats them, 60

wa-ḥabībi l-arwāḥi wa-hādīhā · wa-imāmi l-ummati wa-dāʻīhā fakhru Makkata idh wulida fīhā and the beloved of spirits and their guide, and the leader of the community and its caller, the pride of Mecca, since he was born in it, wa-sayyidu Ṭaybata llatī ṭābat arāḍīhā l-āmiru bi-l-maʻrūfi and the master of Tayba, whose lands have become sweet, who enjoins what is right, alladhī kāna yuṭʻimu l-jāʼiʻa wa-yaʼmuru bi-l-maʻrūfi wa-yughīthu l-malhūfa wa-yukrimu ḍ-ḍuyūfa who used to feed the hungry, enjoin what is right, come to the aid of the distressed and honour guests, ṣāḥibu l-ʻiffati wa-l-ghinā · wa-l-qanāʻati wa-l-hanā the possessor of self-restraint and self-sufficiency, and of contentment and happiness, ḥalīfu l-ḥilmi wa-l-karami · ashharu min nārin ʻalā ʻalamin the ally of forbearance and generosity, more renowned than a fire on a lofty peak, 61

man rafaʻa Allāhu dhikrahu fa-ṣāra marfūʻan ʻalā jamīʻi dhikri l-makhlūqīna the one whose mention Allah raised up, so that it stands exalted above the mention of all created beings, wa-adāma ʻizzahu wa-qadi nqaṭaʻa ʻizzu l-mulūki l-aqdamīna and whose glory He made endure, while the glory of the kings of old has ceased, wa-sharaḥa ṣadrahu wa-malaʼahu ḥikmatan nūrāniyyatan and whose breast He expanded and filled with luminous wisdom, wa-waḍaʻa wizrahu wa-ayyadahu bi-quwwatin rūḥāniyyatin and whose burden He removed and whom He supported with spiritual strength; fa-huwa sayyidu r-rūḥāniyyīna · wa-ḥujjatu l-mujtahidīna wa-l-muqallidīna so he is the master of the spiritual ones, and the proof for those who exercise independent judgement and for those who follow, wa-mumiddu l-wāṣilīna wa-l-ʻārifīna · dhū l-himmati l-ʻaliyyati and the bestower of succour upon those who have arrived and upon those who know Allah, possessed of lofty resolve, wa-n-nafsi l-abiyyati · wa-s-saṭwati l-qawiyyati · dāʼimu l-bishri 62

and of an unbowed soul, and of formidable might, ever cheerful, ṭawīlu l-fikri · ʻālī l-qadri · ʻaẓīmu l-jāhi long in reflection, lofty in rank, great in standing, dāʼimu l-intibāhi · dhū l-millati l-ḥanīfiyyati l-bayḍāʼi ever alert, possessed of the upright, pure-white creed, sayyidu l-ʻarabi l-ʻarbāʼi · wa-ashrafu l-qurashiyyīna the master of the pure-blooded Arabs, and the noblest of the Qurashites, wa-fakhru l-ʻalawiyyīna · fakhru banī Hāshimi and the pride of the descendants of Ali, the pride of the sons of Hashim, sayyidī abū l-qāsimi · abū z-Zahrāʼi n-naqiyyati my master, Abu al-Qasim, the father of the pure al-Zahra’ (Fatima), dhū dh-dhimati ṭ-ṭāhirati l-wafiyyati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallim kamā ṣallayta ʻalā Ibrāhīma possessed of a pure and faithful pledge, and upon his family and Companions, and grant peace, just as You sent blessings upon Abraham, 63

wa-ʻalā āli Ibrāhīma innaka ḥamīdun majīdun and upon the family of Abraham. Truly, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā ṭāfa bi-l-qalbi ṭāʼifu khayrin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as a visitation of good circles the heart, ṣalātan nusāqu bihā ilā khayri sayrin with a blessing by which we are led to the best of journeys, wa-nuḥfaẓu bihā min kulli sharrin and by which we are protected from every evil; mā ṭāra fī l-faḍāʼi ṭayrun for as long as a bird flies through the open sky, bi-ʻadadi sukkāni l-baḥri wa-l-barri · sayyidinā Muḥammadin raḥmati Allāhi r-raḥīmi l-barri by the number of the inhabitants of the sea and the land, our master Muhammad, the mercy of Allah, the Ever-Merciful, the Kind, 64

alladhī staqarra fī l-khuldi khayra maqarrin who has settled in everlasting Paradise, the finest of abodes, fī ṭaybatihi fī rawḍatin bihā l-ʻaynu taqarru ṣalātan bihā l-khayru ʻalaynā yastamirru wa-sh-sharru ʻannā yadhhabu wa-yafirru in his Tayba, in a garden in which the eye is delighted; with a blessing by which good continues upon us, and evil departs from us and flees, mā tāba ilā Allāhi tāʼibun wa-staghfara wa-lam yuṣirra as often as a penitent turns to Allah in repentance, seeks forgiveness and does not persist [in sin], wa-mā waqafa bi-ʻArafātin ḥājjun wa-nafara and as often as a pilgrim stands at Arafat and then departs, wa-ṭāfa bi-l-bayti l-ʻatīqi ṭāʼifun wa-ʻtamara and someone circles the Ancient House and performs the lesser pilgrimage, wa-sāmaḥa Allāhu l-ḥajīja wa-ghafara · wa-raḍiya ʻan aḥbābihi wa-lahum satara and Allah pardons the pilgrims and forgives, and is pleased with His beloved ones and draws a veil over them; 65

bi-ʻadadi man dakhala l-jannata fī jannātin wa-naharin by the number of those who have entered Paradise, in gardens and rivers, wa-biʻadadi mā aẓhara Allāhu fī l-kawni min badāʼiʻa wa-ʻibara and by the number of the marvels and lessons that Allah has made manifest in the universe, wa-biʻadadi kulli man tāba li-rabbihi wa-nzajara and by the number of everyone who turned in repentance to his Lord and desisted, wa-biʻadadi kulli man albasahumu Allāhu libāsa t-taqwā l-muftakhara and by the number of all those whom Allah has clothed in the prized garment of piety, wa-biʻadadi kulli muʼminin qātala l-kuffāra wa-zaʼara and by the number of every believer who fought the disbelievers and roared, wa-biʻadadi kulli man jāʼahu rasūlu Allāhi fa-ntaṣara and by the number of everyone to whom the Messenger of Allah came and who then triumphed, wa-biʻadadi kulli masmūʻin fī d-dunyā min qawlin wa-khabarin and by the number of everything heard in this world, of speech and report, 66

mā kasā Allāhu l-arḍa nafāʼisa l-khuḍari for as long as Allah clothes the earth in the choicest greenery, wa-mā zāna nūruhu sh-shajara · wa-biʻadadi kulli zāʼirin li-Ṭaybata ḥaḍara and his light adorns the trees, and by the number of every visitor to Tayba who came, wa-raddada s-salāma bi-ḥubbin wa-shawqin ʻalā khayri l-bashari and repeated the greeting of peace, with love and longing, upon the best of mankind, man anzala ʻalayhi Allāhu taʻālā l-āyāti wa-s-suwari the one upon whom Allah, the Exalted, sent down the verses and chapters, khayru man sharufat bihi Muḍaru the best of those through whom the tribe of Mudar was ennobled, wa-azāla Allāhu bihi l-ḥuzna wa-l-kadara and through whom Allah removed grief and gloom. Allāhumma asʻidnā bi-zawratihi maʻa kulli man zāra wa-zdahara O Allah, grant us joy through visiting him, along with everyone who has visited and flourished, 67
wa-ʻalāhumu n-nūru l-muḥammadiyyu wa-ghamara innaka ḥamīdun majīdun and the Muhammadan light rose above them and flooded over them. Truly, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. 68

wa-jaʻala l-jannata mutaqallabahumā wa-mathwāhumā and make Paradise their resort and their abode. wa-nfaʻnā Allāhumma bi-jāhihimā ʻindaka yā Allāhu And benefit us, O Allah, through their standing with You, O Allah. Allāhumma innī uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday kulli nafasin walamḥatin wa-ṭarfatin yaṭrifu bihā ahlu s-samāwāti wa-ahlu l-arḍi wakulli shayʼin huwa fī ʻilmika kāʼinun aw qad kāna uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday dhālika kullihi O Allah, I offer to You, in the presence of every breath, every glance and every blink with which the people of the heavens and the people of the earth blink, and of everything that is in Your knowledge, whether it is yet to be or has already come to be — I offer to You, in the presence of all of that, [the prayers that follow]. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-hāshimiyyi lmukhtāri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet, the Hashimite, the Elect One; 70

wa-rḍa ʻan ahli baytihi mimman sakanū l-fayāfiya wa-l-amṣāra and be pleased with the People of his House, among those who have dwelt in the deserts and the cities. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī huwa samḥun idhā bāʻa samḥun idhā shtarā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who is lenient when he sells and lenient when he buys, alladhī kāna yakrahu l-jidāla wa-l-mirā who used to dislike disputation and wrangling. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ash-shafīʻi l-mushaffaʻi lladhī jāhuhu fī kulli ḥīnin yanfaʻu wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā tashaffaʻa bihi ilayka mutashaffiʻun O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the intercessor whose intercession is accepted, whose exalted standing benefits at all times; and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as any petitioner seeks intercession through him with You. 71

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khayri man jāhada fī sabīli Allāhi wa-daʻā · wa-ḥajja wa-ʻtamara wa-saʻā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the best of all who strove in the way of Allah and gave the call, and performed the pilgrimage and the lesser pilgrimage and the saʻy. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā ḥarraka l-wajda mashūqun ilā n-nabiyyi ṣ-ṣaddūqi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as one who yearns for the Prophet, the Ever-Truthful, stirs up ardent passion, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-rzuqnā Allāhumma bi-jāhihi tamāma l-wuthūqi and upon his family, and grant peace; and grant us, O Allah, by his exalted standing with You, perfect trust. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nūri l-asbaqi lladhī minhu ltumisati l-anwāru s-sābiqatu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Foremost Light, from whom the earlier lights were sought, 72

wa-tasarrajat bihi l-umamu l-lāḥiqatu · fa-huwa n-nūru s-sābiqu wa-l-faḍlu llāḥiqu and by whom the nations that followed were lit as with a lamp; for he is the preceding Light and the succeeding Bounty. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-munbaʻithi nūruhu ilā lqulūbi taryāqan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose light was sent forth to the hearts as an antidote, wa-ʻalā qadruhu sabʻan ṭibāqan · wa-ahdā l-anāma amnan wa-wifāqan and whose rank rose above the seven heavens, layer upon layer, and who presented humankind with security and harmony. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tasbiqu l-barqu sabqan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that far outstrips the lightning, yarḍā bihā man arsaltahu nabiyyan ḥaqqan a blessing with which the one You sent as a true prophet is well pleased, 73

bi-ʻadadi mā khalaqta fī l-akwāni khalqan by the number of all the creatures You have created in the universes. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ʻaṭafa ʻalā l-muʻwazīna min khalqika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who showed tenderness to the needy among Your creation, wa-qaḍā ḥawāʼija s-sāʼilīna bi-faḍlika · wa-ātaytahu mafātiḥa khazāʼini arḍika and met the needs of those who asked, by Your bounty, and You gave him the keys to the treasuries of Your earth. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin aʻbadi l-ʻābidīna laka O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the most devout of those who worship You, wa-ashaddi l-mujāhidīna li-ajlika l-ḥākimi bayna khalqika bi-amrika · wa-ddāʻī ilayka bi-idhnika 74

and the most vigorous of those who strive for Your sake, who judges between Your creation by Your command, and the one who calls to You by Your leave. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin afḍali l-afāḍili n-nabiyyi lkāmili O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the most excellent of the excellent, the perfect Prophet, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli qaṭrin nāzilin and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every drop that falls. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khayri man ṭāfa wa-aḥrama O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the best of those who performed the circumambulation and entered the state of ihram, wa-ṣallā wa-sallama wa-khaṭaba wa-takallama · wa-ḍaḥika wa-tabassama and prayed and gave the salutation of peace, and delivered sermons and spoke, and laughed and smiled. 75

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi s-sakhāʼi wa-l-karami O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of liberality and generosity, al-musrā bihi min ḥaramin ilā ḥaramin who was taken by night from one sanctuary to another, wa-lladhī yuqassimu ʻalā ahli l-jannati n-niʻama and who apportions favours to the people of Paradise. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tashraḥu bihā ṣadrī lil-ʻilmi wa-d-durūsi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which You expand my breast for knowledge and study, wa-iṣlāḥi n-nufūsi and for the reform of souls, wa-tudkhilunī bihā fī ḥaḍrati l-maliki l-quddūsi wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim waṣrif ʻannā bi-faḍlika kulla n-nuḥūsi 76

and by which You admit me into the Presence of the King, the Most Holy; and upon his family, and grant peace; and by Your bounty turn away from us all ill fortune. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tudkhilunā bihā ḥaẓāʼira l-qudsi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which You admit us into the enclosures of holiness, wa-tuqawwī bihā r-rūḥa ʻalā l-ḥissi and by which You strengthen the spirit over the senses, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-jʻal lanā farqan min ghayri labsin and upon his family, and grant peace; and give us a distinction free of any confusion. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalāta muṣallin yashhaduhu maʻa l-anfāsi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with the blessing of one who sends blessings while witnessing him with every breath, wa-yaʼkhudhu minhu lā min lawḥin wa-kurrāsin and who takes from him, not from a slate or a notebook, 77

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ḥfaẓnā mina l-waswāsi and upon his family, and grant peace; and protect us from the whisperer. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā ntaṣara sh-sharʻu waʻamma n-nafʻu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as the Sacred Law triumphs and benefit becomes universal, ṣalātan tamlaʼu l-araḍīna wa-s-samāwāti s-sabʻa with a blessing that fills the earths and the seven heavens, ṣalātan tubāriku lanā bihā kulla fardin wa-jamʻin a blessing by which You grant us grace in every individual and every group, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · alladhīna jāhadū li-naṣri d-dīni wa-sh-sharʻi and upon his family, and grant peace, those who strove for the victory of the religion and the Sacred Law. 78

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kathīri l-bukāʼi min khashyatika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, much given to weeping out of awe of You, wa-ʻaẓīmi r-raghbati fī ṭāʻatika · wa-raḥmatika l-wāsiʻati ilā khalqika and intense in his eagerness to obey You, and Your vast mercy to Your creation, alladhī jāʼahu Jibrīlu l-amīnu bi-waḥyika the one to whom Gabriel the Trustworthy came with Your revelation. Allāhumma yā man lā awwaliyyata li-wujūdihi O Allah, O You whose existence has no beginning, ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī lahu awwaliyyatun ʻalā jamīʻi khalqika send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who has primacy over all Your creation, 79

min samāwātika wa-ʻarshika · wa-anbiyāʼika wa-rusulika wa-malāʼikatika including Your heavens and Your Throne, and Your Prophets and Your Messengers and Your angels, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-jʻalnā Allāhumma min ahli wuddika wa-ḥifẓika and upon his family, and grant peace; and make us, O Allah, among the people of Your affection and Your protection. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī jāʼa bi-mā lam tastaṭiʻhu l-awāʼilu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who came with what the earlier generations were unable to achieve, wa-ḥamalat bihi bintu wahbin bi-mā lam tasbiqhā ilayhi l-ḥawāmilu and whom the daughter of Wahb (Amina) carried as no pregnant woman before her had carried, wa-uzīlat bihi ʻani l-kawni l-muftariyātu wa-z-zalāzilu and through whom fabrications and convulsions were removed from the universe. 80

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan sarīʻata l-wuṣūli O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing swift to arrive, mutawwajatan bi-l-qubūli · murḍiyatan li-r-rasūli · muḥaqqiqatan li-lmaʼmūli crowned with acceptance, pleasing to the Messenger, fulfilling what is hoped for, fātiḥatan bāba d-dukhūli wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-aṣḥābihi laʼimmati l-ʻudūli opening the door of entry; and grant peace upon him and upon his family and his Companions, the upright leaders. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi lladhī lamaʻa nūruhu fa-raʼāhu Jibrīlu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet whose light gleamed so that Gabriel saw it, 81

qabla khalqi Ādama wa-l-khalīli · wa-dhukira thanāʼuhu fī t-tawrāti wa-linjīli before the creation of Adam and of the Intimate Friend (Abraham), and whose praise was mentioned in the Torah and the Gospel, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-munna ʻalaynā bi-l-ʻibādati wa-t-tanzīli and upon his family, and grant peace; and favour us with worship and the Revelation. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-āmiri bi-l-ikhlāṣi fī l-ʻamali O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who enjoins sincerity in action, alladhī bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi yadhhabu l-hammu wa-l-kasalu the one through sending blessings upon whom worry and sloth depart, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · wa-amminnā Allāhumma bi-jāhihi min kulli rawʻin wa-wajalin and upon his family, and grant peace; and grant us safety, O Allah, by his exalted standing with You, from all fright and trepidation. 82

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā ghafara Allāhu dhunūban O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as Allah forgives sins, wa-satara li-khalqihi ʻuyūban · wa-farraja ʻanhum humūman wa-kurūban and conceals faults for His creation, and relieves them of worries and afflictions, wa-yassara lahum maṭlūban wa-marghūban · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and eases for them what they seek and desire, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā kushifa ʻani l-qulūbi ghiṭāʼuhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as the covering is lifted from the hearts, wa-zayyanati l-arḍa samāʼuhā · wa-akhrajati l-ashjāru dawāʼahā and the sky adorns the earth, and the trees bring forth their remedy, wa-jarā ʻalā jawānibi l-arḍi māʼuhā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim 83

and its waters flow over the regions of the earth, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan taghfiru bihā dhunūbī O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which You forgive my sins, wa-tasturu bihā ʻuyūbī · wa-tuyassiru bihā mina l-khayri marghūbī and by which You conceal my faults, and by which You ease for me what I desire of good, wa-tuʼamminu bihā kulla qalbin marʻūbin and by which You grant security to every terrified heart, wa-talṭufu bihā binā fī kulli qaḍāʼin maktūbin wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and by which You show us gentle kindness in every decree that is written; and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā sakabat ʻaynun tuḥibbuhu damʻan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as an eye that loves him pours out tears, 84

wa-aʻārat li-qawlihi ṣamtan wa-samʻan · fa-zakat bihi aṣlan wa-farʻan and lends silence and hearing to his words, so that, through him, it is purified in root and branch, wa-ḥasunat bihi ʻādatan wa-ṭabʻan · wa-jmaʻi Allāhumma baynī wa-baynahu jamʻan and becomes beautiful in habit and disposition through him; and bring me together with him, O Allah, in a true gathering, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim taslīman anālu bihi khayran wa-nafʻan and upon his family, and grant peace, a peace by which I attain good and benefit. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻadada alṭāfika wa-ʻadada birrika wa-itḥāfika wa-ʻadada inqādhika wa-isʻāfika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the number of Your gentle kindnesses, the number of Your beneficence and Your gifts, and the number of Your deliverance and Your succour, wa-ʻadada khayrātika wa-barakātika · wa-midāda kalimātika and the number of Your good things and Your graces, and the ink of Your words; 85

wa-asʼaluka Allāhumma bi-jāhihi an tajʻalanī min ahli ḥasanātika waʻināyatika and I ask You, O Allah, by his exalted standing with You, to make me among the people of Your goodness and Your care; wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā shtāqat anfusun ilā munājātika wa-tilāwati kalimātika and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as souls yearn for intimate converse with You and for reciting Your words. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan taftaḥu bihā masāmiʻa qalbī li-dhikrika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which You open the ears of my heart to Your remembrance, wa-yalhaju bihā lisānī bi-ḥamdika wa-shukrika and by which my tongue remains devoted to Your praise and thanks, wa-adkhulu bihā yawma l-qiyāmati fī jannati ʻadnika and by which I enter, on the Day of Resurrection, Your Garden of Eden, 86

fī riḍāka wa-qurbika · wa-adkhulu bihā fī ahli ḥubbika wa-waṣlika in Your good pleasure and Your nearness, and by which I enter among the people of Your love and union with You, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ahli ʻibādatika wa-ḥubbika and upon his family, and grant peace, the people devoted to worshipping You and loving You. Allāhumma adim sawābigha ṣalawātika wa-nawāmiya barakātika O Allah, perpetuate Your ample blessings and Your ever-growing graces, wa-jazīla taḥiyyātika wa-munīra taslīmātika · ʻalā afḍali l-mutḥafīna birisālātika and Your abundant greetings and Your radiant salutations of peace, upon the most excellent of those favoured with Your messages, wa-l-muʼayyadīna bi-naṣrika wa-kalimātika · wa-d-dāʻīna ilā subuli saʻādatika and of those strengthened by Your help and Your words, and of those who call to the paths of the happiness You grant, 87

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-jʻalnā Allāhumma min ahli maghfiratika wajannātika and upon his family, and grant peace; and make us, O Allah, among the people of Your forgiveness and Your Gardens. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin bi-qadri ḥubbika fīhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad in proportion to Your love for him. Allāhumma bi-jāhihi farrij ʻannī mā anā fīhi O Allah, by his exalted standing with You, relieve me of what I am going through. Allāhumma lā asʼaluka radda l-qaḍāʼi wa-lākin asʼaluka l-luṭfa fīhi O Allah, I do not ask You to turn back the decree, but I ask You for gentle kindness within it. wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallim wa-lā takilnī ilā nafsī wa-lā ilā aḥadin min khalqika ṭarfata ʻaynin wa-lā aqalla min dhālika And upon his family and Companions, and grant peace; and do not entrust me to myself or to anyone of Your creation, not even for the blink of an eye, nor for less than that. 88

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-khalāṣi min kulli shiddatin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of deliverance from every hardship, wa-l-faraji wa-n-najdati wa-l-jāhi ʻindaka wa-l-ijābati wa-l-qabūli fa-niʻma lmuntakhabu min khalqika wa-niʻma r-rasūlu of relief, of succour, of standing with You, of answered supplication and of acceptance; for excellent indeed is the one chosen from among Your creation, and excellent indeed is the Messenger; fa-bihi Allāhumma farrij ʻannā wa-shaffiʻhu fīnā wa-ksunā Allāhumma thawba l-mawaddati wa-l-qabūli so through him, O Allah, relieve us, and accept his intercession for us, and clothe us, O Allah, in the garment of affection and acceptance. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī zakā aṣluhu wa-farʻuhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose root and branch are pure, 89

wa-fāqa jamīʻa sh-sharāʼiʻi sharʻuhu · wa-khayru ṭabʻin fī l-umami ṭabʻuhu whose Sacred Law surpassed all other laws, whose disposition is the finest disposition among the nations, wa-afḍalu durūʻi l-mujāhidīna dirʻuhu · wa-afḍalu l-aṣḥābi wa-l-jumūʻi ṣaḥbuhu wa-jamʻuhu whose coat of mail is the finest of the coats of mail of those who strive, whose Companions and assembly are the finest of all companions and assemblies, alladhī ʻamma l-muslimīna nafʻuhu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim whose benefit embraces all Muslims, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika sh-shafīʻi l-mushaffaʻi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the intercessor whose intercession is accepted, 90

alladhī baʻathtahu fī l-ummiyyīna li-yuʻallimahumu l-kitāba wa-l-ḥikmata wa-yuzakkīhim whom You sent among the unlettered people, to teach them the Book and wisdom and to purify them, wa-rafaʻta bihi l-ʻadhāba ʻan ahli l-arḍi wa-qulta wa-qawluka l-ḥaqqu “wamā kāna Allāhu li-yuʻadhdhibahum wa-anta fīhim” wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and through whom You lifted punishment from the people of the earth, and You said—and Your word is the truth—“And Allah would never punish them while you are among them” (Qur’an 8:33); and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khayri man ḥajja wa-ʻtamara wa-labbā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the best of those who performed the pilgrimage and the lesser pilgrimage and called out “Labbayk”, ṣalātan tarzuqunī bihā ḥubbaka wa-ḥubbahu wa-takūnu li-qalbī dawāʼan wa-ṭibbā 91

with a blessing through which You grant me love of You and love of him, and which becomes a remedy and a cure for my heart, wa-takūnu li-wasāwisi sh-shayṭāni raddan wa-ḥarban and which becomes a repulse of, and a war against, the whisperings of Satan, ṣalātan tajdhubunī bihā ilā ḥaḍrati l-qurbi jadhban with a blessing through which You draw me, with a mighty drawing, into the Presence of Nearness, ṣalātan āmanu bihā buʻdan wa-salban wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim with a blessing through which I am secure from remoteness and dispossession; and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī jāʼat li-daʻwatihi lashjāru O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, at whose summons the trees came, wa-nhallati l-ghuyūthu wa-l-amṭāru · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-kfinā Allāhumma sharra mā yajīʼu fī l-layli wa-n-nahāri and the life-giving rains and the showers poured down, and upon his family, and grant peace; and shield us, O Allah, from the evil of whatever comes by night and by day. 92

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā tahallala farḥan yawma fatḥa ummi l-qurā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as he beamed with joy on the day of the conquest of the Mother of Cities (Mecca), wa-mā tasharrafa bihi ghāru thawrin wa-ḥirā and for as long as the caves of Thawr and Hira were honoured by him, alladhī laylan sarā · wa-nāla min rabbihi l-karāmata wa-l-qirā he who journeyed by night, and received from his Lord honour and hospitality, mā taqāṭara damʻu aḥbābihi shawqan ilayhi wa-jarā for as long as the tears of those who love him drip and flow out of longing for him, alladhī bihi ḥaqqa l-ḥaqqu wa-zāla l-mirā he through whom the truth was established and wrangling vanished, mā jadda ilayhi ḥajījun bi-s-surā for as long as pilgrims press on toward him through the night journeys, 93

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · ʻadada dharrāti ṣ-ṣukhūri wa-th-tharā and upon his family, and grant peace, the number of the particles of the rocks and the soil. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin as-sābiḥi fī baḥri jalāli kamāli dhī l-jalāli wa-l-ikrāmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the swimmer in the ocean of the majesty of the perfection of the Possessor of Majesty and Honour, ḥaythu lā sabḥa illā bihi where there is no swimming except through him, wa-l-muthabbiti bika man shiʼta li-tajallī jalālika and the one who, through You, makes steadfast whomever You will for the self-disclosure of Your majesty, wa-l-muqassimi bi-amrika li-man shiʼta min ʻaẓīmi ikrāmika and the one who, by Your command, apportions to whomever You will from Your immense honour. fa-bihi Allāhumma atawajjahu ilayka an tudkhilanī fī ḥizbihi lladhīna khuṣṣū bi-th-thabāti wa-l-ikrāmi · yā dhā l-jalāli wa-l-ikrāmi 94

So through him, O Allah, I turn to You, that You may admit me into his party, those who have been distinguished with steadfastness and honour, O Possessor of Majesty and Honour. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin afḍali man yamshī ʻalā l-arḍi wa-man tuẓilluhu s-samāʼu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the most excellent of those who walk upon the earth and of those whom the sky overshadows, al-mushaffaʻu yawma l-qiyāmati bi-shafāʻati faṣli l-qaḍāʼi the one whose intercession is accepted on the Day of Resurrection, through the intercession for the decisive settling of judgement, al-qāʼilu “anā lahā anā lahā” fa-huwa l-maqbūlu ʻindaka the one who says, “I am for it, I am for it,” for he is the one accepted with You; fa-bijāhihi taqabbal minnā aʻmālanā · wa-khtim bi-ṣ-ṣāliḥāti ājālanā so by his exalted standing (with You), accept our deeds from us, and seal our appointed terms with righteous deeds, wa-adkhilnā fī ʻibādika ṣ-ṣāliḥīna · wa-sallim Allāhumma ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi taslīma l-fawzi l-ʻaẓīmi and admit us among Your righteous servants, and grant peace, O Allah, upon him and upon his family, with the peace of the great 95

triumph.
