Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi r-raḥmati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of mercy, ar-raḥīmi r-raʼūfi · wa-l-ḥalīmi l-ʻaṭūfi · ṣalātan tuyassiru lanā bihā ʻalā ʻArafāti l-wuqūfi the merciful, the kind, and the forbearing, the tenderly compassionate, with a blessing through which You ease for us the standing at Arafat, wa-taḥfaẓunā bihā mina l-khizyi wa-l-kusūfi and through which You protect us from disgrace and shame, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · bi-ʻadadi l-aʻdādi min miʼātin wa-ulūfin and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all numbers, of hundreds and thousands, ṣalātan tuʼamminnā bihā min kulli ḥuznin wa-khawfin with a blessing through which You grant us security from every grief and fear, wa-tajʻalunā bihā min ahli l-khayri wa-l-maʻrūfi and through which You make us people of goodness and kindness, 96

wa-taḥfaẓunā bihā min kulli sharrin wa-ḥutūfin and through which You protect us from every evil and every deadly fate, wa-taḥfaẓu l-muslimīna fī mashāriqi l-arḍi wa-maghāribihā min kulli balāʼin wa-ʻināʼin wa-zilzālin wa-khusūfin and through which You protect the Muslims throughout the east and west of the earth from every affliction, hardship, earthquake and being swallowed by the earth. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ʻamma nūruhu l-anfusa wa-l-āfāqa O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose light pervaded the souls and the horizons, wa-azāla bi-ʻadlihi shuʼma ẓ-ẓulmi wa-sh-shiqāqi and who, through his justice, removed the misfortune of oppression and discord, wa-aqāma bi-hadyihi l-muwaddata wa-l-wifāqa and who, through his guidance, established affection and harmony, 97

wa-azāla bi-ḥikmatihi ʻani l-qulūbi l-aʻlāqi lladhī bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi tanzilu rraḥmatu wa-yadhhabu l-ʻusru wa-l-imlāqu and who, through his wisdom, removed from hearts their clinging attachments; he through the sending of blessings upon whom mercy descends, and hardship and destitution depart, ṣalātan tuyassiru lanā bihā l-asbāba wa-l-arzāqa with a blessing through which You ease for us the means and the provisions, wa-alqi nūrahā fī l-ḥayāti wa-yawma t-talāqi and cast its light in life and on the Day of Meeting, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ʻajjil lanā bi-sarīʻi luṭfika wa-ʻaṭfika wa-ḥanānika yā laṭīfu yā wadūdu yā khallāqu and upon his family, and grant peace; and hasten for us Your swift gentle kindness, Your tenderness and Your compassion, O Subtle, Gentle One, O Most Loving, O Supreme Creator. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khayri tālin li-kitābika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the best of those who recite Your Book, wa-khayri wāqifin bi-bābika · aqrabu aḥbābika 98

and the best of those who stand at Your door, the nearest of Your beloved ones, wa-afḍalu d-dāʻīna li-hadyika wa-rashādika · alladhī bārakta ʻalā ummatihi fī aqṭārika wa-bilādika and the most excellent of those who call to Your guidance and right direction, he upon whose community You have bestowed grace in Your regions and Your lands, wa-raḍīta fīhim ʻan awliyāʼika wa-aqṭābika and among them You were pleased with Your friends and Your spiritual poles, wa-ammantahum min salbi niʻamika wa-inzāli ʻadhābika and You made them secure from the stripping away of Your favours and the sending down of Your punishment. Allāhumma shaffiʻhu fīnā shafāʻatan tajʻalunā bihā mina l-ʻāmilīna biaḥkāmi kitābika O Allah, accept his intercession for us, an intercession through which You make us among those who act by the rulings of Your Book, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā jāʼa l-ḥujjāju Makkata wa fī ʻArafātin ukrimū biʻaẓīmi maghfiratika wa-thawābika 99

and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as the pilgrims come to Mecca and, at Arafat, are honoured with Your great forgiveness and reward. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-mawaddati lladhī alqayta ʻalayhi mawaddatan minka O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of loving affection, upon whom You cast an affection from You, wa-rasūli r-raḥmati lladhī habaṭat ilayhi r-raḥmatu minka and the Messenger of mercy, to whom mercy descended from You, fa-huwa nabiyyu mawaddatika · wa-rasūlu raḥmatika for he is the Prophet of Your loving affection, and the Messenger of Your mercy, al-muʻtazzu bi-ʻizzatika · wa-l-muʼayyadu bi-naṣrika wa-quwwatika the one made mighty through Your might, and the one supported with Your help and Your strength, wa-l-mubayyinu li-kitābika wa-sharīʻatika · wa-l-hādī li-khalīqatika wa-ahli ṭāʻatika wa-l-mubashshiru li-l-muʼminīna bi-naʻīmika wa-jannatika and the one who makes clear Your Book and Your Law, and the guide of Your creation and of the people of obedience to You, and the bearer of glad tidings to the believers of Your bliss and Your Paradise, 100

wa-n-nāṣiru li-ḥizbika wa-daʻwatika · ʻalayhi minka afḍalu ṣalawātika waatammu taslīmātika and the supporter of Your party and Your call. Upon him from You be the most excellent of Your blessings and the most perfect of Your salutations of peace, wa-ʻalā ālihi milʼa arḍika wa-samāwātika and upon his family, as much as would fill Your earth and Your heavens. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ṭāfa bi-l-bayti wa-li-lḥajari qabbala O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who circled the House and kissed the Stone, wa-shāhada Allāha taʻālā ṭūla ḥayātihi wa-ʻalayhi aqbala and witnessed Allah, the Most High, throughout his life, and turned toward Him, wa-nawwara l-qulūba bi-l-īmāni wa-li-l-kufri baddada wa-ʻaṭṭala and lit the hearts with faith, and dispersed and abolished disbelief, fa-stajābat lahu l-qulūbu wa-ʻalayhā Allāhu l-īmāna anzala 101

so the hearts answered his call, and Allah sent down faith upon them, wa-ataw bi-Minan li-ramyi l-jamarāti fa-minhum man taʼakhkhara waminhum man taʻajjala and they came to Mina to stone the Jamarat, and among them were those who stayed on and among them those who hastened, fa-huwa l-ḥabību l-maḥbūbu lladhī ʻalā rabbihi tawakkala for he is the Beloved, the Loved One, who placed his trust in his Lord, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā ruwiya ḥadīthuhu l-muʻanʻanu wa-lmusalsalu and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of times his hadith has been narrated, the muʻanʻan (“from … from …”) and the musalsal (serially linked). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika ḥabībi l-arwāḥi wa-l-ashbāḥi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the beloved of spirits and bodies, 102

wa-ṣafwati Allāhi l-maliki l-fattāḥi · ṣalātan taftaḥu bihā ʻalayya futūḥa lʻārifīna and the pure choice of Allah, the King, the Opener, with a blessing through which You open to me the openings of those who know Allah, wa-tudrikunī bi-luṭfika ẓ-ẓāhiri wa-l-khafiyyi fī kulli waqtin wa-ḥīnin and through which You reach me with Your gentle kindness, outward and hidden, at every time and every moment, wa-ʻalā ālihi ṭ-ṭayyibīna ṭ-ṭāhirīna wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi l-ʻālamīna and upon his family, the good and the pure; and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds; wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman tusallimunī bihi min āfāti d-dunyā wa-fitanihā wa-min ʻadhābi l-ākhirati and grant peace upon him and upon his family, with a peace through which You keep me safe from the afflictions of this world and its trials, and from the punishment of the Hereafter. innaka anta Allāhu l-maliku l-ḥaqqu s-salāmu Truly, You are Allah, the King, the Truth, the Peace. Allāhumma yā ḥayyu yā qayyūmu 103

O Allah, O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting, ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tabqā wa-tadūmu send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a blessing that remains and endures, alladhī jāʼa bi-l-Qurʼāni wa-l-ʻulūmi · abū z-Zahrāʼi wa-zaynaba waruqayyata wa-ummi kulthūmin the one who brought the Qur’an and the branches of knowledge, the father of al-Zahra (Fatima), Zaynab, Ruqayya and Umm Kulthum, ṣalātan bi-ʻadadi mā tuqillu l-jibālu wa-th-tharā wa-t-tukhūmu with a blessing by the number of all that the mountains, the soil and the boundaries bear, ṣalātan tujīrunā bihā min sharābi l-yaḥmūmi wa-l-ḥuzni wa-l-ghammi wa-lhumūmi with a blessing through which You protect us from the drink of the black smoke (Yahmum), and from sorrow, distress and worries, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ahli l-ʻilmi wa-l-fuhūmi and upon his family, the people of knowledge and understanding, and grant peace, 104

wa-anzil ʻalayhim saḥāʼiba r-raḥmati wa-l-barakati wa-r-riḍā fī kulli mashhadin maʻlūmin and send down upon them the clouds of mercy, grace and good pleasure in every known place of gathering. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tajʻalunī bihā mimmana ṣṭafaytahum li-kitābika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a blessing through which You make me one of those whom You have chosen for Your Book, wa-adkhaltahum fī zumrati aḥbābika · wa-aḥaṭtahum bi-t-tawfīqi wa-lʻināyati and whom You admitted into the company of Your beloved ones, and whom You enveloped with divine enabling and care, wa-yassarta lahumu l-khayra wa-l-hidāyata · fa-kānū laka dhākirīna and for whom You made goodness and guidance easy, so they were remembering You, 105

wa-liniʻamika shākirīna · wa-maʻa l-ḥujjāji mulabbīna wa-bibaytika l-ʻatīqi ṭāʼifīna and giving thanks for Your favours, and, with the pilgrims, calling out “Labbayk” and circling Your Ancient House, wa-ʻalā jabali ʻArafāti wāqifīna · wa-shakarūka fa-zidtahum min inʻāmika wa-dhakarūka fa-dhakartahum kamā atā fī kalāmika and standing upon Mount Arafat; they gave thanks to You, so You gave them more of Your favours, and they remembered You, so You remembered them, as it has come in Your Word; ṣalātan taḥfaẓunī bihā min sharri ʻadhābika wa-ntiqāmika · wa-ʻalā ālihi wasallim with a blessing through which You protect me from the evil of Your punishment and Your retribution, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī tuḥibbu man zārahu btighāʼa wajhika l-karīmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose visitor You love, whoever visits him seeking Your Noble Face, 106

wa-tamnaḥuhu l-ʻaṭfa wa-l-maghfirata wa-t-takrīma · wa-anta l-jawādu lladhī lā yabkhalu and You bestow upon that visitor tenderness, forgiveness and honour; and You are the Bountiful One who never withholds, wa-ṣ-ṣabūru lladhī lā yaʻjalu wa-r-raḥīmu lladhī yuʻṭī wa-yarḥamu the Patient One who does not hasten, and the Ever-Merciful who gives and shows mercy, wa-l-mujību lladhī bi-ilḥāḥi l-muliḥḥīna lā yatabarramu and the Responsive One who is never wearied by the persistence of those who implore; asʼaluka t-tawfīqa lladhī bihi li-kulli khayrin ataqaddamu I ask You for the divine enabling by which I advance toward every good, wa-l-ḥifẓa lladhī bihi min kulli sūʼin aslamu and the protection by which I am kept safe from every evil, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi man ṣallā ʻalayhi wa-athnā wa-sallama and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of those who have sent blessings upon him, praised him and offered him peace. 107

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin dalīli l-khayrāti wa-l-asrāri wamuhbiṭi l-barakāti wa-l-anwāri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the guide to good things and to secrets, and the place of descent of graces and lights, alladhī bi-maḥabbatihi saʻidati l-akhyāru · wa-binūrihi kullu taqiyyin istanāra through love of whom the virtuous attained happiness, and by whose light every God-fearing person was illumined, wa-ṣāra min ahli l-maʻrifati wa-l-iʻtibāri and became one of the people of gnosis and insight, alladhī nawwara Allāhu bi-nūrihi l-qulūba nūran yafūqu ʻalā sh-shumūsi wal-aqmāri the one by whose light Allah illumined the hearts with a light that surpasses the suns and the moons, alladhī man aḥabbahu najā wa-man ʻādāhu dakhala n-nāra he of whom it is true that whoever loves him is saved, and whoever is hostile to him enters the Fire, 108

wa-man ṣallā ʻalayhi saʻida wa-btaʻadat ʻanhu l-akdāru and whoever sends blessings upon him finds happiness, and troubles distance themselves from him, wa-ghafara Allāhu lahu dh-dhunūba l-awzāra and Allah forgives him his sins and burdens; wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi dawarāni kulli falakin dāra and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the turnings of every celestial sphere that has turned, wa-biʻadadi mā nazala min qaṭri l-amṭāri and by the number of the drops of rain that have fallen, wa-biʻadadi amwāji l-anhāri wa-l-biḥāri · wa-biʻadadi anfāsi l-khalīqati fī sāʼiri l-aqṭāri and by the number of the waves of the rivers and seas, and by the number of the breaths of creation in every region, ṣalātan anālu bihā riḍāka wa-riḍāhu yā ʻazīzu yā ghaffāru with a blessing through which I attain Your good pleasure and his good pleasure, O Almighty, O Ever-Forgiving. Allāhumma yā Allāhu yā ghafūru yā shakūru 109

O Allah, O Allah, O Most Forgiving, O Most Appreciative, ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin dhī l-ḥajji l-mabrūri wa-s-saʻyi l-mashkūri send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the possessor of the accepted pilgrimage and the appreciated striving, wa-l-jayshi l-manṣūri · wa-z-zuhdi fī dāri l-ghurūri and of the army granted victory, and of renunciation of the abode of delusion, alladhī man tabiʻahu nāla tijāratan lan tabūra he of whom it is true that whoever follows him gains a trade that will never fail, wa-dakhala l-jannata dhāta l-ḥūri wa-l-quṣūri and enters Paradise, with its houris and palaces, ṣalātan nastajlibu bihā r-riḍā wa-l-ḥubūra with a blessing through which we draw in good pleasure and delight, wa-l-faraḥa bi-llāhi wa-s-surūra · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā katabati laqlāmu ʻalā l-awrāqi wa-s-suṭūri and joy in Allah, and gladness, and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as the pens write on pages and lines, 110

wa-mā aṭmaʼannat bi-dhikri Allāhi l-qulūbu wa-ṣ-ṣudūru and for as long as hearts and breasts find tranquillity in the remembrance of Allah, ṣalātan nastaʻīdhu bihā bi-llāhi min ahli l-baghī wa-sh-shurūri with a blessing through which we seek refuge in Allah from the people of aggression and evils, wa-min kulli shayṭānin ʻaduwwin gharūrin and from every devil, an enemy and deceiver, mā stajāba li-llāhi kullu ʻabdin ṣabūrin for as long as every patient servant responds to Allah, wa-mā futiḥat abwābun li-ahli l-barri wa-l-burūri wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim milʼa l-ayyāmi wa-l-ashhuri wa-d-duhūri and for as long as doors are opened for the people of piety and righteousness; and upon his family, and grant peace, as much as would fill the days, the months and the ages, ṣalātan anālu bihā qurban ilayhi bi-lā ḥijābin wa-lā sutūrin with a blessing through which I attain nearness to him, without veil or curtains. 111

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī nabbaʼtahu qabla nnabiyyīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom You made a prophet before the Prophets, wa-arsaltahu ākhira l-mursalīna · fa-huwa l-awwalu fa-lā nabiyya qablahu and whom You sent as the last of the Messengers, for he is the first, so there is no prophet before him, wa-l-ākhiru fa-lā rasūla baʻdahu · alladhī man tawajjaha ilayka bihi qabiltahu and the last, so there is no messenger after him, he of whom it is true that whoever turns to You through him, You accept him, wa-man saʼalaka bihi aʻṭaytahu · wa-mani stanṣaraka bihi naṣartahu and whoever asks You through him, You give him, and whoever seeks Your help through him, You help him, wa-mani starḥamaka bihi raḥimtahu · fa-huwa raḥmatuka ilā jamīʻi khalqika ʻulwiyyihim wa-sufliyyihim and whoever asks You for mercy through him, You have mercy on him; for he is Your mercy to all Your creation, the upper and the lower of them, 112

wa-innī khalqun ḍaʻīfun min khalqika and I am a weak creature among Your creatures; atawajjahu bihi ilayka I turn to You through him, idh huwa nabiyyu raḥmatika wa-rasūlu ḥikmatika “yā sayyidī yā Muḥammadu yā rasūla Allāhi” (thalāthan) innī tawajjahtu bika ilā rabbī fī ḥawāʼijī jamīʻihā li-tuqḍā since he is the Prophet of Your mercy and the Messenger of Your wisdom. “O my master, O Muhammad, O Messenger of Allah” (three times): “Indeed, I have turned through you to my Lord for all my needs, that they may be fulfilled.” Allāhumma shaffiʻhu fiyya yā man lā yashfaʻu ʻindahu aḥadun illā bi-idhnihi O Allah, accept his intercession for me, O You with whom no one intercedes except by His permission. Allāhumma innī asʼaluka bi-ḥubbika lahu wa-biḥubbihi laka O Allah, I ask You, by Your love for him and his love for You, 113

an tuṣalliya ʻalayhi ṣalātan anālu bihā maḥabbata khalqika ajmaʻīna ʻulwihim wa-suflihim that You send blessings upon him, a blessing through which I gain the love of all Your creation, the upper and the lower of them, insihim wa-jinnihim · wa-alqi Allāhumma mawaddatī fī qulūbihim wamaḥabbatan minka ʻalayya humankind and jinn, and cast, O Allah, affection for me into their hearts, and a love from You upon me, ḥattā tanqāda lī kullu nafsin abiyyatin until every proud soul submits to me, yā man bi-yadihi kullu shayʼin wa-huwa ʻalā kulli shayʼin qadīrun O You in whose hand is everything, and who has power over all things. yā wāḥidun lā sharīka lahu O One, who has no partner, yā fardun lā nidda lahu O Sole One, who has no equal, 114

yā ṣamadun lā yuqṣadu siwāhu O Eternal Refuge, none other than Him is sought; asʼaluka bi-asmāʼika l-ḥusnā kullihā mā ʻalimtu minhā wa-mā lam aʻlam I ask You by all Your Most Beautiful Names, those of them that I know and those that I do not know, wa-bikalimātika t-tāmmāti kullihā l-mubārakāti · wa-bi-smika l-ʻaẓīmi laʻẓami l-makhzūni l-maknūni and by all Your perfect, grace-filled words, and by Your Great Name, the Greatest, the treasured and concealed, alladhī idhā duʻīta bihi ajabta wa-idhā suʼilta bihi aʻṭayta by which, when You are called upon, You answer, and when You are asked, You give, an tuṣalliya ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika wa-rasūlika that You send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, alladhī athnayta ʻalayhi fī waḥyika whom You praised in Your revelation, 115

wa-ʻallamtahu mā lam yakun yaʻlamu and whom You taught what he did not know, wa-tafaḍḍalta ʻalayhi fa-kāna afḍala khalqika and upon whom You bestowed bounty, so that he became the most excellent of Your creation, alladhī sharaḥta ṣadrahu · wa-yassarta amrahu whose breast You expanded, and whose affair You made easy, wa-rafaʻta dhikrahu · alladhī arsaltahu raḥmatan ʻāmmatan and whose mention You raised high, whom You sent as a universal mercy, wa-aʻṭaytahu sh-shafāʻata l-ʻuẓmā and to whom You gave the Greatest Intercession, wa-baʻathtahu l-maqāma l-maḥmūda Allāhumma sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman aslamu bihi min āfāti d-dunyā wa-fitanihā and whom You raised to the Praiseworthy Station. O Allah, grant peace upon him and upon his family, with a peace through which I am safe from the afflictions of this world and its trials, 116

wa-min shurūrihā wa-kadarihā · wa-aʻūdhu bika Allāhumma min makri lmākirīna and from its evils and its troubles; and I seek refuge in You, O Allah, from the scheming of the schemers, wa-siḥri s-sāḥirīna · wa-stahzāʼi l-mustahziʼīna · wa-sukhriyyati s-sākhirīna and the sorcery of the sorcerers, and the mockery of the mockers, and the ridicule of those who ridicule; wa-asʼaluka mina l-ʻilmi anfaʻahu · wa-mina r-rizqi awsaʻahu and I ask You for the most beneficial of knowledge, and the most ample of provision, wa-mina l-faḍli ajmaʻahu · wa-mina l-aṣḥābi akhlaṣahum and the most comprehensive of bounty, and, of companions, the most sincere, wa-mina z-zuwwāri akramahum · wa-jlib ilayya mā yasurrunī and, of visitors, the most honourable; and bring to me what pleases me, wa-ṣrif ʻannī mā yasūʼunī · yā man bi-yadihi maqālīdu l-umūri 117

and turn away from me what distresses me, O You in whose hand are the keys of all affairs, wa-huwa ʻalā kulli shayʼin qadīrun and who has power over all things. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika l-ʻazīzi lladhī ʻtazza bi-ʻizzatika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the mighty one, who is made mighty through Your might, wa-r-raʼūfu lladhī raʼafa bi-khalīqatika · wa-r-raḥīmu lladhī huwa raḥmatun min raḥmatika and the kind one who showed kindness to Your creation, and the merciful one who is a mercy from Your mercy, alladhī lawlāhu mā khalaqta l-amlāka he without whom You would not have created the angels, wa-lā jāʼa ḥajījun ilā Makkata wa-labbāka and no pilgrims would have come to Mecca and answered You with “Labbayk”, 118

wa-lā tajallayta ʻalā l-ḥajīji bi-ʻarafata fa-ghafarta lahum and You would not have disclosed Yourself to the pilgrims at Arafat and forgiven them, wa-lā qabilta minhum wa-lā qabiltahum and You would not have accepted from them, nor accepted them; fa-huwa n-nabiyyu l-maqbūlu lladhī bihi qubilat ummatuhu for he is the accepted Prophet through whom his community was accepted, wa-huwa n-nabiyyu sh-sharīfu lladhī bihi shurifat ummatuhu and he is the noble Prophet through whom his community was ennobled, wa-huwa afḍalu l-anbiyāʼi wa-l-mursalīna lladhī bihi fuḍḍilat ummatuhu and he is the most excellent of the Prophets and the Messengers, through whom his community was given excellence; fa-huwa sh-shafīʻu l-mushaffaʻu wa-jāhuhu lā shakka yanfaʻu for he is the intercessor whose intercession is accepted, and his exalted standing (with You) undoubtedly benefits, wa-anwāruhu talmaʻu · wa-liman zārahu yashfaʻu and his lights shine, and he intercedes for whoever visits him; 119

fa-huwa n-nāfiʻu mutābiʻatuhu tanfaʻu · wa-l-māniʻu lladhī riḍāhu ʻani n-nāri yamnaʻu for he is the one who benefits, and following him brings benefit, and the protector, whose good pleasure protects from the Fire. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī anwāruhu saṭaʻat O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose lights shone forth, wa-kalimātuhu nafaʻat wa-bihi n-nāsu ʻani sh-shirki ilā t-tawḥīdi rajaʻat and whose words benefited, and through whom the people turned back from polytheism to the affirmation of Allah’s Oneness, mā thāra ghubāru l-mujāhidīna wa-suyūfuhum fī l-jihādi lamaʻat for as long as the dust of those who strive rises and their swords flash in the struggle, wa-mā fariḥat jumūʻuhum wa-bi-llāhi ntaṣarat and for as long as their hosts rejoice and triumph through Allah, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan ilā l-ḥabībi l-maḥbūbi wa-ṣalat 120

and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing that reaches the Beloved, the Loved One, wa-ʻinda Allāhi l-karīmi qubilat · wa-jʻali Allāhumma l-muṣallīna ʻalayhi bihā dhunūbuhum ghufirat and is accepted with Allah, the Generous; and make, O Allah, those who send blessings upon him through it people whose sins are forgiven, wa-qulūbuhum wa-ashbāḥuhum min kulli sharrin ḥufiẓat whose hearts and bodies are protected from every evil, wa-sārat jumūʻuhum wa-ilā Ṭaybata wa-ṣalat whose throngs set out and reach Tayba (Medina), wa-ahdat ilā l-mukhtāri khayra salāmin ʻindamā ḥaḍarat and present to the Elect One the best greeting of peace when they come into his presence, wa-fāḥat ʻalayhim aʻṭāruhu wa-nasharat · wa-sālat dumūʻuhum mina shshawqi wa-qaṭarat · wa-muliʼat qulūbuhum bi-l-anwāri wa-ʻumirat and over whom his fragrances waft and spread, whose tears flow from longing and fall in drops, and whose hearts are filled with lights and made flourishing. 121

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī kāna yakrahu l-jidāla wa-l-mirā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who disliked disputation and wrangling, samḥun idhā bāʻa samḥun idhā shtarā lenient when he sold, lenient when he bought, khayru man yamshī ʻalā th-tharā · nabiyyu l-iḥsāni wa-l-qirā the best of those who walk upon the earth, the Prophet of beneficence and hospitality. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin raḥmati Allāhi l-mursalati ilā sāʼiri l-ʻawālimi l-ʻulwiyyati wa-s-sufliyyati wa-faraji Allāhi l-qarībi li-lmunkasirati qulūbuhum min ahli n-nufūsi l-marḍiyyati wa-raʼfati Allāhi liʻibādihi l-muʼminīna l-fāʼiqati li-raʼfati l-ummahāti ʻalā dh-dhurriyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the mercy of Allah sent to all the worlds, upper and lower, and the near relief of Allah for those whose hearts are broken, among the people of wellpleasing souls, and the compassion of Allah for His believing servants, surpassing the compassion of mothers for their offspring, 122

wa-baḥri ʻilmika l-mulqī li-anwāʻi ʻulūmika l-ladunniyyati wa-kanzi asrārika l-ghāliyyati l-khafiyyati and the ocean of Your knowledge, casting forth the kinds of Your knowledge imparted directly by You, and the treasure of Your precious, hidden secrets, al-mubayyinu li-ʻibādika āyāti kitābika l-qurʼāniyyati the one who makes clear to Your servants the Qur’anic verses of Your Book, sirāju l-qulūbi bi-anwāri ʻallāmi l-ghuyūbi the lamp of hearts through the lights of the Knower of the unseen, li-kulli ʻāshiqin wa-majdhūbin naṣru Allāhi wa-l-fatḥu li-ahli n-nufūsi lammārati the victory of Allah for every lover and every enraptured one, and the opening for the people of the evil-commanding souls, wa-ghāyatu l-ghāyāti li-ahli l-arwāḥi s-sayyārati and the ultimate goal of all goals for the people of the wayfaring spirits, 123

wa-khalīfatu Allāhi fī bayʻati Allāhi “inna lladhīna yubāyiʻūnaka innamā yubāyiʻūna Allāha” bābu Allāhi li-kulli ʻābidin mutaqarribin and the vicegerent of Allah in the pledge of allegiance to Allah, “Truly, those who pledge allegiance to you pledge allegiance only to Allah” (Qur’an 48:10), the door of Allah for every worshipper who draws near, wa-ḥablu wuddi Allāhi li-kulli mutawaddidin mutaḥabbibin and the cord of Allah’s loving affection for everyone who seeks affection and strives to be loved, sayfu Allāhi l-qāṭiʻu li-l-ʻawāʼiqi wa-l-mawāniʻi the sword of Allah that cuts through hindrances and obstacles, wa-barqu naṣrihi l-mubashshiru l-lāmiʻu and the lightning of His victory, heralding glad tidings and gleaming, sayyidunā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadun bnu ʻabdi Allāhi lladhī aḍāʼat bihi lḥawāliku wa-tanazzaha kamāluhu ʻani n-naẓīri wa-l-mushāriki our master and our patron, Muhammad, son of Abdullah, through whom the pitch-black darknesses were lit up, and whose perfection is exalted above any peer or partner, 124

man tanazzalat bihi raḥamātun mina Allāhi li-ummatihi turḍīhim wa-rufiʻa bihi l-ʻadhābu ʻanhum bi-sababi masāwīhim “wa-mā kāna Allāhu liyuʻadhdhibahum wa-anta fīhim” al-ḥaqqu l-mubīnu he through whom mercies from Allah came down upon his community, pleasing them, and through whom punishment was lifted from them because of their misdeeds, “Allah would never punish them while you are among them” (Qur’an 8:33), the manifest truth, wa-s-sayyidu l-amīnu “wa-mā arsalnāka illā raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna” qabḍatu nūrika lladhī kāna wa-lā nūra wa-lā akwāna and the Trustworthy Master, “We have sent you only as a mercy to the worlds” (Qur’an 21:107), the handful of Your light, which existed when there was no light and no created worlds; “wa-kuntu nabiyyan wa-Ādamu bayna r-rūḥi wa-l-jasadi” laqad bāna “I was a prophet while Adam was between the spirit and the body”: it has indeed become clear, alladhī tanḥallu bihi ʻuqadu l-kurūbi he through whom the knots of afflictions are untied, 125

wa-tughfaru bihi anwāʻu dh-dhunūbi wa-tuqḍā bi-jāhihi l-ḥawāʼiju min qāḍī l-ḥājāti wa-tukshafu l-humūmu wa-l-ghumūmu wa-l-maḍarrātu and through whom every kind of sin is forgiven, and through whose exalted standing (with Allah) needs are fulfilled by the Fulfiller of needs, and worries, distresses and harms are removed, alladhī man ʻarafahu fa-qad ʻarafa he of whom it is true that whoever knows him has truly come to know, wa-man lam yaʻrifhu faqadi nḥarafa and whoever does not know him has indeed deviated, al-amāni li-kulli muʼminin mina sh-shirki wa-t-talafi the security for every believer from polytheism and ruin, sāqiya arwāḥi l-muṣallīna ʻalayhi min raḥīqin makhtūmin the cupbearer of the spirits of those who send blessings upon him, giving them to drink from a sealed nectar, wa-murabbī arwāḥihim bi-naẓarihi l-ʻālī fa-l-muṣallī ʻalayhi bihi makrūmun 126

and the nurturer of their spirits with his lofty gaze; so the one who sends blessings upon him is honoured through him, saʻdu Allāhi wa-s-saʻādatu l-abadiyyatu wa-khayru Allāhi li-ahli n-nufūsi zzakiyyati the good fortune of Allah, and everlasting happiness, and the goodness of Allah, for the people of pure souls. ṣallā Allāhu ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna May Allah bless him and his family, and grant them all peace, ṣalātan taftaḥu lanā bihā abwāba raḥmatika yā arḥama r-rāḥimīna with a blessing through which You open for us the doors of Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. 127

Wird Yawm ath-Thalāthāʼ Tuesday J U M P T O P R AY E R 1–10 11–20 21–30 31–40 41–44 O P E N I N G · R E C I T E D E A C H D AY al-ḥamdu li-llāhi wa-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʻalā sayyidinā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadin rasūli Allāhi wa-ʻalā ālihi fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi All praise is for Allah, and blessings and peace be upon our master and patron Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, and upon his family, in every glance and every breath, by the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses, wa-raḍiya Allāhu ʻan shaykhaynā sayyidī Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi and may Allah be pleased with our two shaykhs: my master Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, wa-sayyidī ʻabdi l-ghaniyyi Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi wa-arḍāhumā and my master ʻAbd al-Ghanī Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, and may He make them well pleased, 128

wa-jaʻala l-jannata mutaqallabahumā wa-mathwāhumā and make Paradise their resort and their abode. wa-nfaʻnā Allāhumma bi-jāhihimā ʻindaka yā Allāhu And benefit us, O Allah, through their standing with You, O Allah. Allāhumma innī uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday kulli nafasin walamḥatin wa-ṭarfatin yaṭrifu bihā ahlu s-samāwāti wa-ahlu l-arḍi wakulli shayʼin huwa fī ʻilmika kāʼinun aw qad kāna uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday dhālika kullihi O Allah, I offer to You, in the presence of every breath, every glance and every blink with which the people of the heavens and the people of the earth blink, and of everything that is in Your knowledge, whether it is yet to be or has already come to be — I offer to You, in the presence of all of that, [the prayers that follow]. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-badri s-sārī fī samāʼi larwāḥi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the full moon that journeys through the sky of spirits, 129

li-tashhada bihi jalāla l-fattāḥi · fa-tanqabiḍa bi-sarayānihi so that the spirit may witness through him the majesty of the Opener, and contract at his coursing, wa-tanbasiṭa bi-lamʻānihi · fa-yakhruju min bayni qabḍin wa-basṭin shuhūdu ḥaqqin and expand at his gleaming, and from between contraction and expansion there comes forth a witnessing of Truth, bihi takshifu r-rūḥu ʻan ḥaqāʼiqi kunhi baʻḍi sirri sarayānihi fa-tansāqu bihi ilā shuhūdin yastaghriqu jamīʻahā ḥattā tafnā fīhi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim through which the spirit lifts the veil from the realities of the very essence of part of the secret of his coursing, and is led through it to a witnessing that engulfs the whole of the spirit, until it is annihilated in it; and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fātiḥi aqfāli asrāri manāfiʻi ʻawālimi Allāhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the opener of the locks on the secrets of the benefits of Allah’s worlds, 130

bi-taʼyīdi anwāri “inna lladhīna yubāyiʻūnaka innamā yubāyiʻūna Allāha” wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim through the support of the lights of “Truly, those who pledge allegiance to you pledge allegiance only to Allah” (Qur’an 48:10); and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kanzi l-maʻārifa l-khafiyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the treasure of the hidden knowledge of Allah, wa-l-ʻulūmi l-ghaybiyyati l-munazzalati min ladun rabbi l-bariyyati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and of the knowledge of the unseen, sent down directly from the Lord of all creation, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khulāṣati l-ʻarabi s-sādati lakhyāri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the quintessence of the Arabs, the masters, the virtuous, 131

wa-khayri man aḍāʼa bihi l-laylu wa-ashraqa ʻalayhi n-nahāru · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and the best of those by whom the night was lit and upon whom the day shone forth, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī raʼā rabbahu wa-mā raʼāhu siwāhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who saw his Lord, and none but he saw Him, wa-samiʻa min qawlihi wa-akrama mathwāhu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and heard some of His words, and He honoured his abode, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin zīnati l-jannati wa-mā fīhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the adornment of Paradise and all that is in it, wa-muqassimi naʻīmihā li-sākinīhā wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and the apportioner of its bliss to those who dwell in it; and upon his family, and grant peace. 132

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī yuzālu kullu karbin bidaʻwatihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, through whose supplication every affliction is removed, wa-yashulu kullu ṣaʻbin bi-barakatihi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and through whose grace every hardship becomes easy, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ḥabībi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet, the Beloved, an-nabiyyi ṭ-ṭabībi · an-nabiyyi l-maḥbūbi · an-nabiyyi ẓ-ẓāhiri the Prophet, the Physician, the Prophet, the Loved One, the Prophet, the Manifest, at-taqī ṭ-ṭāhiri · al-ḥāmidi sh-shākiri · al-ʻābidi dh-dhākiri the God-fearing, the pure, the one who praises, the one who gives thanks, the worshipper, the one who remembers Allah, imāmi l-ḥaẓāʼiri · dalīli l-ḥāʼiri · nabiyyi l-bashāʼiri the leader of the enclosures, the guide of the perplexed, the Prophet of glad tidings, 133

raḥmati l-qādiri · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim taslīman the mercy of the All-Powerful, and upon his family, and grant peace, a peace naslamu bihi wa-ahlīnā dunyā wa-dīnan through which we are kept safe, we and our families, in this world and in our religion. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṭibbi l-qulūbi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the healer of hearts, wa-miftāḥi l-ghuyūbi · wa-mufarriji l-kurūbi · wa-ghāyati l-maṭlūbi and the key to the unseen, and the reliever of afflictions, and the ultimate goal of all that is sought, wa-nūri ẓ-ẓalāmi · wa-khayri l-anāmi · wa-nabiyyi l-ikrāmi and the light in the darkness, and the best of humankind, and the Prophet of honour, ʻālī l-maqāmi · wa-ʻalā ālihi l-kirāmi · afḍala ṣalātin wa-ajalla salāmin of lofty station, and upon his noble family, with the most excellent blessing and the most exalted peace. 134

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan bi-l-layli wa-n-nahāri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by night and by day, wa-ẓ-ẓahīrati wa-l-asḥāri wa-l-ghuduwwi wa-l-āṣāli · bi-ʻadadi taghrīdi laṭyāri and at midday, in the pre-dawn hours, in the morning and in the evening, by the number of the warbling of the birds, wa-ʻadadi qaṭri l-amṭāri · wa-ʻadadi jawalāni l-arwāḥi wa-l-afkāri and the number of the raindrops, and the number of the wanderings of spirits and thoughts, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ʻāfinā mina l-awhāmi wa-l-aghyāri and upon his family, and grant peace; and keep us safe from delusions and from all that is other [than Allah]. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī yaʻrifuhu l-waḥshu fī qafrihi 135

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom the wild beast knows in its wasteland, wa-ṭ-ṭāʼiru fī wakrihi · wa-l-ḥūtu fī baḥrihi and the bird in its nest, and the fish in its sea, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ʻadada iḥsāni Allāhi wa-birrihi and upon his family, and grant peace, the number of Allah’s beneficence and kindness. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī huwa raḥmatu lumami wa-raḥīmuhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who is the mercy of the nations and merciful toward them, ṣalātan yafūḥu ʻiṭruhā wa-nasīmuhā · wa-yaʻummu khayruhā wa-naʻīmuhā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim with a blessing whose perfume and breeze waft abroad, and whose goodness and bliss extend to all, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan taʻūdu ʻalaynā bi-lkhayrāti wa-l-barakāti fī l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāti 136

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that returns to us with good things and graces, in life and in death, wa-ʻalā ālihi bi-ʻadadi l-ḥarakāti wa-s-sakanāti and upon his family, by the number of movements and stillnesses. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi ṣ-ṣādiqi ṣ-ṣadūqi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet, the unlettered, the truthful, the ever-truthful, mā aṭraba ḥādin ilā ṭarīqihi l-ʻīsa wa-n-nūqa for as long as a camel-driver thrills the pale camels and the shecamels as they head toward his road, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-rzuqnā Allāhumma bika ghāyata l-wuthūqi and upon his family, and grant peace; and grant us, O Allah, the utmost trust in You. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan takhḍarru bihā lghabrāʼu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which the dusty earth turns green, 137

wa-tatazayyanu bihā r-rawḍatu l-fayḥāʼu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ʻadada ḥarakāti n-nujūmi wa-l-anwāʼi and the spacious meadow is adorned, and upon his family, and grant peace, the number of the movements of the stars and the rain-bringing constellations. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tamlaʼu l-qulūba ḥubban O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that fills hearts with love, wa-yuṣabbu bihā l-khayru ʻalā qāʼilihā ṣabban and through which goodness is poured out in torrents upon the one who says it, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · wa-qarrabnā Allāhumma ilayhi qurban and upon his family, and grant peace; and bring us near to him, O Allah, in true nearness. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yafraḥu bihā l-qalbu lḥazīnu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which the sorrowful heart rejoices, 138

wa-yufakku bihā l-ʻaqlu r-rahīnu · wa-yarḥamunā bihā arḥamu r-rāḥimīna and through which the captive mind is set free, and through which the Most Merciful of the merciful has mercy on us, fī kulli waqtin wa-ḥīnin · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ʻalā ʻibādi Allāhi ṣṣāliḥīna at every hour and every moment, and upon his family, and grant peace, and upon the righteous servants of Allah. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sayyidi n-nāsi ajmaʻi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the master of all people together, alladhī li-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi laylata l-jumʻati yasmaʻu who hears the blessings invoked upon him on the night of Friday, wa-aʻli Allāhumma bunyānahu wa-rfaʻ · ṣalātan bihā ʻannā kullu ʻaduwwin yumnaʻu and exalt his edifice, O Allah, and raise it high, with a blessing through which every enemy is held back from us, 139

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā faṭara Allāhu khalqan wa-abdaʻa and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as Allah brings a creature into being and originates it. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā anbatati l-ashjāru awrāqan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, for as long as the trees put forth leaves, wa-ḥarrakati l-aʻyunu aḥdāqan · wa-aẓharati l-qulūbu ilayhi ashwāqan · waʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and eyes move their pupils, and hearts show yearnings toward him, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin akhṭabi l-khuṭabāʼi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the most eloquent of orators, wa-akrami l-kuramāʼi wa-khātami r-rusuli wa-l-anbiyāʼi and the most generous of the generous, and the seal of the Messengers and the Prophets, wa-khayri man yamshī ʻalā l-arḍi taḥta qubbati s-samāʼi 140

and the best of those who walk upon the earth beneath the dome of the sky, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan tadfaʻu bihā ʻannā l-balāʼa wa-l-wabāʼa wa-lʻanāʼa and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing through which You ward off from us affliction, pestilence and hardship. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yuḥibbuhā wa-yarḍāhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that he loves and is pleased with, wa-zakki bihā nafsan anta khayru man zakkāhā and purify through it a soul; You are the best of those who purify it; anta wa-liyyuhā wa-mawlāhā · wa-ʻalā ālihi mā ṭāfa bi-l-Kaʻbati ṭāʼifun waraʼāhā You are its Guardian and its Patron; and upon his family, for as long as anyone circles the Kaʻba and sees it. 141

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tushriqu bi-s-surūri layālīhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing whose nights shine with joy, wa-tuṣallī l-malāʼikatu ʻalā muṣallīhā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-qadri ddunyā wa-mā fīhā and the angels invoke blessings upon the one who offers it, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the measure of this world and all that is in it. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā athārati r-riyāḥu saḥāban O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, for as long as the winds raise up clouds, wa-sāqat ilayhi l-ashwāqu aḥbāban · fa-shāhadū qubbatahu l-khaḍrāʼa and longings drive lovers to him, so that they behold his green dome, wa-qad akhadhahum mina sh-shawqi l-bukāʼu 142

while weeping born of longing has seized them, fa-hanīʼan wa-ḥaqqa l-hanāʼu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim so may joy be theirs, and joy is truly their due, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalāta ʻabdin aḥabbahu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with the blessing of a servant who loves him, wa-tamannā mina Allāhi qurbahu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and who longs for nearness to him from Allah, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tamlaʼu l-āfāqa O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that fills the horizons, wa-takhtariqu s-sabʻa ṭ-ṭibāqa · siʻata raḥmati r-raḥīmi l-khallāqi and pierces through the seven tiers [of heaven], as vast as the mercy of the Ever-Merciful, the All-Creating. 143

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalāta ʻabdin bākī wa-min taqṣīrihi shākī · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with the blessing of a servant who weeps and complains of his shortcomings, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalāta ʻabdin dhalīlin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with the blessing of a lowly servant, wa-mā lahu siwā l-jalīli · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ḥfaẓnā min kulli qālin wa-qīlin who has none but the Majestic One, and upon his family, and grant peace; and protect us from all idle talk and hearsay. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalāta ʻabdin ḍāʼiqin yarjū khayra l-khalāʼiqi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with the blessing of a servant in distress who places his hope in the best of creation, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi l-anfāsi wa-d-daqāʼiqi 144

and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of breaths and minutes. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalāta ʻabdin nādāhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with the blessing of a servant who has called out to him, yarjūhu li-dhanbihi wa-hawāhu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim hoping in him on account of his sin and his vain desire, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan bi-thiqali l-jibāli rrawāsī O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing as heavy as the firmly rooted mountains, yalīnu lahā l-qalbu l-qāsī · mina l-jinnati wa-n-nāsi before which the hard heart softens, among jinn and humankind, wa-nuḥfaẓu bihā mina l-iflāsi · fī sāʼiri l-anfāsi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and through which we are protected from destitution, in every breath, and upon his family, and grant peace. 145

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī naʻatahu Allāhu fī kutubi l-awwalīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom Allah described in the scriptures of the earlier peoples, wa-arsalahu raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna · wa-shāfiʻan li-l-mudhnibīna and whom He sent as a mercy to the worlds, and as an intercessor for sinners, wa-hādiyan ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīmin · ṣirāṭi Allāhi and as a guide to a straight path, the path of Allah, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · ʻadada makhlūqāti Allāhi and upon his family, and grant peace, the number of Allah’s creatures. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tuzakkī qāʼilahā ḥattā yanāla murādahu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that purifies the one who says it until he attains what he desires, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ʻalā dhurriyyatihi wa-aḥfādihi 146

and upon his family, and grant peace, and upon his descendants and his grandchildren. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī fāqa l-qamara nūran O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who outshone the moon in light, wa-malaʼa l-qulūba surūran · wa-malaʼa d-dunyā ʻamalan mabrūran and filled hearts with joy, and filled this world with righteous deeds, wa-ḥamdan wa-shukūran · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and with praise and gratitude, and upon his family, and grant peace; wa-hab lanā raghbatan wa-ḥajjatan wa-ṭāʻatan wa-nūran and grant us earnest desire, a pilgrimage, obedience and light. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ttakhadha Allāhu min ummatihi shuhadāʼa wa-naṣarahum fī l-arḍi wa-aʻlā qadrahum fī s-samāʼi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, from whose community Allah took martyrs, granted them victory on the earth and raised their rank in the heavens, 147

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-rḍa Allāhumma ʻani l-ʻābidīna wa-l-awliyāʼi and upon his family, and grant peace; and be pleased, O Allah, with the worshippers and the friends of Allah. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā zāra zāʼirun al-baqīʻa waqāla s-salāmu ʻalayki yā Fāṭimatu z-Zahrāʼa O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, as often as a visitor visits al-Baqiʻ and says, “Peace be upon you, O Fatima alZahra,” fa-ẓaharat lahu barakātuhā wa-raḍiya ʻanhu rabbu l-arḍi wa-s-samāʼi and so her graces become manifest to him, and the Lord of the earth and the heavens is pleased with him. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan ushāhiduhu bihā bi-lā ḥijābin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which I behold him without a veil, wa-lā shakkin wa-lā rtiyābin · wa-ftaḥ lanā bi-sirrihā li-l-khayri kulla bābin 148

and without doubt or misgiving, and open for us, through its secret, every door to goodness, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-adim dhālika bi-lā ʻaddin wa-lā ḥisābin and upon his family, and grant peace; and make that endure without count or reckoning. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan taḥfaẓu bihā abṣāranā wa-asmāʻanā wa-jawāriḥanā wa-qulūbanā min kulli balāʼin wa-naṣabin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which You protect our sight, our hearing, our limbs and our hearts from every affliction and weariness, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi man waʻaẓa wa-khaṭaba and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all who have exhorted and delivered sermons. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin aḥsani n-nāsi qirāʼatan waṣawtan · wa-afḍalihim ḥayātan wa-mawtan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the finest of people in recitation and voice, and the most excellent of them in life and in death. 149

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā anbatati l-arḍu nabātan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, for as long as the earth brings forth plants, wa-ḥamala l-huwāʼu aṣwātan · wa-qaddara Allāhu li-khalqihi aqwātan · ʻadada l-khalāʼiqi aḥyāʼan wa-amwātan and the air carries sounds, and Allah apportions sustenance for His creation, the number of creatures, living and dead. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan lā tatruku li-l-muṣallī ʻalayhi bihā dhanban O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that leaves no sin remaining for the one who sends blessings upon him through it, wa-qarribnā Allāhumma ilayka bihā qurban and bring us near to You through it, O Allah, in true nearness, ṣalātan takūnu lanā dhakhīratan wa-ṭibban a blessing that will be for us a treasure laid up and a remedy, 150

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim taslīman nazdādu bihi hidāyatan wa-ḥubban and upon his family, and grant peace, a peace through which we increase in guidance and love. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-hudā wa-l-yasāri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of guidance and prosperity, ʻadada qaṭri l-amṭāri · wa-ʻadada ḥarakati l-aqmāri the number of the raindrops, and the number of the movements of the moons, wa-ʻadada waraqi l-ashjāri · wa-ʻadada dawābbi l-biḥāri and the number of the leaves of the trees, and the number of the creatures of the seas, wa-ʻadada ramli ṣ-ṣaḥārī wa-l-qifāri · wa-ʻadada amwāji l-biḥāri · wa-ʻadada taʻāqubi l-layli wa-n-nahāri and the number of the grains of sand of the deserts and wastelands, and the number of the waves of the seas, and the number of the successions of night and day. Allāhumma l-ṭuf bī bi-ʻadadi dharrāti l-wujūdi O Allah, show me gentle kindness by the number of the atoms of existence, 151

ʻinda kulli qiyāmin wa-quʻūdin · wa-hubūṭin wa-ṣuʻūdin at every standing and sitting, and every descent and ascent, fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin · wa-ṭarfatin wa-ḥarakatin in every glance and breath, and every blink and movement, wa-qawlin wa-fiʻlin · yā man aẓhara luṭfahu fa-njalat bihi ẓ-ẓulumātu and every word and deed. O You who manifested Your gentle kindness, so that the darknesses were dispelled through it, wa-akhfā luṭfahu fa-kushifat bihi l-baliyyātu yā ẓāhira l-luṭfi fa-lā khifāʼa liluṭfihi ẓ-ẓāhiri and hid Your gentle kindness, so that afflictions were lifted through it; O You whose gentle kindness is manifest, so that there is no concealing of Your manifest kindness, wa-yā khafiyya l-luṭfi fa-lā idrāka li-luṭfihi l-khafiyyi and O You whose gentle kindness is hidden, so that there is no grasping of Your hidden kindness, 152

asʼaluka Allāhumma luṭfaka ẓ-ẓāhira wa-l-khafiyya lladhī yajʻalunī minka fī ʻiyādhin manīʻin wa-ḥirzin ḥaṣīnin min jamīʻi khalqika yā man qāla waqawluhu l-ḥaqqu : “Allāhu laṭīfun bi-ʻibādihi” Allāhumma innī asʼaluka yā laṭīfu an tuṣalliya wa-tusallima ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wanabiyyika wa-rasūlika ṣalātan tudkhilunā bihā fī khafiyyi luṭfika l-khafiyyi yā man sabaqa luṭfuhu sawābiqa l-ḥawādithi I ask You, O Allah, for Your gentle kindness, manifest and hidden, which places me, from You, in an impregnable refuge and a fortified stronghold from all Your creation. O You who said—and Your word is the truth—“Allah is Gentle with His servants” (Qur’an 42:19); O Allah, I ask You, O Subtle, Gentle One, to send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, with a blessing that admits us into the hidden depths of Your hidden gentle kindness. O You whose gentle kindness preceded the earliest of events, wa-aḥāṭa ʻilmuhu bi-kulli qadīmin wa-ḥādithin · wa-huwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīri and whose knowledge encompassed everything ancient and everything newly arisen, and He is the Subtle, Gentle One, the AllAware. 153

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin shafīʻi l-khalāʼiqi yawma lkurbi l-ʻaẓīmi wa-ʻalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin mishkāti l-qulūbi wasirājuhā l-munīri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the intercessor for creation on the Day of Great Distress, and upon the family of our master Muhammad, [who is] the niche of hearts and their radiant lamp, wa-fātiḥu l-khayru l-bashīru n-nadhīru · an-nabiyyu l-ʻazīzu bi-l-muʼminīna raʼūfun raḥīmun and the opener of goodness, the bearer of glad tidings and warner, the mighty Prophet, kind and merciful to the believers, khitāmu l-anbiyāʼi wa-l-mursalīna · wa-raḥmatu Allāhi li-l-ʻālamīna the seal of the Prophets and the Messengers, and the mercy of Allah to the worlds, Madīnatu l-ʻulūmi z-zākhirati l-bahiyyati · wa-manbaʻu l-ḥikami n-nāfiʻati nnubuwiyyati the city of overflowing, resplendent knowledge, and the wellspring of beneficial prophetic wisdom, 154

al-makhṣūṣi bi-l-khuluqi l-ʻaẓīmi wa-afḍalu khalqi Allāhi the one distinguished with a sublime character and the most excellent of Allah’s creation, wa-l-mukhāṭabu bi-qawli Allāhi l-karīmi “inna lladhīna yubāyiʻūnaka innamā yubāyiʻūna Allāha” lladhī bihi yaḥṣulu mina Allāhi l-faraju wa-lifrāju and the one addressed by the words of Allah, the Generous, “Truly, those who pledge allegiance to you pledge allegiance only to Allah” (Qur’an 48:10), through whom relief and deliverance are obtained from Allah, wa-l-iṣbāḥu wa-l-iblāju · wa-l-yasāru wa-t-taysīru wa-n-namāʼu wa-t-taskhīru and the arrival of morning and the breaking of dawn, and prosperity and ease, growth and the subjection [of all things], wa-ʻalaynā bihi l-khayrātu mutakāthiratun wa-aghithnī Allāhumma bi-jāhihi yā ghiyātha l-mustaghīthīna bi-farajika lladhī huwa ka-lamḥi l-baṣari aw huwa aqrabu and upon us, through him, good things in ever-multiplying abundance; and come to my aid, O Allah, by his exalted standing with You, O Succour of those who cry out for help, with Your relief that is like the twinkling of an eye, or nearer; 155

wa-lā takilnī ilā nafsī wa-lā ilā aḥadin min khalqika ṭarfata ʻaynin wa-lā aqalla min dhālika wa-sallimi Allāhumma ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin waʻalā ālihi salāman aslamu bihi min humūmi d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirati yā Allāhu yā laṭīfu yā khabīru and do not leave me to myself, nor to anyone of Your creation, for the blink of an eye or less than that; and grant peace, O Allah, upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, a peace by which I am safe from the worries of this world and the Hereafter, O Allah, O Subtle, Gentle One, O All-Aware. Allāhumma yā man qabila min Ādama ʻalayhi s-salāmu l-kalimāti wa-tāba ʻalayhi wa-hadā O Allah, O You who accepted the words from Adam, peace be upon him, and turned to him in mercy and guided him, 156

wa-yā man ajāba daʻwata Nūḥin ʻalayhi s-salāmu wa-anjāhu wa-man maʻahu fī l-fulki l-mashḥūna wa-yā man rafaʻa Idrīsa ʻalayhi s-salāmu makānan ʻaliyyan wa-yā man jaʻala n-nāra ʻalā Ibrāhīma ʻalayhi s-salāmu bardan wa-salāman wa-yā man fadā Ismāʻīla ʻalayhi s-salāmu bi-dhibḥin ʻaẓīmin wa-yā man jaʻala li-Mūsā wa-Hārūna ʻalayhimā s-salāmu ṭarīqan fī lbaḥri yabasan wa-yā man ajāba Yūnusa ʻalayhi s-salāmu fī ẓulumātin thalāthin wa-najjāhu mina l-ghammi wa-yā man ajāba Ayyūba ʻalayhi ssalāmu fa-kashafa ʻanhu ḍurrahu wa-yā man alāna l-ḥadīda li-Dāwuda ʻalayhi s-salāmu wa-yā man sakhkhara li-Sulaymāna ʻalayhi s-salāmu l-insa wa-l-jinna wa-ʻallamahu manṭiqa ṭ-ṭayri wa-ātāhu min kulli shayʼin wa-yā man samiʻa duʻāʼa Zakariyyā ʻalayhi s-salāmu l-khafiyya wa-aṣlaḥa lahu zawjahu wa-wahabahu Yaḥyā ʻalayhi s-salāmu wa-yā man radda Yūsufa ʻalā Yaʻqūba ʻalayhi s-salāmu wa-afraḥahu baʻda ḥuznihi wa-yā man akhraja Yūsufa ʻalayhi s-salāmu mina s-sijni wa-makkana lahu fī l-arḍi wa-ātāhu ḥukman wa-ʻilman wa-yā man anjā ʻĪsā ʻalayhi s-salāmu wa-rafaʻahu ilayhi wa-yā man ātā luqmāna ʻalayhi s-salāmu l-ḥikmata wa-yā man ʻallama ʻabdahu l-khaḍira ʻalayhi s-salāmu min ladunhu ʻilman wa-yā man wahaba li-Ibrāhīma Isḥāqa and O You who answered the supplication of Noah, peace be upon him, and saved him and those with him in the laden ark; and O You who raised Idris, peace be upon him, to a lofty place; and O You who made the fire cool and safe for Abraham, peace be upon him; and O You who ransomed Ishmael, peace be upon him, with a great sacrifice; and O You who made for Moses and Aaron, peace be upon them both, a dry path through the sea; and O You who answered Jonah, peace be upon him, in the three darknesses and saved him from distress; and O You who answered Job, peace be upon him, and removed his affliction from him; and O You who softened iron for David, peace be upon him; and O You who subjected humankind and jinn to Solomon, peace be upon him, and taught him the speech of the birds and gave him of everything; and O You who heard the hidden supplication of Zechariah, peace be upon him, and set right his wife for him and granted him John, peace be upon him; and O You who restored Joseph to Jacob, peace be upon him, and gladdened him after his grief; and O You who brought Joseph, peace be upon him, out of prison and established him in the land and gave him judgement and knowledge; and O You who 158

saved Jesus, peace be upon him, and raised him up to Yourself; and O You who gave Luqman, peace be upon him, wisdom; and O You who taught Your servant al-Khidr, peace be upon him, knowledge from Yourself; and O You who bestowed Isaac upon Abraham, min warāʼi Isḥāqa Yaʻqūba ʻalayhi s-salāmu wa-yā man rafaʻa dhikra ʻabdihi sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣallā Allāhu ʻalayhi wa-ālihi wa-sallama and after Isaac, Jacob, peace be upon him; and O You who raised up the renown of Your servant, our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, wa-jaʻalahu khātama n-nabiyyīna wa-arsalahu raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna and made him the seal of the Prophets and sent him as a mercy to the worlds, wa-bāraka ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ahli baytihi wa-sharrafa ummatahu wa-jaʻalahum khayra ummatin ukhrijat li-n-nāsi and granted grace to him and to the People of his House, and ennobled his community and made them the best community brought forth for humankind, asʼaluka Allāhumma an tuṣalliya ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-an tajʻala lī min ladunka farajan qarīban I ask You, O Allah, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, and to grant me, from Yourself, a relief that is near. 159

yā mufarriju yā wa-hhābu · hab lī min ladunka raḥmatan wa-khayran wabirran wa-yusran yā arḥama r-rāḥimīna O Reliever, O Bestower, grant me, from Yourself, mercy, goodness, kindness and ease, O Most Merciful of the merciful. 160

Wird Yawm al-Arbiʻāʼ Wednesday J U M P T O P R AY E R 1–10 11–20 21–30 31–40 41–50 51–56 O P E N I N G · R E C I T E D E A C H D AY al-ḥamdu li-llāhi wa-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʻalā sayyidinā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadin rasūli Allāhi wa-ʻalā ālihi fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi All praise is for Allah, and blessings and peace be upon our master and patron Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, and upon his family, in every glance and every breath, by the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses, wa-raḍiya Allāhu ʻan shaykhaynā sayyidī Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi and may Allah be pleased with our two shaykhs: my master Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, wa-sayyidī ʻabdi l-ghaniyyi Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi wa-arḍāhumā and my master ʻAbd al-Ghanī Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, and may He make them well pleased, 161

wa-jaʻala l-jannata mutaqallabahumā wa-mathwāhumā and make Paradise their resort and their abode. wa-nfaʻnā Allāhumma bi-jāhihimā ʻindaka yā Allāhu And benefit us, O Allah, through their standing with You, O Allah. Allāhumma innī uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday kulli nafasin walamḥatin wa-ṭarfatin yaṭrifu bihā ahlu s-samāwāti wa-ahlu l-arḍi wakulli shayʼin huwa fī ʻilmika kāʼinun aw qad kāna uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday dhālika kullihi O Allah, I offer to You, in the presence of every breath, every glance and every blink with which the people of the heavens and the people of the earth blink, and of everything that is in Your knowledge, whether it is yet to be or has already come to be — I offer to You, in the presence of all of that, [the prayers that follow]. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-ḥabībi lladhī alqayta ʻalayhi maḥabbataka fa-aḥabbathu l-ʻawālimu 162

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Beloved, upon whom You cast Your love, so that the worlds loved him. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin saʻdi s-suʻūdi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the felicity of felicities, wa-nūri l-wujūdi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and the light of existence, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalāta ʻabdin qabilta ṣalātahu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with the blessing of a servant whose blessing You have accepted, wa-bārakta ḥayātahu · wa-katabta najātahu · wa-shaghalta ʻanhu ʻudātahu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and to whose life You have granted grace, and whose deliverance You have decreed, and whose enemies You have kept occupied away from him, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī kallamathu l-ghazālatu bi-ḥālihā 163

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, to whom the gazelle spoke of her plight, wa-hiya mawthūqatun bi-ḥabālihā · fa-dhahabat āmanatan ilā ʻiyālihā · waʻalā ālihi wa-sallim while she was bound in her ropes, so that she went away, safe, to her young ones, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan takūnu lahu jazāʼan wāfiyan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that will be for him a full recompense, wa-ʻizzan sāmiyan lā tatruku makānan khāliyan · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and lofty honour, one that leaves no place empty, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tarfaʻu shaʼna lmuṣallīna wa-turḍī rabba l-ʻālamīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that raises the standing of those who send blessings and pleases the Lord of the worlds, 164

wa-tufriḥu n-nabiyya ṣ-ṣādiqa l-amīna · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and gladdens the Prophet, the Truthful, the Trustworthy, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alfa alfa ṣalātin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a thousand thousand blessings, wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alfa alfa salāmin and grant peace upon our master Muhammad, a thousand thousand greetings of peace, wa-ʻalā ālihi ʻalā marri l-layālī wa-l-ayyāmi and upon his family, through the passing of the nights and days. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī kāna idhā takallama yasbiquhu n-nūru wa-yatahallalu wajhuhu bi-l-faraḥi wa-s-surūri · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who, whenever he spoke, was preceded by light, and whose face would beam with gladness and joy, and upon his family, and grant peace. 165

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi t-tawbati l-maqbūlati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of accepted repentance, wa-l-ummati l-marḥūmati · wa-n-nubuwwati l-maʻlūmati · wa-r-risālati lʻāmmati l-mashhūrati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim taslīman and of the community shown mercy, and of the well-known prophethood, and of the universal, renowned Message, and upon his family, and grant peace in full measure. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī jāʼa bi-s-salāmi wa-lamni · wa-n-najāti mina l-ʻayni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who came with peace and security, and deliverance from the evil eye. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣāḥibi l-faraji O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the master of relief, wa-khayri man usriya bihi wa-man ʻaraja · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna 166

and the best of those who were taken by night and those who ascended, and upon his family, and grant peace to them all. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī khāṭabahu ḍ-ḍabbu was-sirḥānu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, to whom the lizard and the wolf spoke, wa-mashat ilayhi l-ashjāru bi-l-aghṣānu · ṣāḥibi abī bakrin wa-ʻUmara waʻAliyyin wa-ʻUthmāna and to whom the trees walked with their branches, the companion of Abu Bakr, Umar, Ali and Uthman. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika wa-ṣafiyyika min khalqika wa-raḥmatika li-l-ʻālamīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, Your chosen one from among Your creation and Your mercy to the worlds, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-azwājihi wa-dhurriyyatihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna and upon his family, and his wives, and his descendants, and grant peace, all of them. 167

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin raḥmati Allāhi li-l-ʻālamīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the mercy of Allah to the worlds, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna · wa-aghithnī Allāhumma bi-jāhihi yā mughīthu yā muʻīnu and upon his family, and grant peace to them all; and come to my aid, O Allah, by his exalted standing with You, O Rescuer, O Helper. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī sakana ḥubbuhu qulūba l-muʼminīna fa-ṣaluḥat ashbāḥuhum wa-kharajat fī sabīli Allāhi suyūfuhum wa-rimāḥuhum O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose love has settled in the hearts of the believers, so that their bodies became righteous and their swords and spears went forth in the way of Allah, wa-nashaṭat ilā l-jannati qulūbuhum wa-arwāḥuhum and their hearts and spirits stirred with eagerness toward Paradise. 168

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nūri lladhī sarā fī l-arwāḥi fa-nawwarahā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the light that coursed through the spirits and illumined them, wa-fī l-qulūbi fa-aṣlaḥahā · wa-fī n-nufūsi fa-arshadahā and through the hearts and set them right, and through the souls and guided them rightly, wa-fī l-ummati fa-waffaqahā · wa-li-z-ziyārati ḥabbabahā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wasallim and through the community and granted it success, and made the visit dear to it, and upon his family, and grant peace. “qul bi-faḍli Allāhi wa-biraḥmatihi fa-bi-dhālika fa-lyafraḥū” Allāhumma yā wāḥidu yā aḥadu “Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy—in that let them rejoice” (Qur’an 10:58). O Allah, O One, O Unique One, ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin · ṣalātan lā tuʻaddu wa-lā tuḥaddu send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that cannot be counted or limited, 169

tunawwiru bihā qalbī wa-rūḥī wa-l-jasada · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim through which You illumine my heart, my spirit and my body, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin Aḥmadi l-ḥāmidīna li-niʻamika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the most praising of those who praise You for Your favours, wa-aktharu sh-shākirīna li-faḍlika · wa-arwaʻu l-mutawāḍiʻīna li-ʻaẓamatika and the most thankful of those who give thanks for Your bounty, and the most splendid of those who are humble before Your greatness, al-munfaridu bi-ruʼyatika · wa-l-khāḍiʻu li-ʻizzatika · jalālu kulli jalālin the one singled out to behold You, and the one who submits to Your might, the majesty of all majesty, wa-jamālu kulli jamālin · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and the beauty of all beauty, and upon his family, and grant peace. 170

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan takuffu bihā ʻannā sharra l-ashrāri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which You hold back from us the evil of the wicked, wa-kadara l-akdāri · wa-sharra l-iṣrāri · wa-ẓulmata l-aghyāri and the murkiness of all troubles, and the evil of persisting [in sin], and the darkness of all that is other [than Allah], wa-tudkhilunā bihā fī ḥizbi l-akhyāri and through which You admit us into the company of the excellent, al-muqarrabīna l-abrāri · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim those brought near, the devout, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tatajaddadu watadūmu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that is ever renewed and endures, 171

bi-dawāmi Allāhi l-ḥayyi l-qayyūmi · tukshafu bihā ʻannā l-humūmu wa-lghumūmu with the everlastingness of Allah, the Ever-Living, the SelfSubsisting, through which worries and griefs are lifted from us, wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi mā dārati l-aflāku wa-n-nujūmu and grant peace upon him and upon his family for as long as the celestial spheres and the stars revolve. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin aṣ-ṣafwati l-mukhtāri qabla lmukhtārīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the pure choice, the Elect before all the elect, wa-n-nūri s-sābiqi ʻalā s-sābiqīna · as-sayyidu l-ḥalīmu and the light that precedes all who precede, the master, the forbearing, wa-n-nūru l-mubīnu · wa-l-faḍlu l-ʻamīmu · wa-ʻalā ālihi maʻa t-taslīmi and the clear light, and the all-embracing bounty, and upon his family, together with peace. 172

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin miftāḥi raḥmati Allāhi l-ʻaẓīmi bi-anwāri sharʻihi l-qawīmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the key to the mercy of Allah, the Magnificent, through the lights of his upright law, wa-hādī khalīqati Allāhi ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīmin and the guide of Allah’s creatures to a straight path, wa-amīni asrāri waḥyi Allāhi wa-dh-dhikri l-ḥakīmi and the trusted keeper of the secrets of Allah’s revelation and of the Wise Reminder, wa-ʻalā ālihi maʻa l-barakati wa-t-taslīmi and upon his family, with grace and peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan takshifu bihā r-rāna ʻan qulūbinā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which You lift the rust from our hearts, wa-tuyassiru bihā umūranā · wa-tasturu bihā ʻuyūbanā 173

and through which You ease our affairs, and through which You conceal our faults, wa-taghfiru bihā dhunūbanā · wa-taqḍī bihā duyūnanā and through which You forgive our sins, and through which You settle our debts, wa-tuzakkī bihā nufūsanā · wa-tunawwiru bihā abṣāranā wa-qulūbanā · waʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and through which You purify our souls, and through which You illumine our sight and our hearts, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yafūḥu ʻalayya ʻabīruhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing whose perfume wafts over me, wa-yasṭaʻu fī qalbī nūruhā · wa-yuḍrabu ʻalayya mina l-adhā sūruhā and whose light shines forth in my heart, and whose wall is raised around me against harm, 174

wa-tuhdā bihā nafsī idhā daʻāhā fujūruhā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and through which my soul is guided when its own wickedness calls to it, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan aslamu bihā mina ẓẓulmi wa-l-hawā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which I am kept safe from wrongdoing and vain desire, wa-udāwā minka bihā khayra dawā and through which I am treated by You with the best of remedies, wa-yaṣluḥu bihā jasadī wa-mā ḥawā and through which my body and all that it holds are set right, wa-qalbī wa-mā ʻalayhi nṭawā · yā fāliqa l-ḥabbi wa-n-nawā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and my heart and all that it keeps enfolded, O Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, and upon his family, and grant peace. 175

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yadhūqu bihā qalbī ḥalāwata l-īmāni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a blessing through which my heart tastes the sweetness of faith, wa-uwaffaqu bihā ilā tilāwati l-Qurʼāni and through which I am enabled to recite the Qur’an, wa-mukhālafati sh-shayṭāni · wa-afūzu bihā bi-t-tuqā wa-l-amāni and to oppose Satan, and through which I succeed in gaining piety and security, wa-tasbīḥi r-raḥmāni · wa-fiʻli l-iḥsāni · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and in glorifying the Most Merciful, and in doing good, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika n-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi l-kāmili l-mukammili li-l-arwāḥi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, the perfect one, the perfecter of spirits, 176

ṣalātan tastanīru bihā l-ʻuqūlu wa-tuḥfaẓu l-ashbāḥu with a blessing through which minds are illumined and bodies are protected, wa-yarḍā bihā l-maliku l-ḥaqqu l-karīmu l-wahhābu l-fattāḥu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and with which the True King, the Generous, the Bestower, the Opener, is well pleased, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā zārati l-aḥbābu ahla baytihi l-kirāmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as the loved ones visit the noble People of his House, wa-sallamū ʻalayhim bi-adabin wa-ḥtirāmin · Allāhumma rḍa ʻan ahli baytihi mimman sakanū l-bilāda wa-l-barāriya wa-l-ākāma and give them the greeting of peace with courtesy and respect. O Allah, be pleased with the People of his House, among those who have dwelt in the lands, the wilds and the hills. 177

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bashshara bihi dhdhiʼbu rāʻiya l-ghanami O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, of whom the wolf gave glad tidings to the shepherd of the sheep, wa-ḥafiẓa lahu ghanamahu ḥattā dhahaba wa-aslama and guarded his flock for him until the shepherd went and embraced Islam, wa-huwa yaqūlu subḥāna Allāhi dhiʼbun yatakallamu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wasallim while he was saying, “Glory be to Allah, a wolf that speaks!”; and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī aththarat ʻalā ṣ-ṣakhri qadamāhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose two feet left their imprint upon the rock, wa-aḥyā Allāhu lahu ummahu wa-abāhu and for whom Allah brought his mother and his father back to life, fa-āmanā bihi wa-lā yabʻudu dhālika ʻalā Allāhi 178

so they believed in him, and that is not far-fetched for Allah, ṣalātan bi-ʻadadi kulli ḥabbatin wa-nawātin · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim with a blessing by the number of every grain and every date-stone, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin rasūli r-raḥmati l-mursalati lʻāmmati bi-ʻumūmi “wa-mā arsalnāka illā raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna” O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Messenger of the mercy that was sent, universal in keeping with the universality of “And We have sent you only as a mercy to the worlds” (Qur’an 21:107), al-khāṣṣati bi-khuṣūṣi “bi-l-muʼminīna raʼūfun raḥīmun” wa-ʻalā ālihi waṣaḥbihi maʻa t-taslīmi specific in keeping with the specificity of “to the believers he is compassionate and merciful” (Qur’an 9:128); and upon his family and Companions, together with peace. Allāhumma yā Allāhu yā ʻaẓīmu O Allah, O Allah, O Magnificent One, 179

ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan ʻaẓīmatan tuʼaddī bihi ʻannā wājibahu naḥwanā send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a mighty blessing through which You discharge on our behalf the due that is owed to him from us, fa-innaka taqdiru ʻalā dhālika wa-lā naqdiru for You are able to do that, and we are not able, wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi taslīman and grant peace to him and to his family, in full measure. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī wa-habta lahu lfaḍāʼila fa-nālahā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, to whom You granted the virtues, and he attained them, wa-ātaytahu l-ḥikmata fa-qālahā · wa-ʻallamtahu mā lam yakun yaʻlamu and to whom You gave wisdom, and he spoke it, and whom You taught what he did not know, wa-kāna faḍluka ʻalayhi ʻaẓīman · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim taslīman 180

and Your bounty upon him was ever great, and upon his family, and grant peace in full measure. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻalā qadri faḍlika ʻalayhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad in the measure of Your bounty upon him, wa-ʻalā qadri ʻināyatika bihi · idh ʻallamtahu mā lam yakun yaʻlamu waamarta bi-ṣ-ṣalāti wa-s-salāmi ʻalayhi and in the measure of Your care for him, since You taught him that which he did not know, and commanded that blessings and peace be sent upon him; wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim taslīman · wa-hab lanā bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi ajran ʻaẓīman and upon his family, and grant peace in full measure; and grant us, through sending blessings upon him, a great reward. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, 181

nabiyyi r-raḥmati lladhī arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna the Prophet of mercy, whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna · bi-ʻadadi ṣalāti l-muṣallīna ʻalayhi mina lawwalīna wa-l-ākhirīna and upon his family, and grant peace to them all, by the number of the blessings of those who send blessings upon him, from among the first and the last. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bawwaʼtahu khayra lmaqāʻidi l-ʻulwiyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom You settled in the best of the lofty seats, wa-jaʻalta manzilatahu fī l-jannati aʻlā l-manāzila l-qurbiyyata and whose station in Paradise You made the highest of the stations of nearness, wa-atmamta niʻmataka ʻalayhi · wa-ṣallayta anta wa-malāʼikatuka ʻalayhi and upon whom You completed Your favour, and upon whom You and Your angels sent blessings, 182

fa-zdāda sharafan ilā sharafihi · wa-ʻizzan ilā ʻizzihi wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim so he increased in nobility on top of his nobility, and in glory on top of his glory; and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bārakta ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi bi-aʻẓami l-barakāti O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, upon whom and upon whose family You bestowed grace with the greatest of graces, wa-rafaʻtahu ʻindaka aʻlā d-darajāti · wa-takarramta ʻalayhi bi-afḍali nnubuwwāti wa-ashrafi r-risālāti and whom You raised to the highest ranks with You, and upon whom You generously bestowed the most excellent of prophethoods and the noblest of messages, fa-huwa n-nabiyyu l-khātimu li-kulli nubuwwatin for he is the Prophet who seals every prophethood, wa-r-rasūlu l-afḍalu ʻalā kulli risālatin · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim 183

and the Messenger most excellent above every message, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ṭāʻatuhu fīhā riḍāʼu Allāhi ʻallāmu l-ghuyūbi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, in obeying whom lies the good pleasure of Allah, the Knower of the unseen, wa-ḥubbuhu ṭibbun wa-shifāʼun li-l-qulūbi · ṣalātan bi-nūrihā yuwaffaqu tālīhā wa-yatūbu and whose love is a remedy and a healing for hearts, with a blessing by whose light its reciter is granted success and repents, wa-yuyassaru lahu kullu amrin marghūbin and every desired matter is made easy for him, wa-yukshafu bi-nūrihā ʻan kulli qalbin maḥjūbin · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and by whose light every veiled heart is unveiled, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ṭāba aṣluhu wa-farʻuhu 184
