O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose root and branch are pure, wa-kāna yataqāṭaru khawfan mina Allāhi taʻālā fī ṣalātihi damʻuhu and whose tears would fall drop by drop, out of fear of Allah, the Exalted, in his prayer, wa-ʻalā Allāhi taʻālā ḥifẓu l-Qurʼāni fī ṣadrihi wa-jamʻuhu wa-raddu kulli ʻaduwwin ʻanhu wa-manʻuhu and upon Allah, the Exalted, rests the preservation of the Qur’an in his breast, and its collection, and the repelling of every enemy from him, and his protection, alladhī kāna aḥsana ṭ-ṭibāʻi ṭabʻuhu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim the one whose nature was the finest of natures, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī saʻidati l-khalāʼiqu bibaʻthatihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, by whose mission the creatures found happiness, wa-ṭābat Ṭaybatu bi-hijratihi · wa-fāza z-zuwwāru bi-zawratihi and by whose migration Tayba (Medina) became sweet, and by visiting whom the visitors triumphed, 185

wa-najā l-muʼminūna bi-shafāʻatihi · ṣalātan tajʻalunā bihā min ahli ʻināyatihi and by whose intercession the believers were saved, with a blessing through which You make us among the people of his care, wa-atbāʻi sunnatihi · wa-l-ʻāmilīna bi-shirʻatihi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and among the followers of his Sunna, and among those who act by his Law, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī tawwajtahu bi-tāji nubuwwatika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom You crowned with the crown of Your prophethood, wa-ajlastahu ʻalā kursiyyi khilāfatika · wa-sharraftahu bi-anwāri risālatika and whom You seated upon the seat of Your vicegerency, and whom You ennobled with the lights of Your message, wa-shaffaʻtahu shafāʻata l-qaḍāʼi fī khalīqatika and whose intercession You accepted, the intercession of judgement, on behalf of Your creation, 186

fa-huwa n-nabiyyu l-ʻarabiyyu l-mawhūbu · wa-r-rasūlu l-hāshimiyyu lḥabību l-maḥbūbu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim for he is the Arab Prophet, the one given as a gift, and the Hashimite Messenger, the Beloved, the loved one, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sirāji nūri ḥaqqika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the lamp of the light of Your truth, ilā jamīʻi khalqika · wa-Madīnati ʻilmika to all Your creation, and the city of Your knowledge, ilā ahli sharʻika · wa-maẓhari raḥmatika to the people of Your Law, and the manifestation of Your mercy, wa-wuddika ṣalātan nanālu bihā ʻaẓīma ajrika and of Your affection, with a blessing through which we attain Your immense reward, wa-wāsiʻa faḍlika · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and Your vast bounty, and upon his family, and grant peace; wa-ʻalā jamīʻi anbiyāʼika wa-rusulika wa-sallim 187

and upon all Your Prophets and Messengers, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ʻaṣamahu Allāhu fakāna maʻṣūman O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom Allah safeguarded, and so he was safeguarded, wa-ʻallamahu Allāhu fa-kāna ʻāliman makrūman and whom Allah taught, and so he was learned and honoured, wa-naṣarahu Allāhu fa-lam yakun maḍyūman and whom Allah helped, and so he was never wronged, wa-ḥakkamahu Allāhu fa-lam yakun maḥkūman and whom Allah made the arbiter, and so he was never subject to another’s ruling, wa-tawallāhu Allāhu fa-lam yakun malūman and whom Allah took under His guardianship, and so he was never blameworthy, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan man talāhā yakun mubārakan marḥūman and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing such that whoever recites it will be granted grace and shown mercy. 188

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-munabbaʼi qabla Ādama ʻalayhi s-salāmu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the one who was informed [of his prophethood] before Adam, peace be upon him, wa-rasūlika l-ʻāqibi fa-huwa li-r-rusuli khitāmun and Your Messenger, the Last of the Prophets, for he is the seal of the Messengers, alladhī ukhtuṣṣa bi-r-ruʼyati wa-fāza bi-samāʻi l-kalāmi the one who was singled out for the Vision and won the hearing of the Divine Speech, wa-fāqa nūruhu shamsa ḍ-ḍuḥā wa-badra t-tamāmi and whose light surpassed the forenoon sun and the full moon at its fullest, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ʻalā awlādihi wa-azwājihi wa-ahli baytihi lmuṭahharīna l-kirāmi and upon his family, and grant peace; and upon his children, his wives and the People of his House, the purified and the noble. 189

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin bi-ʻadadi faḍli Allāhi lladhī lā yuḥaddu wa-ʻadadi niʻami Allāhi llatī lā tuʻaddu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad by the number of Allah’s bounty, which has no limit, and the number of Allah’s favours, which cannot be counted, bi-ʻadadi kulli daʻwatin bi-faḍli Allāhi lā turaddu by the number of every supplication which, by Allah’s bounty, is never turned away, wa-biʻadadi man nawā l-ḥajja wa-z-ziyārata wa-li-r-rawāḥili shadda and by the number of all who have intended the Hajj and the visit and have saddled their mounts, ṣalātan naslamu bihā min kulli sūʼin wa-ḥasadin with a blessing through which we are safe from every evil and envy, bi-ʻadadi kulli wālidin wa-mā walada by the number of every father and all that he has begotten, ṣalātan nuhdā bihā ilā sabīli r-rashadi with a blessing by which we are guided to the path of rectitude, 190

wa-numaddu bihā bi-l-khayrāti wa-l-madadi · minka yā ilāhu yā wāḥidu yā ṣamadu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and by which we are supplied with good things and with succour, from You, O God, O One, O Eternal Refuge, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī malaʼta qalbahu min jalāli ʻaẓamatika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose heart You filled with the majesty of Your grandeur, wa-ʻaynahu min jamāli rubūbiyyatika · wa-ṣadrahu min ʻulūmi ṣamadāniyyatika and his eye with the beauty of Your Lordship, and his breast with the knowledge of Your absolute self-sufficiency, fa-ṣāra qalbuhu khāshiʻan bi-qudratika · wa-naẓaruhu shāfiʻan bi-raḥmatika so that his heart became humbled by Your power, and his gaze intercessory by Your mercy, wa-ʻilmuhu nāfiʻan bi-idhnika · wa-junduhu manṣūran bi-ḥawlika and his knowledge beneficial by Your leave, and his army victorious through Your might, 191

fa-innahu lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʻaliyyi l-ʻaẓīmi for there is no might and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi maʻa r-riḍā wa-t-taslīmi and upon his family and Companions, with good pleasure and peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī zalzala arḍa l-kufri ʻazmuhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose resolve shook the land of disbelief, wa-wasiʻa l-muʼminīna ʻafwuhu wa-ḥilmuhu · wa-ashrafu l-asmāʼi fī lkhalīqati smuhu and whose pardon and forbearance embraced the believers, and whose name is the noblest of names in creation, wa-amadda l-ʻulamāʼa qawluhu wa-ʻilmuhu · wa-aʻjaba l-ḥukamāʼa ʻadluhu wa-ḥukmuhu and whose word and knowledge sustained the scholars, and whose justice and judgement astonished the sages, 192

wa-ammana l-bilāda ḥarbuhu wa-silmuhu · fa-huwa l-ʻafuwwu l-ḥalīmu and whose war and peace alike secured the lands, so he is the pardoning, the forbearing one, wa-l-ʻādilu l-ʻalīmu · dhū l-khuluqi l-ʻaẓīmi the just, the knowing one, the possessor of a great character, wa-l-qalbi s-salīmi · wa-ʻalā ālihi maʻa l-barakati wa-t-taslīmi and of a sound heart, and upon his family, with grace and peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sirāji qulūbi ʻibādi r-raḥmāni lladhīna yamshūna ʻalā l-arḍi hawnan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the lamp of the hearts of the servants of the Most Merciful, who walk upon the earth in humility, al-mukammali li-anfusihim min baḥri kamāli ṣifātihi l-ḥusnā the perfecter of their souls from the ocean of the perfection of his most beautiful attributes, al-muʻribi bi-bayānihi ʻan ghawāmiḍi asrāri badāʼiʻi l-maʻnā who, by his eloquent exposition, makes plain the obscure secrets of the marvels of meaning, 193

alladhī tafaḍḍalta ʻalayhi bi-jūdika fa-kāna khayra man ʻalayka athnā upon whom You bestowed Your bounty out of Your munificence, so that he became the best of all who have praised You, al-mukhāṭabu bi-qawlika “wa-wajadaka ʻāʼilan fa-aghnā” ṣalātan anālu bihā sirra mā bihi l-arwāḥu taghnā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim the one addressed by Your words “And He found you in need and enriched you” (Qur’an 93:8), with a blessing through which I attain the secret of that by which spirits are enriched, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bi-taʼyīdika wa-naṣrika abṭala ʻibādata l-aṣnāmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who, by Your support and help, abolished the worship of idols, wa-bisāṭiʻi waḥyika azāla qtisāma l-azlāmi and by Your radiant revelation removed the seeking of decisions by divining arrows, wa-binūri tawḥīdihi ndatharati l-abāṭīlu fa-lā ḥāma and by the light of his declaration of Oneness the falsehoods were effaced, so that no ḥām remained, 194

wa-biʻaẓīmi ʻadlihi azāla ḍ-ḍaghāʼina wa-qaṭʻa l-arḥāmi and by his great justice he removed grudges and the severing of family ties, fa-huwa n-najātu mina l-ahwāli wa-l-ālāmi so he is the deliverance from terrors and pains, wa-l-munqidhu mani qtafāhu mina l-arjāsi wa-l-awhāmi and the rescuer of whoever follows in his footsteps from impurities and delusions, wa-sallim Allāhumma ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi s-sādati l-kirāmi and grant peace, O Allah, upon him and upon his family, the noble masters. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī faḍḍaltahu ʻalā lawwalīna wa-l-ākhirīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom You preferred above the first and the last, wa-ātaytahu qurʼānan taqarru bihi aʻyunu l-qāriʼīna and to whom You gave a Qur’an that brings delight to the eyes of the reciters, 195

wa-tanshariḥu bihi ṣudūru s-sāmiʻīna · wa-shaffaʻtahu fī l-mudhnibīna wakatabta sh-shafāʻata li-z-zāʼirīna lahu bi-rawḍatihi maʻa z-zāʼirīna and by which the breasts of the listeners are opened wide, and whose intercession for the sinners You accepted, and You decreed intercession for those who visit him at his Garden (al-Rawḍa), along with the visitors, wa-fariḥa z-zāʼirūna lahu maʻa z-zāʼirīna l-fariḥīna and the visitors to him rejoiced, together with the joyful visitors, wa-fāḥa ʻalayhim ṭaybuhu lladhī huwa aṭyabu mina l-wardi wa-l-yāsimīna and over them wafted his fragrance, which is sweeter than the rose and the jasmine, ṣalātan dāʼimatan fī kulli waqtin wa-ḥīnin · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim with a constant blessing, at every time and every moment, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī huwa raḥmatu Allāhi li-man arāda an yurḥama 196

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who is Allah’s mercy to whoever wishes to be shown mercy, wa-bābu ḥifẓin li-man arāda an yuḥfaẓa wa-yuʻṣama and a door of protection for whoever wishes to be guarded and shielded, wa-bābu karamin li-man arāda an yujzala lahu wa-yukrama and a door of generosity for whoever wishes to be given abundantly and honoured, wa-bābu ḥusni l-khātimati wa-mani ttabaʻa sharʻahu in shāʼa Allāhu bi-ḥusni l-khitāmi lahu yukhtamu and the door of a good end (and whoever follows his Law will, if Allah wills, be sealed with a good ending), alladhī bi-daʻwatihi ilā Allāhi taʻālā āmana man āmana wa-aslama man aslama through whose call to Allah, the Exalted, those who believed came to believe and those who submitted came to submit, alladhī ḥubbuhu li-l-qulūbi s-salīmati hayyama whose love has enraptured the sound hearts, wa-llāhu taʻālā ʻalā kulli mani ttabaʻahu bi-l-khayrāti anʻama 197

and Allah, the Exalted, has favoured everyone who follows him with good things, wa-ʻalā bābi l-ghāri muʻjizata l-ʻankabūtu khayyama and at the entrance of the cave, as a miracle, the spider pitched its tent, wa-ʻalā ummatihi Ibrāhīmu l-khalīlu ʻalayhi s-salāmu laylata l-isrāʼi sallama and Abraham the Intimate Friend, peace be upon him, sent greetings of peace to his community on the night of the Night Journey, ṣalātan bihā min kulli sharrin wa-sūʼin aslamu with a blessing through which I am safe from every evil and harm, mā hāma bi-madḥihi mādiḥun wa-tarannama for as long as a praiser is enraptured in praising him and chants melodiously, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā taqabbala Allāhu ṣ-ṣāliḥāti watammama and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of times Allah has accepted righteous deeds and brought them to completion. 198

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika wa-ḥabībika lladhī khatamta bi-nubuwwatihi n-nubuwwāti O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, and Your Beloved, through whose prophethood You sealed the prophethoods, wa-birisālatihi r-risālāti · fa-huwa khātimu n-nabiyyīna and through his message the messages, so he is the Seal of the Prophets, wa-imāmi l-anbiyāʼi wa-l-mursalīna · wa-sayyidu walada Ādama ajmaʻīna and the leader of the Prophets and the Messengers, and the master of all the children of Adam, aṣ-ṣādiqu l-maʼmūnu l-amīnu · wa-raḥmatu Allāhi li-l-ʻālamīna the Truthful, the Trusted, the Trustworthy, and the mercy of Allah to the worlds, wa-shafīʻu l-khalāʼiqi yawma d-dīni · alladhī ātaytahu sabʻan mina l-mathānī wa-l-Qurʼāna l-ʻaẓīma and the intercessor for all creatures on the Day of Judgement, to whom You gave seven of the oft-repeated [verses] and the Great Qur’an, 199

akhlaṣu l-ʻāmilīna · wa-afḍalu dh-dhākirīna · wa-aṭyabu ṭ-ṭayyibīna the most sincere of those who labour, and the most excellent of those who engage in remembrance, and the purest of the pure, wa-aqrabu l-mutaqarribīna · alladhī huwa bi-l-muʼminīna raʼūfun raḥīmun · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and the nearest of those who draw near, who is, towards the believers, compassionate and merciful, and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī ʻallamtahu mā lam yakun yaʻlamu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, whom You taught that which he did not know, wa-ṣallayta ʻalayhi anta wa-malāʼikatuka · wa-amartanā bi-ṣ-ṣalāti wa-ssalāmi ʻalayhi and upon whom You and Your angels have sent blessings, and You commanded us to invoke blessings and peace upon him, 200

wa-qulta wa-qawluka l-ḥaqqu “yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʻalayhi wasallimū taslīman” and You said, and Your word is the truth, “O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with a worthy greeting of peace” (Qur’an 33:56). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalayhi ṣalātan taṣilu rūḥī bi-rūḥihi ttiṣāla l-maḥabbati llatī tasūqu ilā mutābiʻatihi ṣallā Allāhu ʻalayhi wa-sallama O Allah, send blessings upon him, with a blessing that joins my spirit to his spirit in the union of love that leads to following him (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), fī l-qawli wa-l-fiʻli wa-ẓ-ẓāhiri wa-l-bāṭini in word and deed, in the outward and the inward, yā man huwa l-awwalu wa-l-ākhiru O You who are the First and the Last, wa-ẓ-ẓāhiru wa-l-bāṭinu · wa-huwa bi-kulli shayʼin ʻalīmun the Manifest and the Hidden, and He is All-Knowing of everything. 201

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tuzayyinu bihā rūḥī bizīnati kawākibi ḥubbihi r-rūḥāniyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which You adorn my spirit with the adornment of the spiritual stars of his love, wa-mā yaḥfaẓuhā mina s-sawālibi n-nafsāniyyati wa-n-nazaʻāti shshayṭāniyyati and with what guards it from the despoiling forces of the soul and the satanic impulses, bi-jawādhibi lamaʻāni burūqi tajalliyātihi l-ʻirfāniyyati bi-ẓuhūri “fa-innī aẓharu fī kulli ṣūratin insāniyyatin” ḥattā yudbira laylu nafsī min hāhunā through the attractions of the gleaming lightning-flashes of his gnostic self-disclosures, by the appearing of “For I appear in every human form,” until the night of my soul withdraws from here, wa-yuqbila nahāru rūḥī bi-l-hanā and the day of my spirit comes forward in delight, 202

ʻalā arḍi jismī fa-tushriqa ʻawālimuhu t-turābiyyatu bi-mā yuʼahhiluhā li-ttalaqqī ʻanhu fī ʻawālimihā l-ghaybiyyati upon the earth of my body, so that its earthen worlds shine with what qualifies them to receive from him in their unseen worlds, mā yajʻaluhā muttabiʻatan lahu fī awāmirihi wa-nawāhīhi l-ʻaliyyati that which makes them follow him in his exalted commands and prohibitions, fa-tujdhaba bihi ilā ḥaḍratin qudsiyyatin and so [my spirit] is drawn by him to a sacred Presence, fī maqāmin kāna Allāhu wa-lā shayʼa maʻahu qabla ʻawālimihi lmaẓhariyyati fa-tudrika l-ḥaqīqata t-tawḥīdiyyati fa-tatlū āyata t-tawḥīdi billāhi ʻani Allāhi in a station in which Allah was, and nothing was with Him, before the worlds of His manifestation, so that it perceives the reality of Oneness and recites the verse of Oneness, by Allah, from Allah, fa-tasriya fī ʻawālimi jismihā ladhdhatun ghayru mukayyafatin li-ʻaqlin wa-lā mudrakatin li-naqlin 203

so that there flows through the worlds of its body a delight that no intellect can define and no transmitted knowledge can reach, fa-tadhkuru bihā ladhdhata “alastu bi-rabbikum” fa-tudrika bi-qadīmi samʻihā qadīma masmūʻihā and so it remembers, through this delight, the delight of “Am I not your Lord?” (Qur’an 7:172), and perceives with its ancient hearing the ancient thing that it heard, fa-yaṭribahā s-samāʻu fa-tudrika bihi ʻadamahā wa-fanāʼahā fī maqāmi baqāʼihā so that the hearing sends it into rapture, and through this hearing it perceives its non-existence and its annihilation in the station of its subsistence, fa-takhruja min maqāmi ʻadamin wa-fanāʼin ilā shuhūdin wa-baqāʼin “khālidīna fīhā abadan raḍiya Allāhu ʻanhum wa-raḍū ʻanhu” wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and so it goes forth from the station of non-existence and annihilation to witnessing and subsistence: “abiding therein forever; Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him” (Qur’an 5:119; 98:8); and upon his family, and grant peace. Allāhumma innī asʼaluka bi-smika l-ʻaẓīmi l-aʻẓami 204

O Allah, I ask You by Your Name, the Magnificent, the Greatest, al-maktūbi min nūri wajhika l-aʻlā d-dāʼimi l-muʼabbadi written from the light of Your Face, the Most High, the Everlasting, the Perpetual, al-mukhalladi fī qalbi nabiyyika wa-rasūlika sayyidinā Muḥammadin made to abide forever in the heart of Your Prophet and Your Messenger, our master Muhammad, ṣallā Allāhu ʻalayhi wa-sallam · wa-asʼaluka Allāhumma bi-smika l-aʻẓami lwāḥidi bi-waḥdati l-aḥadi may Allah bless him and grant him peace. And I ask You, O Allah, by Your Greatest Name, the One, by the oneness of the Unique One, al-mutaʻālī ʻan waḥdati l-kammi wa-l-ʻadadi who is exalted above the oneness of quantity and number, al-muqaddasi ʻan kulli aḥadin who is sanctified above anyone at all, wa-bisirri bismi llāhi r-raḥmāni r-raḥīmi “qul huwa Allāhu aḥadun · Allāhu ṣ-ṣamadu · lam yalid wa-lam yūlad · wa-lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥadun” 205

an tuṣalliya wa-tusallima ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin and by the secret of “In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Ever-Merciful” and “Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. And there is none comparable to Him” (Qur’an 112:1–4), that You send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, sirri ḥayāti l-wujūdi wa-s-sababi l-aʻẓami li-kulli mawjūdin the secret of the life of existence and the greatest cause of every existing thing, ṣalātan tuthabbitu fī qalbī l-īmāna with a blessing that makes faith firm in my heart, wa-tuḥaffiẓunī l-Qurʼāna · wa-tufahhimunī minhu l-āyāti and causes me to memorize the Qur’an, and makes me understand its verses, wa-taftaḥu lī bihā nūra l-jannāti and through which You open for me the light of the Gardens of Paradise, wa-nūra n-naʻīmi · wa-nūra n-naẓri ilā wajhika l-karīmi · wa-ʻalā ālihi waṣaḥbihi wa-sallim and the light of bliss, and the light of gazing upon Your Noble Face, and upon his family and Companions, and grant peace. 206

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan lā yakhību tālīhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a blessing whose reciter is never disappointed, wa-lā yasʼamu qārīhā · wa-tastanīru layālīhā and whose reader never grows weary, and whose nights become illumined, bi-ʻadadi d-dunyā wa-mā fīhā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim by the number of this world and all that is in it, and upon his family, and grant peace. 207

Wird Yawm al-Khamīs Thursday J U M P T O P R AY E R 1–10 11–20 21–30 31–40 41–50 51–56 O P E N I N G · R E C I T E D E A C H D AY al-ḥamdu li-llāhi wa-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʻalā sayyidinā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadin rasūli Allāhi wa-ʻalā ālihi fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi All praise is for Allah, and blessings and peace be upon our master and patron Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, and upon his family, in every glance and every breath, by the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses, wa-raḍiya Allāhu ʻan shaykhaynā sayyidī Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi and may Allah be pleased with our two shaykhs: my master Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, wa-sayyidī ʻabdi l-ghaniyyi Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi wa-arḍāhumā and my master ʻAbd al-Ghanī Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, and may He make them well pleased, 208

wa-jaʻala l-jannata mutaqallabahumā wa-mathwāhumā and make Paradise their resort and their abode. wa-nfaʻnā Allāhumma bi-jāhihimā ʻindaka yā Allāhu And benefit us, O Allah, through their standing with You, O Allah. Allāhumma innī uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday kulli nafasin walamḥatin wa-ṭarfatin yaṭrifu bihā ahlu s-samāwāti wa-ahlu l-arḍi wakulli shayʼin huwa fī ʻilmika kāʼinun aw qad kāna uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday dhālika kullihi O Allah, I offer to You, in the presence of every breath, every glance and every blink with which the people of the heavens and the people of the earth blink, and of everything that is in Your knowledge, whether it is yet to be or has already come to be — I offer to You, in the presence of all of that, [the prayers that follow]. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bihi yatimmu l-islāmu wa-l-īmānu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, through whom Islam and faith reach completion, 209

wa-lawlāhu mā anzala ilayhi kitābahu l-Qurʼāna and had it not been for him, He would not have sent down to him His Book, the Qur’an, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī kulli waqtin wa-makānin and upon his family, and grant peace, at every time and in every place. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tajʻalunā lahu mushāhidīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a blessing that makes us behold him, wa-bisunnatihi ʻāmilīna · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-najjinā mina ẓ-ẓālimīna and act upon his Sunna, and upon his family, and grant peace; and deliver us from the wrongdoers. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-qadri mā ṣulliya ʻalayhi · ṣalātan tuqarribunī ilayhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, and grant peace, by the measure of all the blessings that 210

have been sent upon him, with a blessing that brings me near to him. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ṣabara li-ḥukmi Allāhi ḥattā atāhu naṣru Allāhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who waited patiently for Allah’s judgement until Allah’s help came to him, wa-bashsharahu Allāhu wa-ḥaqqaqa lahu bushrāhu and Allah gave him glad tidings and fulfilled for him his glad tidings. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sayyidi ahli d-dunyā wa-lākhirati lladhī huwa mina s-sulālati ṭ-ṭayyibati ṭ-ṭāhirati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the master of the people of this world and the Hereafter, who comes from the good and pure lineage. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ad-dāʻī ilayka bika wa-l-hādī ilā ṣ-ṣirāṭi l-mustaqīmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who calls to You through You and guides to the straight path, 211

ṣirāṭi Allāhi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi faḍli Allāhi ʻalā khalqi Allāhi the path of Allah, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of Allah’s bounties upon Allah’s creation. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim biʻadadi ṣalāti l-muṣallīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the blessings of those who send blessings, wa-biqadri ṣalāti l-muṣallīna ʻalayhi · ṣalātan tuqarribunī bihā ilayhi and by the measure of the blessings of those who send blessings upon him, with a blessing through which You bring me near to him. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī fataḥa li-n-nāsi abwāba l-jannati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who opened the gates of Paradise for the people, 212

wa-jāʼa bi-l-kitābi wa-s-sunnati · wa-lladhī manna Allāhu bihi ʻalayhim aʻẓama minnatin and who brought the Book and the Sunna, and through whom Allah conferred upon them the greatest favour. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin sirāji l-kawni wa-ʻalīmihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the lamp of the universe and the one who knows it, wa-munīri l-qalbi wa-salīmihi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim alladhī yajibu ḥtirāmuhu wa-takrīmuhu and the illuminator of the heart and of what is sound in it, and upon his family, and grant peace; the one whom it is obligatory to respect and honour. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥabībi l-jalīli O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Beloved of the Majestic One, wa-daʻwati l-khalīli · ar-rāḍī bi-l-qalīli · wa-sh-shāfī li-l-ʻalīli 213

and the supplication of the Intimate Friend (Abraham), the one who is content with little, and the healer of the ailing, an-nabiyyi l-aṣīli · ṣāḥibi Jibrīla · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim the Prophet of noble origin, the companion of Gabriel, and upon his family, and grant peace, taslīman kathīran · wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi l-ʻālamīna with abundant peace; and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-fawzi bi-d-dārayni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of triumph in both abodes, wa-imāmi l-qiblatayni · wa-nūri l-muqlataynu · wa-jaddi l-ḥasanayni wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and the imam of the two directions of prayer, and the light of the two eyes, and the grandfather of al-Hasan and al-Husayn, and upon his family, and grant peace; wa-farrij ʻannā kulla karbin · wa-qḍi ʻannā kulla daynin and relieve us of every affliction, and discharge every debt on our behalf. 214

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tuʻjizu l-ʻāddīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a blessing that leaves those who count powerless, wa-tufriḥu zayna n-nabiyyīna · wa-tahdī bihā l-muslimīna and gladdens the adornment of the Prophets, and through which You guide the Muslims, wa-taqbalu bihā l-ʻuṣāta wa-l-mudhnibīna · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna and through which You accept the disobedient and the sinners, and upon his family, and grant peace to them all. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī jāʼa bi-l-Qurʼāni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who brought the Qur’an, wa-jaʻalta ṭāʻatahu ṭāʻataka yā raḥīmu yā raḥmānu and You made obedience to him obedience to You, O Ever-Merciful, O Most Merciful (Raḥmān), wa-jaʻalta ḥubbahu ʻalāmatan ʻalā l-īmāni and You made love for him a sign of faith, 215

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ahli l-khushūʻi li-llāhi d-dayyāni and upon his family, the people of humility before Allah, the Requiter, and grant peace. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan anālu bihā fatḥa lawwalīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a blessing through which I attain the opening of the earliest ones, wa-iqbāla l-ḥāḍirīna · wa-yaqīna l-mutawakkilīna · wa-mawaddata lmaḥbūbīna and the wholehearted turning of those who are present, and the certainty of those who place their trust in Allah, and the affection of the beloved, wa-anwāra l-ʻārifīna · wa-tawbata ṣ-ṣiddīqīna · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna and the lights of those who know Allah, and the repentance of the truthful, and upon his family, and grant peace to them all. 216

Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin afḍali khalqi Allāhi ajmaʻīna O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our master Muhammad, the most excellent of all of Allah’s creation, wa-ʻalā l-ḥasanayni wa-ummihimā wa-mā tanāsala minhum ilā yawmi d-dīni and upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn, and their mother, and all who have descended from them until the Day of Judgement, fī kulli waqtin wa-ḥīnin · abada l-ābidīna at every hour and every moment, for all eternity, wa-dahra d-dāhirīna · yā rabba l-ʻālamīna and for ages upon ages, O Lord of the worlds. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī amartanā bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi fī l-Qurʼāni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, upon whom You commanded us in the Qur’an to send blessings, wa-amarta l-umama qablanā fī kulli zamānin and You commanded the nations before us, in every age, 217

ṣalātan maqrūnatan bi-l-fatḥi wa-l-amāni · li-ahli l-islāmi wa-l-īmāni with a blessing accompanied by victory and security, for the people of Islam and faith, wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi yā raḥīmu yā raḥmānu and grant peace upon him and upon his family, O Ever-Merciful, O Most Merciful (Raḥmān). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā zāra l-baqīʻa zāʼirun wasallim ʻalā abī Muḥammadin al-ḥasani O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as a visitor visits al-Baqiʻ, and grant peace upon Abu Muhammad alHasan, wa-ẓaharat ʻalayhim barakātahu · fa-hadāhumu Allāhu ilā khayri sananin and his graces appear upon them, so Allah guides them to the best of ways, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · mā ruwiya l-ḥadīthu ṣ-ṣaḥīḥu wa-l-ḥasanu and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as the sound and the fair (hasan) hadith are narrated. 218

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bakā l-jadhʻu li-firāqihi ḥattā samiʻa l-jālisūna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, at being parted from whom the palm trunk wept until those who were sitting could hear it, fa-bakā li-bukāʼihi ṣ-ṣaḥābatu ajmaʻūna · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi qaṭarāti sayḥūna wa-jayḥūna and so the Companions, all of them, wept at its weeping, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the drops of the rivers Sayhun and Jayhun. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-bzugh shamsa ʻilmihi ʻalā qulūbinā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and cause the sun of his knowledge to rise upon our hearts, wa-yassir lanā bi-jāhihi l-wuṣūla ilā maṭlūbinā and by his exalted standing, make it easy for us to reach what we seek, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · wa-mattiʻnā bi-unsihi fī dāri khulūdinā 219

and upon his family, and grant peace, and grant us the enjoyment of his intimate company in our eternal abode. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī man aṭāʻahu fa-qad aṭāʻa Allāha O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, who is such that whoever obeys him has indeed obeyed Allah, wa-man ʻaṣāhu fa-qad ʻaṣā Allāha and whoever disobeys him has indeed disobeyed Allah, wa-man ṣallā ʻalayhi fa-qad ṣallā ʻalayhi Allāhu and whoever sends blessings upon him, Allah has indeed sent blessings upon him. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-muẓallali bi-l-ghamāmati mā aẓhara mushtāqun ilayhi wajdahu wa-gharāmahu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the one shaded by the cloud, for as long as one who longs for him displays his ardent passion and consuming love, 220

wa-tawqīrahu wa-ḥtirāmahu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-adim dhālika ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati and his reverence and respect for him, and upon his family, and grant peace, and make that endure until the Day of Resurrection. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika l-mutaḥallī bi-akmali ṣifāti l-ʻubūdiyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, adorned with the most perfect attributes of servanthood, wa-ḥabībika l-muqarrabi bi-aʻlā l-maqāmāti l-qurbiyyati and Your Beloved, drawn near through the highest stations of nearness, al-munfaridi bi-awfā ṣ-ṣifāti l-wuddiyyati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī kulli bukratin wa-ʻashiyyatin uniquely distinguished by the most complete attributes of loving affection, and upon his family, and grant peace, every morning and evening. 221

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin naṣri Allāhi d-dāʼimi waraḥmatihi l-ʻālamiyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the abiding help of Allah and His universal mercy, allatī ʻammat aṣnāfa l-bariyyati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim which has embraced every kind of creature, and upon his family, and grant peace, wa-rzuqnā Allāhumma ʻīshatan mubārikatan haniyyatan and grant us, O Allah, a life of grace and pleasantness. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ashraqa nūruhu ʻalā qulūbi l-ʻārifīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose light shone upon the hearts of those who know Allah (the gnostics), fa-nālū bihi ʻilma l-yaqīni · wa-lawlāhu mā nālū dharratan mina s-sirri lmaṣūni so that through him they attained the knowledge of certainty, and were it not for him, they would not have attained a single speck of the guarded secret, 222

fa-huwa wāsiṭatu tanazzulāti maknūnāti fuyūḍāti ladunniyāti ʻulūmika ʻalā mā kāna wa-mā yakūnu min asrāri mā kāna wa-mā yakūnu for he is the intermediary of the descents of the hidden things of the outpourings of Your directly bestowed (ladunī) sciences, upon all that has been and all that will be, of the secrets of all that has been and all that will be. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan nashhadu bihā lkamāla r-rabbāniyya O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which we witness the divine perfection, fī sāʼiri l-maḥsūsāti wa-l-maʻānī · wa-nadkhulu bihā jannata r-riḍwāni in all things perceptible and in all meanings, and through which we enter the Paradise of good pleasure, wa-tuḥīṭunā bihā ṭ-ṭumaʼnīnatu fī kulli ānin and through which tranquillity surrounds us at every moment, ṣalātan yanṣaliḥu bihā kullu waqtin wa-zamānin a blessing through which every time and every age is set right, 223

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · ahli l-khayri wa-l-iḥsāni and upon his family, and grant peace, the people of goodness and excellence. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī rafaʻta dhikrahu ʻindaka fa-lā dhikra arfaʻu minhu wa-rafaʻta liwāʼahu yawma l-qiyāmati fajamīʻu l-anbiyāʼi taḥta li-wāʼihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose mention You have raised in Your presence, so that no mention is higher than his, and whose banner You have raised on the Day of Resurrection, so that all the Prophets are beneath his banner, wa-aʻṭaytahu s-siyādata fa-huwa sayyidu waladi Ādama ajmaʻīna and to whom You gave mastership, so that he is the master of all the children of Adam. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim taslīman kathīran ilā yawmi d-dīni O Allah, send blessings upon him and upon his family, and grant abundant peace until the Day of Judgement. 224

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī sabaqa s-sābiqīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, who preceded the forerunners, wa-faḍala l-awwalīna wa-l-ākhirīna · wa-arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna and surpassed the first and the last, and whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna · wa-rḥamnī bi-jāhihi ʻindaka yā ḥaqqu yā mubīnu and upon his family, and grant peace to them all, and have mercy on me, by his exalted standing with You, O Truth, O Manifest One, wa-rḍa ʻan aṣḥābihi wa-rḥam ummatahu l-muʼminīna and be pleased with his Companions, and have mercy on his community, the believers. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan taghmisunā bihā fī baḥri ḥubbihi maʻa l-ʻārifīna 225

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which You immerse us in the ocean of love for him, together with those who know Allah, wa-tunawwiru bihā qulūbanā bi-nūri l-yaqīni and by which You illumine our hearts with the light of certainty, wa-taqḍī lanā bihā ḥawāʼija d-dunyā wa-d-dīni and by which You fulfil for us the needs of this world and of religion, wa-taḥfaẓunā bihā min aʻyuni l-ḥāsidīna and by which You protect us from the eyes of the envious, wa-kaydi l-kāʼidīna · wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-ʻalā sāʼiri l-muʼminīna and from the scheming of those who scheme, and grant peace upon him and upon his family and upon all the believers, wa-ʻalaynā maʻahum yā arḥama r-rāḥimīna and upon us with them, O Most Merciful of the merciful. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nūri l-asbaqi lladhī sabaqa s-sābiqīna 226

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Foremost Light who preceded the forerunners, wa-raḥmatuka l-ʻuẓmā llatī ʻammati l-ʻālamīna and Your supreme mercy, which has embraced all the worlds, wa-sirājuka lladhī minhu ttaqadat suruju l-mustaʼkhirīna and Your lamp, from which the lamps of those who came later were kindled, wa-qamaruka s-sārī laylan min ḥaramin ilā ḥaramin bi-idhni Allāhi l-muʻīni and Your moon, which by the leave of Allah, the Helper, journeyed by night from one sanctuary to another, al-mushāhidi li-rabbihi bi-ʻaynay raʼsihi fī l-maqāmi l-amīni · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna who witnessed his Lord with the two eyes of his head, in the secure station, and upon his family, and grant peace to them all. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin aṣ-ṣādiqi l-amīni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Truthful, the Trustworthy, wa-n-nadhīri l-mubīni · wa-raḥmati Allāhi li-l-ʻālamīna 227

the clear warner, and the mercy of Allah to the worlds, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna · bi-qadri barakātika l-ḥāṣilati li-ahli ssamāwāti wa-ahli l-araḍīna and upon his family, and grant peace to them all, in the measure of Your graces that have come to the inhabitants of the heavens and the inhabitants of the earths, wa-l-ṭuf binā luṭfan yalīqu bi-karamika wa-iḥsānika yā rabba l-ʻālamīna and deal gently with us, with a gentle kindness that befits Your generosity and beneficence, O Lord of the worlds. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-fātiḥi li-aqfāli qulūbi lmuʼminīna bi-asrāri ʻulūmi l-Qurʼāni l-mubīni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the opener of the locks of the hearts of the believers with the secrets of the sciences of the clear Qur’an, wa-l-khātimi li-jamāʻati l-anbiyāʼi wa-l-mursalīna · wa-n-nāṣiri li-muḥibbīhi bi-nūrihi fī kulli waqtin wa-ḥīnin and the Seal of the company of the Prophets and the Messengers, and the supporter of those who love him, through his light, at every time and every moment, 228

ṣalātan adkhulu bihā fī ḥizbihi wa-anṣārihi l-mufliḥīna with a blessing by which I enter among his company and his supporters, the successful, ḥattā ashhadahu fī samāʼi rūḥī ka-sh-shamsi li-n-nāẓirīna until I witness him in the sky of my spirit, like the sun to those who look, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna and upon his family and Companions, and grant peace to them all. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kanzi Allāhi l-maknūni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the hidden treasure of Allah, alladhī mā kāna mithluhu wa-lā yakūnu the like of whom has never been and never will be, wāsiṭatu man amruhu bayna l-kāfi wa-n-nūni the intermediary of Him whose command lies between the Kaf and the Nun, fī tanazzulāti asrāri l-maʻārifi wa-l-funūni in the descents of the secrets of gnosis and the branches of learning, 229

ʻalā kulli qalbin maṣūnin · wa-sirruhu s-sārī fī dharrāti ʻulwiyyāti wasufliyyāti kulli kūnin upon every guarded heart, and his secret, which pervades the particles of the higher and lower things of every realm of being, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-khtim lanā bi-ḥusni l-khātimati ʻinda l-manūni and upon his family, and grant peace; and conclude our lives with a good ending at the hour of death. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-ḥikmati wa-l-ʻadli O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of wisdom and justice, wa-afḍali ahli l-faḍli · al-āmiri bi-l-jiddi wa-l-qawli l-faṣli the most excellent of the people of excellence, who commands earnestness and the decisive word, wa-n-nāhī ʻani l-hazli · ṭayyibi l-farʻi wa-l-aṣli and forbids frivolity, pure in branch and root, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim sādāti ahli l-ḥarami wa-l-ḥilli and upon his family, and grant peace, the masters of the people of the Sanctuary and of the land beyond it, 230

ʻadada kulli wābilin wa-ṭallin · wa-ʻadada kulli zāʼirin ilā ṭ-ṭayyibi rtaḥala the number of every downpour and drizzle, and the number of every visitor who has journeyed to the Pure One, wa-sallim ʻalayhi ʻinda khayri rawḍatin wa-maḥallin and grant peace upon him at the best of gardens and places, ṣalātan taftaḥu lanā bihā bi-l-fatḥi wa-taḥqīqi l-amali a blessing by which You open for us, with the opening and the fulfilment of hope, wa-taḥfaẓunā bihā min sharri l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani wa-l-malali and by which You protect us from the evil of worry, grief and weariness, wa-l-ʻajzi wa-l-kasali · yā arḥama r-rāḥimīna and from helplessness and sloth, O Most Merciful of the merciful. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī malaʼta qalbahu min jalāli ʻuẓmatika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose heart You filled with the majesty of Your greatness, 231

wa-ʻaynahu min jamāli rubūbiyyatika · wa-ṣadrahu min ʻulūmi ṣamadāniyyatika and his eye with the beauty of Your Lordship, and his breast with the knowledge of Your absolute self-sufficiency, fa-ṣāra qalbuhu khāshiʻan wa-naẓaruhu shāfiʻan so his heart became humble and his gaze intercessory, wa-ʻilmuhu nāfiʻan · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ʻalā qadri inʻāmika ʻalayhi and his knowledge beneficial, and upon his family, and grant peace, in proportion to Your bestowal of favour upon him, wa-thanāʼihi ʻalayka · wa-rzuqnā Allāhumma barakata tawḥīdika wa-ṣṣalāta ʻalayhi and his praise of You, and grant us, O Allah, the grace of affirming Your oneness and the sending of blessings upon him, yā man ilayhi l-marjiʻu wa-l-muʻawwalu ʻalayhi O You to whom is the return, and on whom reliance is placed, 232

yā ilāha l-awwalīna wa-l-ākhirīna · wa-salāmun ʻalā l-mursalīna · wa-lḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi l-ʻālamīna O God of the first and the last. And peace be upon the Messengers, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika n-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi lladhī manaʻta bihi nuzūla l-ʻadhābi ʻalā man aʻraḍū maʻa tawallīhim wa-anzalta ʻalayhi qawlaka “wa-mā kāna Allāhu liyuʻadhdhibahum wa-anta fīhim” al-ʻazīzi r-raʼūfi r-raḥīmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, through whom You withheld the coming down of punishment upon those who turned away and turned their backs, and upon whom You sent down Your saying, “Allah would never punish them while you are among them” (Qur’an 8:33), the honoured, the compassionate, the merciful, alladhī jaʻalta bayʻatahu bayʻataka · wa-ṭāʻatahu ṭāʻataka ʻalā qadri riḍwānika ʻalā ahli maḥabbatika 233

whose pledge of allegiance You made Your own pledge of allegiance, and whose obedience You made Your own obedience, in proportion to Your good pleasure with the people of Your love, wa-sallim taslīman wa-rḍa ʻan aṣḥābihi wa-rḥam ummatahu yā arḥama rrāḥimīna and grant complete peace, and be pleased with his Companions, and have mercy on his community, O Most Merciful of the merciful. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika nabiyyi r-raḥmati r-raʼūfi r-raḥīmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the Prophet of mercy, the compassionate, the merciful, alladhī arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna · wa-imāmi l-anbiyāʼi wa-lmursalīna whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds, and the leader of the Prophets and the Messengers, wa-khātami n-nabiyyīna · wa-shafīʻi l-mudhnibīna · wa-sayyidi waladi Ādama ajmaʻīna 234

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika n-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi ṣ-ṣādiqi l-amīni l-maʼmūni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, the Truthful, the Trustworthy, the Trusted, 235

alladhī bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi nadkhulu fī luṭfi Allāhi s-sarīʻi lladhī bihi kullu amrin yahūnu by sending blessings upon whom we enter into Allah’s swift gentle kindness, through which every matter becomes easy, wa-asʼaluka Allāhumma yā man idhā arāda shayʼan yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu and I ask You, O Allah, O You who, when He wills a thing, says to it “Be!” and it is, kawwin lī bughyatī wa-rzuqnī asrāra l-maʻārifi wa-l-funūni bring into being for me my desire, and grant me the secrets of gnosis and the branches of learning, wa-adkhilnī fī ḥifẓika l-manīʻi lladhī man dakhala fī dāʼiratihi fa-huwa lmaḥfūẓu l-maknūnu and admit me into Your impregnable protection, such that whoever enters its circle is the protected, the sheltered one, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-jʻalnī Allāhumma min ahli ʻawnika yā qawiyyu yā muʻīnu and upon his family, and grant peace; and make me, O Allah, one of the people of Your help, O Strong One, O Helper. 236

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-bashīri lladhī bashshara lmuʼminīna bi-l-ḥusnā wa-ziyādatin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the bearer of glad tidings, who gave the believers glad tidings of the best [reward] and more, wa-hadāhum bi-idhnika ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīmin and guided them, by Your leave, to a straight path, ar-raʼūfi r-raḥīmi · dhī l-khuluqi l-ʻaẓīmi the compassionate, the merciful, of sublime character, al-ḥalīmi lladhī lā yaghḍabu illā li-rabbihi the forbearing, who is angered only for the sake of his Lord, alladhī kāna lā yafzaʻu ʻinda l-karbi illā li-rabbihi who, in times of distress, would turn for help to none but his Lord, dhī l-qalbi s-salīmi · wa-n-nūri l-ʻamīmi of sound heart, and the all-embracing light, alladhī min ʻilmihi l-ʻulūmu · wa-min sirrihi l-asrāru from whose knowledge come the sciences, and from whose secret come the secrets, 237

wa-min nūrihi l-anwāru · aṣ-ṣādiqi l-amīni and from whose light come the lights, the Truthful, the Trustworthy, rasūli rabbi l-ʻālamīna · wa-imāmi l-anbiyāʼi wa-l-mursalīna the Messenger of the Lord of the worlds, and the leader of the Prophets and the Messengers, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallim ajmaʻīna and upon his family and Companions, and grant peace to them all. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī akhadhta l-mīthāqa lahu ʻalā l-mursalīna wa-n-nabiyyīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, for whom You took the covenant from the Messengers and the Prophets, ʻalā an yuʼminū bihi wa-yanṣurūhu that they would believe in him and support him, fa-aqarrū ajmaʻīna · wa-kunta shāhidan ʻalayhim wa-anta khayru shshāhidīna and they all acknowledged it, and You were a witness over them, and You are the best of witnesses; 238

fa-lammā ḥaḍara baynahum laylata l-miʻrāji l-mubīna ṣallā bihim imāman wa-kānū bihi muʼtammīna and when he was present among them on the night of the manifest Ascension (Miʻraj), he led them in prayer as imam, and they followed him in the prayer, li-iẓhāri faḍlihi ʻalayhim · idh huwa raḥmatu Allāhi li-l-ʻālamīna in order to make manifest his excellence over them, since he is the mercy of Allah to the worlds, as-sābiqīna minhum wa-l-mustaʼkhirīna · wa-khātamu n-nabiyyīna wa-lmursalīna the earlier among them and the later, and the Seal of the Prophets and the Messengers, ʻalayhi wa-ʻalayhim afḍalu ṣalāti l-muṣallīna wa-ajallu salāmi l-musallimīna upon him and upon them be the most excellent blessing of those who send blessings, and the most exalted peace of those who give peace. 239

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin aṭ-ṭayyibi lladhī ṭāba biṭaybatihi maqīlu l-qāʼilīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Pure One, by whose purity the resting place of those who take their midday rest became pleasant, wa-stanshaqat min aʻṭārihi arwāḥu l-ʻārifīna and whose perfumes the spirits of those who know Allah inhaled, fa-hāmū bi-maḥabbatihi fī l-muḥibbīna · wa-fataḥa Allāhu lahum bāba ttaʻarrufi ilayhi fa-ṣārū min ahli l-yaqīni so they were lost in love for him, among the lovers, and Allah opened for them the door of coming to know Him, so they became people of certainty, wa-yassarahumu Allāhu fī dunyāhum fa-ṣārū mina l-muyassarīna and Allah made their way easy in their worldly life, so they became among those granted ease, wa-ʻarafū jalāla rabbihim fa-ṣārū minhu mina l-khāʼifīna and they came to know the majesty of their Lord, so they became among those who fear Him, wa-ʻamilū bi-s-sunnati wa-l-kitābi fa-kānū mina l-ʻāmilīna 240

and they acted upon the Sunna and the Book, so they were among those who act upon them, wa-ṣārū li-kitābihi mina t-tālīna · wa-lahajū bi-dhikrihi fī kulli waqtin waḥīnin and they became among those who recite His Book, and they were devoted to His remembrance at every time and every moment, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā khḍarra l-yaqṭīnu and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as the gourd plant grows green, wa-fāḥat rawāʼiḥu l-yāsimīni · ṣalātan muʻaṭṭaratan bi-rawāʼiḥi l-jannati wayarḍā bihā ʻannā rabbu l-ʻālamīna and the fragrances of jasmine spread, with a blessing perfumed with the fragrances of Paradise, and through which the Lord of the worlds is pleased with us. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin saʻdi Allāhi l-mabʻūthi li-lkhalqi bi-s-saʻādati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the good fortune of Allah, sent to creation with happiness, ṣāḥibi d-darajati wa-s-siyādati · wa-l-ʻilmi wa-l-ifādati 241

possessor of rank and mastership, of knowledge and the conferring of benefit, wa-l-juyūshi wa-l-qiyādati · wa-l-Qurʼāni wa-l-ʻibādati · wa-dh-dhikri wa-ttilāwati of armies and command, of the Qur’an and worship, of remembrance and recitation, wa-r-rushdi wa-l-hidāyati · wa-l-īmāni wa-l-ʻināyati · wa-l-islāmi wa-lwilāyati of rectitude and guidance, of faith and care, of Islam and friendship with Allah, wa-l-ḥanāni wa-s-salāmati · wa-l-ikhlāṣi wa-sh-shajāʻati · wa-l-ʻulūmi wa-ddirāyati of tenderness and well-being, of sincerity and courage, of the sciences and deep understanding, wa-l-khushūʻi wa-l-inābati · wa-l-liwāʼi wa-r-rāyati · wa-t-taʻaffufi wa-nnazāhati of reverent humility and penitent return, of the banner and the standard, of self-restraint and integrity, 242

wa-l-yaqīni wa-z-zahādati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · wa-bārik ilā yawmi lqiyāmati of certainty and renunciation, and upon his family, and grant peace, and grant grace until the Day of Resurrection. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tadullunā bihā ʻalā khayri l-ʻamali O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which You guide us to the best of deeds, wa-tarfaʻunā bihā wa-taḥuffunā bihā bi-l-amni l-ajalli and by which You raise us and surround us with the most exalted security, wa-taṣrifu bihā ʻannā l-hamma wa-l-kasala and by which You turn away from us worry and sloth, wa-l-wasāwisa wa-z-zalala · Allāhumma yā man lahu qudratun wa-sulṭānun and whisperings and slips. O Allah, O You who have power and authority, 243

wa-maḥajjatun wa-burhānun · wa-karamun wa-iḥsānun · ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin bni ʻadnāni and a clear path and proof, and generosity and beneficence, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, descendant of ʻAdnan, ʻadada mā yakūnu wa-mā kāna the number of all that will be and all that has been, ṣalātan tarzuqunā bihā ṣiḥḥata l-qulūbi wa-l-abdāni a blessing by which You grant us the health of hearts and bodies, wa-nūra t-tawḥīdi wa-l-īmāni · wa-barakata l-ḥadīthi wa-l-Qurʼāni and the light of the affirmation of Allah’s oneness, and of faith, and the grace of the hadith and the Qur’an, wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi mā dāra falaku z-zamāni and grant peace upon him and upon his family for as long as the sphere of time turns, wa-taḥarrakat bi-n-naẓari l-ʻaynāni · wa-htazzati l-ashjāru wa-l-aghṣānu and the two eyes move as they look, and the trees and branches sway, 244

wa-rtafaʻat ʻani l-muslimīna l-akdāru wa-l-aḥzānu and troubles and sorrows are lifted from the Muslims. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika l-ḥāmidi l-maḥmūdi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the Praiser, the Praised, wa-sh-shāhidi ʻalā khalqika fī l-yawmi l-mashhūdi and the witness over Your creation on the Day that is witnessed, alladhī saṭaʻat fī l-kawni anwāruhu whose lights blazed forth across the universe, wa-ʻammati d-dunyā bi-l-khayri akhbāruhu · alladhī jāʼati l-wufūdu liziyāratihi min jamīʻi l-bilādi and whose tidings pervaded this world with goodness, to visit whom delegations came from all lands, 245

bi-l-ḥubbi wa-sh-shawqi wa-l-widādi · wa-naẓarū ilayhi bi-l-qulūbi fa-zdādati l-qulūbu īmānan fa-shakarūka yā rabbi wa-zdādū islāman wa-iḥsānan with love, longing and affection, and they looked upon him with their hearts, and their hearts grew in faith, so they thanked You, O my Lord, and grew in Islam and in excellence. Allāhumma hādhā ḥabībuka wa-anta tuḥibbuhu O Allah, this is Your Beloved, and You love him, wa-tuḥibbu man yuḥibbuhu · wa-tuṣallī ʻalā man yuṣallī ʻalayhi and You love whoever loves him, and You send blessings upon whoever sends blessings upon him, wa-shaffaʻtahu fī zuwwārihi fa-shaffiʻhu fīnā and You have accepted his intercession for those who visit him, so accept his intercession for us, wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi taslīman kathīran ilā yawmi d-dīn and grant abundant peace upon him and upon his family until the Day of Judgement. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻayni l-ʻināyati 246

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the wellspring of care, wa-imāmi l-hidāyati · wa-muzīli l-ghawāyati · wa-rasūli s-salāmati and the leader of guidance, and the remover of misguidance, and the Messenger of well-being, wa-l-barakati wa-l-amānati · wa-l-ʻadli wa-l-istiqāmati · wa-sh-sharafi wa-lkarāmati and of grace and trustworthiness, and of justice and uprightness, and of nobility and dignity, wa-l-wajhi l-munīri · wa-l-jayshi l-ghafīri · wa-l-ʻilmi wa-l-kitābi and of the radiant face, and of the vast army, and of knowledge and the Book, wa-s-sunnati wa-ṣ-ṣawābi · wa-l-islāmi wa-l-īmāni · wa-tilāwati l-Qurʼāni and of the Sunna and rightness, and of Islam and faith, and of the recitation of the Qur’an, wa-l-ʻafwi wa-l-ghufrāni · wa-l-faṣāḥati wa-l-bayāni · an-nabiyyi l-maḥbūbi ṣṣādiqi l-maṣdūqi and of pardon and forgiveness, and of eloquence and clarity of expression, the beloved Prophet, the Truthful, the one confirmed as 247

truthful, al-mufaḍḍali l-fāḍili · al-mukammali l-kāmili · al-muqaddami l-miqdāmi the favoured, the excellent, the perfected, the perfect, the one given precedence, the dauntless, al-muṣallī bi-l-layli wa-n-nāsu niyāmun · nabiyyi l-khayri wa-ṣ-ṣalāḥi who prays by night while people sleep, the Prophet of goodness and righteousness, wa-l-hudā wa-l-iṣlāḥi · wa-d-daʻwati ilā l-yaqīni · wa-l-fatḥi wa-t-tamkīni · wa-s-sirri l-mubīni and of guidance and reform, and of the call to certainty, and of victory and empowerment, and of the manifest secret. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, alladhī fa-taḥta lahu fatḥan mubīnan to whom You granted a clear victory, fasurra wa-stabshara · wa-dakhala l-bayta l-ʻatīqa wa-hallala wa-kabbara 248

so he was gladdened and rejoiced, and he entered the Ancient House and proclaimed “There is no god but Allah” and “Allah is Greatest”, wa-adkhalta s-surūra ʻalayhi · wa-ʻalā aṣḥābihi wa-ahli baytihi and You brought joy to him, and to his Companions and the People of his House, fa-laka l-ḥamdu ʻalā dhālika · ḥamdan yalīqu bi-jalālika wa-kamālika wafariḥa l-baytu wa-astāruhu so praise be Yours for that, praise that befits Your majesty and perfection; and the House and its coverings rejoiced, wa-l-ḥaramu wa-anwāruhu · wa-jāʼa naṣru Allāhi wa-l-fatḥu and so did the Sanctuary and its lights, and the help of Allah came, and the victory, wa-ṣadaqa Allāhu waʻdahu wa-naṣara ʻabdahu and Allah made good His promise and helped His servant, wa-aʻazza jundahu · fa-laka l-ḥamdu ʻalā dhālika yā man naṣara nabiyyahu ʻalā aʻdāʼihi l-jāḥidīna and gave might to His army, so praise be Yours for that, O You who gave His Prophet victory over his enemies, the deniers, 249

wa-sharaḥa ṣadrahu wa-yassara amrahu wa-jaʻalahu fī d-dunyā wa-lākhirati raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna and expanded his breast and eased his affair and made him, in this world and the Hereafter, a mercy to the worlds, wa-shafīʻan li-l-mudhnibīna · wa-sallimi Allāhumma ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi warḥamnā bi-raḥmatika yā arḥama r-rāḥimīna and an intercessor for sinners, and grant peace, O Allah, upon him and upon his family, and have mercy on us through Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī rafaʻta bihi l-ʻadhāba ʻani l-ummati wa-khāṭabtahu bi-qawlika “wa-mā kāna Allāhu li-yuʻadhdhibahum wa-anta fīhim” O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, through whom You lifted punishment from the community, and whom You addressed with Your saying, “Allah would never punish them while you are among them” (Qur’an 8:33), fa-hādhā n-nabiyyu lladhī jāʼa bi-l-Qurʼāni raḥmatan wa-shifāʼan li-lmuʼminīna 250

for this is the Prophet who brought the Qur’an as a mercy and a healing for the believers, wa-sāda walada Ādama ajmaʻīna · wa-ddakhara shafāʻatahu li-ahli l-kabāʼiri min ummatihi yawma yaqūmu n-nāsu li-rabbi l-ʻālamīna and who became master of all the children of Adam, and who stored up his intercession for those of his community guilty of major sins on the Day when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds, fa-qāla ʻalayhi ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu “daʻwatī shafāʻatī ddakhartuhā li-ahli lkabāʼiri min ummatī” Allāhumma adkhilnā fī shafāʻatihi wa-fī raḥmatihi wafī jāhihi l-ʻaẓīmi and so he said, upon him be blessings and peace, “My supplication —my intercession—I have stored up for those of my community guilty of major sins.” O Allah, admit us into his intercession, and into his mercy, and into his great standing. wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman aslamu bihi mina l-fitani mā ẓahara minhā wa-mā baṭana And grant peace upon him and upon his family, a peace by which I am kept safe from the trials, both what is apparent of them and what is hidden, 251

fī kulli waqtin wa-ḥīnin · wa-salāmun ʻalā l-mursalīna wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi l-ʻālamīna at every hour and every moment. And peace be upon the Messengers, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī dakhala n-nāsu bi-daʻwatihi fī dīnika afwājan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, through whose call people entered Your religion in throngs, wa-farrajta bihi kuraba l-muʼminīna ifrājan and through whom You fully relieved the afflictions of the believers, wa-athlajta qulūbahum bi-nayli rughūbihim · fa-nālū mina l-khayri minālan and soothed their hearts with the attainment of their desires, so they attained a full measure of goodness, wa-aqbalū ʻalayka iqbālan · wa-adrakathum ʻināyataka fa-ṣārū ahla ʻināyatin 252

and turned to You wholeheartedly, and Your care overtook them, so they became people of care, wa-sāraʻū ilā naṣrika fa-adrakathumu l-wilāyatu and they hastened to Your help, so friendship with Allah overtook them. Allāhumma sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi ʻadada kulli mā huwa mafhūmun O Allah, grant peace upon him and upon his family, the number of everything that is understood, wa-ʻadada kulli manṭūqin naṭaqat bihi l-alsunu and the number of every utterance that tongues have spoken, wa-manẓūrin adrakathu l-aʻyunu · yā man lā tarāhu l-ʻuyūnu and of everything seen that eyes have perceived, O You whom eyes do not see, wa-lā tukhāliṭuhu ẓ-ẓunūnu · wa-lā yudriku kunha waṣfihi l-wāṣifūna and whom no conjectures can touch, and the true essence of whose description no describers can grasp, wa-amruhu bayna l-kāfi wa-n-nūni · wa-yaʻlamu min khalqihi mā yusirrūna wa-mā yuʻlinūna 253

and whose command lies between the Kaf and the Nun, and who knows of His creation what they conceal and what they reveal, ighfir lī mā kāna wa-mā yakūnu forgive me all that has been and all that will be, wa-adriknī bi-luṭfika fī l-ḥayāti wa-ʻinda l-manūni āmīna and reach me with Your gentle kindness in life and at the hour of death. Amin. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika s-sirāji l-munīri lladhī asraja qulūba l-muʼminīna fa-stanārat binūrihi wa-ṭmaʼannat O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the radiant lamp, who lit the hearts of the believers like lamps, so they were illumined by his light and grew tranquil, wa-nawwara arwāḥahum fa-shāhadat bi-nūrihi mushāhada anwāri asrāri maʻānī l-Qurʼāni l-karīmi and who illumined their spirits, so that through his light they witnessed the visions of the lights of the secrets of the meanings of the noble Qur’an, 254

wa-dh-dhikri l-ḥakīmi · fa-aynaʻat ashjāru jannatihā and of the wise Reminder, so the trees of their garden ripened, fa-sāraʻat ilā maghfiratin min rabbihā and so they hastened to forgiveness from their Lord, wa-gharradat ṭuyūru ashjārihā · bi-anghāmi shawqihā ilā liqāʼi rabbihā wamushāhadatihi wa-kushifa ʻan rūḥihā ḥijābu l-ghaflati and the birds of their trees warbled with the melodies of their longing to meet their Lord and to witness Him; and the veil of heedlessness was lifted from their spirits, wa-dakhalat miyādīna l-ḥaḍrati · fa-naẓarat wa-ʻarafat wa-samiʻat and they entered the fields of the Presence, so they beheld, came to know and heard; wa-sallim Allāhumma ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāma ṣ-ṣilati r-rūḥiyyati wa-lanwāri l-qudsiyyati and grant peace, O Allah, upon him and upon his family, the peace of the spiritual bond and of the sacred lights, 255

wa-l-fuyūḍāti r-rabbāniyyati · wa-jʻalhu rāḍiyan ʻannī muqbilan ʻalayya nāẓiran ilayya bi-naẓrātihi l-jamāliyyati and of the divine outpourings, and make him pleased with me, turned toward me, looking upon me with his glances of beauty, mubārikan ʻalayya bi-barakātihi n-nabawiyyati āmīn bestowing grace upon me with his prophetic graces. Amin. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī jāʼathu z-zuwwāru afwājan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, to whom the visitors came in throngs, wa-sallamū ʻalayhi fa-nazalat ʻalayhim raḥmatuka amwājan and they greeted him with peace, so Your mercy descended upon them in waves, wa-shakarū Allāha taʻālā ḥīnamā raʼawhu qamaran wa-sirājan and they thanked Allah, the Exalted, when they saw him as a moon and a lamp, 256

fa-zāda ḥubbuhum fīhi fa-shaffaʻahu Allāhu taʻālā fīhim wa-aʻṭāhu mā yurḍīhi so their love for him increased, and so Allah, the Exalted, accepted his intercession for them and gave him what pleases him, fa-ḥamida Allāhu wa-huwa Aḥmadu ḥāmidin li-llāhi and so he praised Allah, and he is the most praising of all who praise Allah, fa-fariḥa bi-ummatihi · fa-fariḥat bihi fa-akramahu Allāhu taʻālā wa-akrama ummatahu bihi and rejoiced in his community, and they rejoiced in him, so Allah, the Exalted, honoured him and honoured his community through him, wa-shaffaʻahu fīhim wa-sāqahum ilayhi · wa-lawlā tawfīqu Allāhi mā wafada ʻabdun ilayhi and accepted his intercession for them and led them to him, and were it not for Allah’s granting of success, no servant would have come to him, fa-huwa lladhī ḥabbabahu fīhim wa-ḥabbabahum fīhi for it is He who made him love them and made them love him, 257

fa-li-llāhi l-faḍlu awwalan wa-ākhiran ʻalā ḥabībihi wa-nabiyyihi so to Allah belongs the bounty, first and last, upon His Beloved and His Prophet, fa-laka l-ḥamdu yā rabbi an akramtanā bihi so praise be Yours, O my Lord, for having honoured us through him, wa-sharraftanā bi-risālatihi · wa-hadaytanā li-l-islāmi wa-l-īmāni and ennobled us with his message, and guided us to Islam and faith, wa-daʻawtanā ilā anwāri l-Qurʼāni · Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi midāda kalimātika and called us to the lights of the Qur’an. O Allah, send blessings upon him and upon his family, the ink of Your words, wa-ʻadada anwāri ḥikamika wa-āyātika · Allāhumma unṣur dīnahu ʻalā jamīʻi l-adyāni and the number of the lights of Your wisdoms and Your signs. O Allah, give victory to his religion over all religions, wa-ḥfaẓ ummatahu ṣallā Allāhu ʻalayhi wa-sallam min fitani z-zamāni and protect his community, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, from the trials of the age, 258

fa-innaka anta l-ḥafīẓu r-raḥīmu lladhī bi-yadihi taqallubu z-zamāni for truly it is You who are the Guardian, the Ever-Merciful, in whose hand is the turning of time, wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman yazdahiru bihi l-awānu and grant peace upon him and upon his family, a peace by which the times flourish, wa-yafraḥu bihi n-nabiyyu l-ʻadnāni · wa-ḥfaẓ ummatahu yā ḥafīẓu yā raḥīmu yā raḥmānu and by which the ʻAdnanite Prophet rejoices, and protect his community, O Guardian, O Ever-Merciful, O Most Merciful (Rahman). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī fariḥati l-qulūbu bi-ruʼyatihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, at whose sight the hearts rejoiced, wa-stanārati d-dunyā bi-baʻthatihi · wa-jāʼati z-zuwwāru afwājan ilā ṭaybatihi 259

and this world was illumined by his mission, and the visitors came in throngs to his Tayba (Medina), fa-ṭāba z-zamānu wa-l-makānu li-man sallamū ʻalayhi fī rawḍatihi so time and place became sweet for those who greeted him with peace in his Garden (al-Rawḍa); laqad ẓaharat ʻalayhimu l-anwāru · wa-shāhadū nūrahu lladhī yudhhibu li-laḥzāni wa-l-akdāri truly, the lights have appeared upon them, and they witnessed his light, which dispels sorrows and troubles, wa-fariḥat qulūbuhum wa-ṭābat anfusuhum bi-l-ḥuḍūri ʻinda ṭayyibin ṭābat bihi ṭaybatuhu wa-ṭāba tharāhā and their hearts rejoiced and their souls were delighted to be present beside a pure one through whom his Tayba became pure and its soil became sweet, idh annahu fīhā ka-sh-shamsi fī s-samāʼi for in it he is like the sun in the sky, wa-lawlāhu mā jāʼahā aḥadun min ahli l-arḍi wa-lā ahli s-samāʼi and were it not for him, none of the people of the earth or the people of the heavens would have come to it. 260

fa-sallamū ʻalayhi taslīma l-ʻāshiqīna l-muḥibbīna So they greeted him with peace, as ardent and devoted lovers do, fa-radda ʻalayhimu s-salāma fa-ghtanamū faḍla salāmi n-nadhīri l-mubīni and he returned their greeting of peace, and they seized the bounty of the greeting of peace from the clear warner, alladhī lawlāhu mā nazala Qurʼānun wa-lā buniyat masājidu li-l-muṣallīna without whom no Qur’an would have been sent down and no mosques would have been built for those who pray; wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman yuʻarrifunā bihi wa-yuqarribunā minhu and grant peace upon him and upon his family, a peace that makes us acquainted with him and draws us near to him, wa-yuwaffiqnā ilā ziyāratihi maʻa z-zāʼirīna and grants us success in visiting him along with the visitors. Allāhumma yā muḥsinu yā munʻimu O Allah, O Benefactor, O Bestower of favours, yā ḥannānu yā mannānu · yā raḥīmu yā raḥmānu O Tender One, O Munificent One, O Ever-Merciful, O Most Merciful (Raḥmān), 261

yā karīmu yā raʼūfu · yā ʻaṭūfu yā ʻafuwwu O Generous One, O Compassionate One, O Affectionate One, O Ever-Pardoning One, yā mutajāwizu yā muʻṭī · asʼaluka Allāhumma iḥsānaka l-qadīma O One who overlooks, O Giver, I ask You, O Allah, for Your ancient beneficence, yā qadīma l-iḥsāni · yā dāʼima l-iḥsāni O Ancient in beneficence, O Unceasing in beneficence; wa-asʼaluka Allāhumma niʻamaka wa-sh-shukra ʻalayhā ḥattā tadūma ʻalaynā wa-tazīda and I ask You, O Allah, for Your favours, and for gratitude for them, so that they may endure with us and increase; wa-asʼaluka Allāhumma ḥanānaka wa-minnataka wa-raḥmataka yā wāsiʻa rraḥmati and I ask You, O Allah, for Your tenderness, Your benefaction and Your mercy, O Vast in mercy; wa-asʼaluka Allāhumma karamaka yā mubdiʼa n-niʻami qabla stiḥqāqihā and I ask You, O Allah, for Your generosity, O Initiator of favours before they are deserved; 262

wa-asʼaluka Allāhumma raʼfataka l-ʻaẓīmata yā ʻaẓīma r-raʼfati and I ask You, O Allah, for Your great compassion, O Great in compassion; wa-adim ʻalayya Allāhumma ʻaṭfaka wa-ʻafwaka wa-tajāwuzaka wa-ʻaṭāʼaka and, O Allah, make Your affection, Your pardon, Your overlooking and Your giving continue upon me; wa-asʼaluka Allāhumma bi-kulli asmāʼika l-ḥusnā and I ask You, O Allah, by all Your Most Beautiful Names, wa-ṣifātika l-ʻulyā · wa-smika l-ʻaẓīmi l-aʻẓami and by Your Most Exalted Attributes, and by Your Name, the Great, the Greatest, al-karīmi l-akrami · an tuṣalliya ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika l-kāmili the Generous, the Most Generous, that You send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your perfect servant, alladhī huwa akmalu ʻabīdika fī hādhā l-ʻālami min banī Ādama · alladhī arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna who is the most perfect of Your servants in this world among the children of Adam, whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds. 263

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika n-nūri lladhī yamnaʻu shuʻāʻuhu wa-sāwisa sh-shayṭāni mina lqulūbi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the light whose radiance keeps the whisperings of Satan away from the hearts, wa-l-ḥabībi lladhī tastanīru bi-ḥubbihi l-qulūbu and the Beloved, through love of whom hearts are illumined, alladhī mā sakana ḥubbuhu qalban illā saʻida ṣāḥibuhu fī t-tawfīqi whose love has never settled in a heart without its owner finding felicity in divinely granted success, wa-lā ṣallā ʻalayhi muḥibbun illā ṣaḥibahu s-saʻdu wa-t-tawfīqu and no lover has ever sent blessings upon him without good fortune and success accompanying him, an-nabiyyu sh-shafīqu r-rafīqu · alladhī man akthara mina ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi farraja Allāhu ʻalayhi kulla karbin wa-ḍīqin the Prophet who is caring and gentle, such that whoever sends abundant blessings upon him, Allah relieves him of every affliction and distress, 264

alladhī bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi tatanawwaru l-arwāḥu by sending blessings upon whom the spirits are filled with light, wa-tanshaṭu l-ashbāḥu · wa-tugharridu ṭuyūru l-unsi ʻalā shajari l-maḥabbati lladhī rayḥānuhu qad fāḥa and the bodies are invigorated, and the birds of intimacy warble upon the trees of love, whose fragrant herbs have already spread their scent, fa-tanshaqu l-arwāḥu ʻuṭūrahu l-miskiyyati · wa-tahtazzu arḍu l-ashbāḥi bitaghrīdi ṭuyūrihi l-muṭribati l-ʻandalībiyyati so the spirits breathe in their musky perfumes, and the earth of the bodies is set quivering by the warbling of their enrapturing, nightingale-voiced birds, fa-taḥinnu l-arwāḥu ilā awṭānihā l-awwaliyyati so the spirits yearn for their original homelands, fa-tashtāqu ilā simāʻi “alastu bi-rabbikum” mina l-ḥaḍrati l-ilāhiyyati and long to hear “Am I not your Lord?” (Qur’an 7:172) from the Divine Presence, 265

fa-tasmaʻu l-khiṭāba mina l-āyāti l-qurʼāniyyati “yā ʻibādī lladhīna āmanū inna arḍī wāsiʻatun fa-iyyāya fa-ʻbudūni” and hear the address from the verses of the Qur’an: “O My servants who believe, My earth is indeed spacious, so worship Me alone” (Qur’an 29:56). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika n-nabiyyi lladhī awḥayta ilayhi waḥyan min ladunka O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the Prophet to whom You revealed a revelation from Yourself, fa-akhraja bihi n-nāsa mina ẓ-ẓulumāti ilā n-nūri and by it he brought people out of the darkness into the light, wa-raghghabahum fīmā ʻindaka wa-zahhadahum fī dāri l-ghurūri and made them yearn for what is with You and renounce the abode of delusion, fa-huwa n-nabiyyu d-dāʻī ilayka bi-idhnika so he is the Prophet who calls to You by Your leave, 266

wa-l-mujāhidu fī sabīlika bi-idhnika · alladhī aʻlayta bihi manāra l-islāmi fiʻlan and the striver in Your way by Your leave, through whom You have truly raised high the beacon of Islam, wa-faḍḍaltahu ʻalā kulli man nubbiʼa wa-ursila and You preferred him over everyone who was made a prophet and sent as a messenger, wa-kāna nabiyyan wa-Ādamu bayna ṭ-ṭīni wa-l-māʼi and he was a prophet while Adam was between the clay and the water, fa-huwa afḍalu man yamshī ʻalā l-arḍi wa-tuẓilluhu s-samāʼu so he is the most excellent of all who walk upon the earth and whom the sky shades, khātamu l-anbiyāʼi · wa-majdu l-awliyāʼi · kalimātuhu nūrāniyyatun the Seal of the Prophets, and the glory of the friends of Allah; his words are luminous, wa-rawāʼiḥuhu miskiyyatun · wa-dhurriyyatuhu khayru dhurriyyatin and his fragrances are musky, and his descendants are the best of descendants, 267

wa-ummatuhu khayru ummatin ukhrijat li-n-nāsi and his community is the best community brought forth for mankind; aqāmū ṣ-ṣalawāti wa-kabbarū takbīran · wa-ʻamarū l-ghazawāti wa-kānū yazʼarūna bihā zaʼīran they established the prayers and fully proclaimed Allah’s greatness, and they thronged the campaigns, roaring in them with a mighty roar, wa-suyūfuhum talmaʻu · wa-anwāruhum tasṭaʻu · wa-fī kulli amrin yaqūlūna ilā Allāhi l-maʼābu wa-l-marjiʻu while their swords gleamed, and their lights shone forth, and in every matter they say, “To Allah is the final destination and the return.” wa-sallimi Allāhumma ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi mā fāḥat rawāʼiḥu l-jannati And grant peace, O Allah, upon him and upon his family for as long as the fragrances of Paradise waft li-dh-dhākirīna Allāha bi-l-asḥāri bi-qulūbin muṭmaʼinnatin for those who remember Allah in the hours before dawn with tranquil hearts, 268

wa-waffiqnā Allāhumma li-l-ʻamali bi-l-kitābi wa-s-sunnati · āmīn and grant us success, O Allah, in acting upon the Book and the Sunna. Amin. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika l-bashīri l-mubashshari bihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the bearer of glad tidings, and the one foretold in glad tidings, alladhī bashshara bihi ʻĪsā bnu Maryama ʻalayhi s-salāmu fa-qāla “wamubashshiran bi-rasūlin yaʼtī min baʻdī smuhu Aḥmadu” fa-huwa Aḥmadu lḥāmidīna laka of whom Jesus, son of Mary, peace be upon him, gave glad tidings, saying, “and giving glad tidings of a messenger who will come after me, whose name is Ahmad” (Qur’an 61:6). So he is Ahmad, the most praising of those who praise You, alladhī lawlāhu mā ḥamidaka ḥāmidun without whom no one who praises would have praised You, 269

wa-lā sajada laka sājidun · wa-lā ṣuffat ṣufūfun li-l-jihādi fī sabīlika and no one who prostrates would have prostrated before You, and no ranks would have been drawn up for jihad in Your way, wa-lā stashhada l-mustashhidūna fa-adkhaltahum jannataka fa-nālū khayra naʻīmika and no martyrs would have been martyred, whom You then admitted into Your Paradise, where they attained the best of Your bliss. Allāhumma fa-jzihi ʻani l-islāmi wa-l-muslimīna aḥsana l-jazāʼi O Allah, so reward him, on behalf of Islam and the Muslims, with the finest reward, wa-anilhu l-maqāma l-maḥmūda lladhī yaʻlū bihi ʻalā sāʼiri l-mursalīna wa-lanbiyāʼi and grant him the Praiseworthy Station, by which he rises above all the Messengers and the Prophets, wa-shaffiʻhu fīnā shafāʻatan tuḥibbuhā wa-tarḍāhā and accept his intercession for us, an intercession that You love and are pleased with, 270

fa-tanālu n-nafsu min baʻdihā mina l-khayri mā yublighuhā mina r-riḍā munāhā so that after it the soul obtains such good as brings it, in contentment, to its heart’s desire. yā man lā tudrikuhu l-abṣāru O You whom eyes do not perceive, wa-huwa yudriku l-abṣāra · wa-huwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīru while He perceives all eyes, and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware. ulṭuf binā yā laṭīfu yā khabīru fīmā jarat bihi l-maqādīru Be gentle with us, O Subtle, Gentle One, O All-Aware, in what the divine decrees have brought to pass. wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman taṭmaʼinnu bihi l-qulūbu And grant peace upon him and upon his family, a peace through which hearts find tranquillity, wa-tughfaru bihi dh-dhunūbu · wa-tustaru bihi l-ʻuyūbu and through which sins are forgiven, and through which faults are concealed. yā man aḥāṭa bi-kulli shayʼin ʻilman O You who have encompassed all things in knowledge, 271

wa-ghafara dh-dhunūba karaman wa-ḥilman · “rabbi ghfir wa-rḥam wa-anta khayru r-rāḥimīna” (thalāthan) and have forgiven sins out of generosity and forbearance, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful” (Qur’an 23:118) (three times). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī sāqa ilā Makkata lhadya wa-l-budna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who drove the offerings and the sacrificial camels to Mecca, wa-waʻadtahu wa-aṣḥābahu wa-atbāʻahu jannata ʻadnin and to whom, together with his Companions and his followers, You promised the Garden of Eden, alladhī atḥaftahu bi-l-kamāli wa-l-jalāli wa-l-ḥusni whom You presented with the gifts of perfection, majesty and beauty, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā halla ghaythun min muznin and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as life-giving rain pours down from the rain clouds, 272

bi-ʻadadi kulli lamḥatin wa-sāʻatin wa-yawmin wa-shahrin wa-ʻāmin waqarnin by the number of every instant, hour, day, month, year and century, bi-ʻadadi anwāri kulli ʻilmin wa-fannin by the number of the lights of every science and art, wa-biʻadadi kulli qaryatin wa-waṭanin · mā shtāqa qalbun muḥibbun ilayhi wa-ḥanna and by the number of every village and homeland, for as long as a loving heart longs for him and pines, man atā bi-sh-sharīʻati wa-li-s-sunnati sanna him who brought the Sacred Law and laid down the Sunna, mā shtāqa mushtāqun ilayhi wa-min kathīri shawqihi anna for as long as a yearner yearns for him and, from the abundance of his longing, moans, wa-biʻadadi mā naṣabat mina l-manṣūbāti (an) and by the number of the words that “an” has put in the accusative, wa-biʻadadi mā khafaḍat mina l-makhfūḍāti (ʻan) and by the number of the words that “ʻan” has put in the genitive, 273
