wa-biʻadadi kulli jayshin yuqātilu l-kuffāra wa-li-l-ighārati shanna and by the number of every army that fights the disbelievers and launches a raid, ṣalātan taḥfaẓunā bihā mina l-ʻajzi wa-l-kasali wa-ḍ-ḍaʻfi wa-l-wahani with a blessing through which You protect us from incapacity, laziness, weakness and frailty, mā ʻarafa l-qalbu ḥubba r-raqībi wa-sakana for as long as the heart knows the love of the Ever-Watchful and is at rest, fa-staghnā bihi ʻan muʼānisin tasmaʻuhu l-udhunu and so finds sufficiency in Him, without need of a companion whom the ear can hear, mā nfalaqa ṣubḥun wa-jāʼa laylun wa-janna for as long as the morning breaks, and night comes and draws its veil, mā shtāqati l-qulūbu li-jaddi l-ḥusayni wa-l-ḥasani for as long as hearts yearn for the grandfather of al-Husayn and alHasan, wa-naẓarū ilayhi bi-qulūbihim naẓrata muḥibbin bi-l-ghayri mā ftatana 274

and gaze upon him with their hearts, with the gaze of a lover who is not beguiled by any other. Allāhumma mlaʼ qulūbanā min ḥubbihi ṣallā Allāhu ʻalayhi wa-sallama ḥattā nashhadahu ṣallā Allāhu ʻalayhi wa-sallama fī s-sirri wa-l-ʻalani O Allah, fill our hearts with love of him, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, until we witness him, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, in secret and in the open; wa-naʻūdhu bika Allāhumma mina l-kufri wa-shirki ahli sh-shirki wa-lwathani and we seek refuge in You, O Allah, from disbelief and from the polytheism of the people of polytheism and idolatry; wa-ḥfaẓnā bi-ḥifẓika l-muḥīṭi ṭūla l-ḥayāti wa-z-zamani and protect us with Your all-encompassing protection throughout the length of life and time, mā jāʼa r-rawḍata zuwwāru sh-shāmi wa-l-yamani wa-aʻājimu l-bilādi waʻadanin for as long as visitors from Syria and Yemen, and the non-Arabs of the lands and of Aden, come to the Garden (al-Rawḍa), bi-ʻadadi mā kharajat rūḥun min jasadin wa-badanin by the number of times that a spirit departs from a body and a frame; 275

wa-bika Allāhumma nastaʻīdhu mina l-fitani mā ẓahara minhā wa-mā baṭana and in You, O Allah, we seek refuge from the trials, both those that are apparent and those that are hidden. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika n-nadhīri l-mubīni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the clear warner, alladhī ātaytahu sabʻan mina l-mathānī wa-l-Qurʼāna l-ʻaẓīma to whom You gave seven of the oft-repeated [verses] and the Great Qur’an, wa-arsaltahu shāhidan wa-mubashshiran wa-nadhīran · wa-dāʻiyan ilayka bi-idhnika wa-sirājan munīran and whom You sent as a witness, a bearer of glad tidings and a warner, and as one who calls to You by Your leave, and as a radiant lamp, wa-arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna · wa-jaʻaltahu imāma l-anbiyāʼi wa-lmursalīna 276

and whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds, and whom You made the leader of the Prophets and the Messengers, wa-khātama n-nabiyyīna · wa-sayyidi waladi Ādama ajmaʻīna and the Seal of the Prophets, and the master of all the children of Adam, ash-shafīʻi l-maʼmūni l-amīni · alladhī bihi rafaʻta l-ʻadhāba ʻani l-arḍi the intercessor, the trusted one, the Trustworthy, through whom You lifted punishment from the earth, wa-anzalta r-raḥmata wa-anta arḥamu r-rāḥimīna and sent down mercy, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful, wa-jaʻalta bayʻatahu bayʻataka · wa-ṭāʻatahu ṭāʻataka and made allegiance to him allegiance to You, and obedience to him obedience to You, wa-khāṭabtahu bi-qawlika “inna lladhīna yubāyiʻūnaka innamā yubāyiʻūna Allāha” and addressed him with Your words, “Truly, those who pledge allegiance to you pledge allegiance only to Allah” (Qur’an 48:10), “man yuṭiʻi r-rasūla fa-qad aṭāʻa Allāha” wa-ʻalā ālihi ṭ-ṭayyibīna ṭ-ṭāhirīna 277

“Whoever obeys the Messenger has indeed obeyed Allah” (Qur’an 4:80); and upon his family, the good and the pure, wa-sallim taslīman wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi l-ʻālamīna and grant peace in full measure; and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. 278

Wird Yawm al-Jumuʻa Friday J U M P T O P R AY E R 1–10 11–20 21–30 31–40 41–50 51–56 O P E N I N G · R E C I T E D E A C H D AY al-ḥamdu li-llāhi wa-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʻalā sayyidinā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadin rasūli Allāhi wa-ʻalā ālihi fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi All praise is for Allah, and blessings and peace be upon our master and patron Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, and upon his family, in every glance and every breath, by the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses, wa-raḍiya Allāhu ʻan shaykhaynā sayyidī Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi and may Allah be pleased with our two shaykhs: my master Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, wa-sayyidī ʻabdi l-ghaniyyi Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi wa-arḍāhumā and my master ʻAbd al-Ghanī Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, and may He make them well pleased, 279

wa-jaʻala l-jannata mutaqallabahumā wa-mathwāhumā and make Paradise their resort and their abode. wa-nfaʻnā Allāhumma bi-jāhihimā ʻindaka yā Allāhu And benefit us, O Allah, through their standing with You, O Allah. Allāhumma innī uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday kulli nafasin walamḥatin wa-ṭarfatin yaṭrifu bihā ahlu s-samāwāti wa-ahlu l-arḍi wakulli shayʼin huwa fī ʻilmika kāʼinun aw qad kāna uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday dhālika kullihi O Allah, I offer to You, in the presence of every breath, every glance and every blink with which the people of the heavens and the people of the earth blink, and of everything that is in Your knowledge, whether it is yet to be or has already come to be — I offer to You, in the presence of all of that, [the prayers that follow]. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan anālu bihā riḍāka wariḍāhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which I attain Your good pleasure and his, 280

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi and upon his family, and grant peace, in every glance and breath, the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻayni l-ʻināyati wa-bābi lwilāyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the very essence of divine care and the gateway of sainthood, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-kshif lanā ʻan sirri kulli sūratin wa-āyatin and upon his family, and grant peace; and unveil for us the secret of every surah and every verse. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī lammā samiʻa s-sabuʻu smahu dhahaba ilā l-barriyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, at whose name, when the lion heard it, it went off into the wilderness, wa-taraka ṭ-ṭarīqa fa-salimati l-jamʻiyyatu wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan ṭayyibatan haniyyatan 281

and left the road, so the company was kept safe; and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing that is good and wholesome. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī khāṭabahu ḍ-ḍabbu waaqarra bi-r-risālati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom the desert lizard addressed and whose messengership it acknowledged, wa-asmaʻahu faṣīḥa l-maqālati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi thawābi kulli nubuwwatin wa-risālatin and made him hear eloquent speech, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the rewards of every prophethood and messengership. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥabībi Allāhi wa-nabiyyi Allāhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Beloved of Allah and the Prophet of Allah, wa-rasūli Allāhi · wa-khayri khalqi Allāhi wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi ikrāmi Allāhi li-man āmana bi-llāhi and the Messenger of Allah, and the best of Allah’s creation; and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the honours Allah grants to whoever believes in Allah. 282

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin maʻdini l-kamālāti lkhuluqiyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the mine of the perfections of character, wa-manbaʻi l-ʻulūmi l-ladunniyyati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli jahrin wa-niyyatin and the wellspring of the sciences given directly by Allah (al-ʻulūm al-ladunniyya), and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of everything spoken aloud and every intention. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kāshifi l-ghummati wa-ʻālī lhimmati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the remover of gloom and the one of lofty resolve, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-bārik lahu fī l-ummati and upon his family, and grant peace; and grant him grace in the community (umma). 283

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khayri mudhakkirin bi-ʻilmihi wa-l-ʻādili fī ḥarbihi wa-silmihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the best reminder through his knowledge, and the one who is just in his war and in his peace, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · bi-ʻadadi qaḍāʼi Allāhi wa-ḥukmihi and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of Allah’s decrees and His judgements. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin adh-dhākiri li-llāhi fī yaqaẓatihi wa-nawmihi · wa-laḥẓatihi wa-yawmihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the one who remembers Allah in his waking and in his sleep, and in his moment and in his day. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin as-saʻīdi lladhī asʻada n-nāsa bi-saʻdihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the fortunate one, who made people fortunate through his good fortune, al-ʻazīzi lladhī aʻazza ummatahu bi-dīnihi wa-majdihi 284

the mighty one, who made his community mighty through his religion and his glory. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā zārati l-ḥusayna zawwāruhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, for as long as al-Husayn’s visitors visit him, wa-usrijat ʻalayhim anwāruhu · ṣalātan tuthbitu bihā ʻalā l-ḥaqqi anṣāruhu and his lights are kindled over them, with a blessing through which his supporters are made steadfast in the truth. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī aqsama Allāhu biḥayātihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, by whose life Allah swore, wa-ʻaṣrihi wa-baladihi · ṣalātan yafraḥu man talāhā wa-yadkhulu fī rubāhā and by his era and his city, with a blessing such that whoever recites it rejoices, and enters into its hills. 285

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā labbati l-ḥujjāju munādīhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, for as long as the pilgrims answer their caller, wa-aṭraba l-ʻīsa ḥādīhā · wa-ṣallā muṣallin raghībata l-fajri llatī hiya khayrun mina d-dunyā wa-mā fīhā and the camels’ driver delights them with his song, and a worshipper prays the highly recommended dawn prayer (raghībat al-fajr), which is better than this world and all that is in it. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-ummati l-islāmiyyati wa-rasūlihā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of the Muslim community (umma) and its Messenger, wa-biṭāʻatihi shurūquhā wa-wuṣūluhā · wa-bimukhālifatihi ḍayāʻuhā waufūluhā and through obedience to him come its rising and its arrival, and through disobedience to him come its loss and its setting. 286

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin as-sayyidi z-zakiyyi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the master, the pure, wa-z-zāhidi t-taqiyyi · al-ʻarabiyyi l-qurashiyyi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim biʻadadi kulli maytin wa-ḥayyin and the ascetic, the pious, the Arab, the Qurashite, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every dead and living being. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ʻaṭūfi z-zāhidi fī ḥuṭāmi d-dunyā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the affectionate Prophet, who renounced the fleeting goods of this world, aṭ-ṭayyibi fī l-mamāti wa-l-maḥyā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ātihi Allāhumma d-darajata l-ʻulyā the pure one in death and in life, and upon his family, and grant peace; and grant him, O Allah, the highest rank. 287

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī tuʻraḍu ʻalayhi aʻmālu ummatihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, to whom the deeds of his community are presented, fī maqāmi risālatihi bi-rawḍatihi · fa-yashkuru Allāha li-ahli ṭāʻatihi in the station of his messengership, at his Garden (al-Rawḍa), so he gives thanks to Allah for those who obey Him, wa-yastaghfiru Allāha li-ahli maʻṣiyatihi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ʻalā qadri darajātihi wa-manzilatihi and asks Allah’s forgiveness for those who disobey Him, and upon his family, and grant peace, in proportion to his ranks and his standing. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin dhikri Allāhi ilā khalqi Allāhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the reminder of Allah to Allah’s creation, wa-raḥmati Allāhi ilā khalīqati Allāhi and the mercy of Allah to Allah’s creatures, 288

wa-nukhbati Allāhi min bariyyati Allāhi and the choicest of Allah from among Allah’s created beings, wa-ʻalā ālihi alfu ṣalātin mina Allāhi and upon his family be a thousand blessings from Allah, wa-alfu salāmin mina Allāhi · ʻadada maʻlūmāti Allāhi · wa-midāda kalimāti Allāhi and a thousand salutations of peace from Allah, the number of the things known to Allah, and the ink of the words of Allah. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī tawakkala ʻalā mawlāhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who placed his trust in his Patron, fa-lam yakilhu ilā siwāhu · wa-ḥafiẓa ʻahda rabbihi wa-ballagha sharʻahu wa-addāhu so He did not entrust him to anyone other than Himself, and who kept the covenant of his Lord, conveyed His Sacred Law and delivered it, 289

wa-mā tawānā fī bāṭilin maḥāhu and who never slackened in effacing any falsehood, aw ḥaqqin aʻlāhu · fa-nāla min rabbihi bughyatahu wa-munāhu or in raising any truth on high, and so he gained from his Lord all that he sought and all that he wished for. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan takshifu bihā ʻani lummati l-ghummata O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which You lift the gloom from the community, wa-l-ḥawālika l-mudlahimmata · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and the jet-black, impenetrable darknesses, and upon his family, and grant peace; wa-ṣrif ʻan qalbī waswāsa s-sūʼi idhā ammahu · wa-ṣrif ʻanhu ẓulmatahu wahammahu and turn away from my heart the whispering of evil when it heads toward it, and turn away from it its darkness and its worry. 290

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī mani ttabaʻahu faqadi stamsaka bi-l-ʻurwati l-wuthqā lā nfiṣāma lahā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad — whoever follows him has grasped the most trustworthy handhold, which never breaks, wa-man aʻraḍa ʻanhu fa-qad ḍalla wa-lahan and whoever turns away from him has surely gone astray and been left bewildered, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ilā yawmi tukhriju l-arḍu athqālahā and upon his family, and grant peace until the day the earth brings forth its burdens. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyin kafā l-umama umūra dīnihā wa-dunyāhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a Prophet who took care, for the nations, of the affairs of their religion and of their life in this world, wa-bayyana lahā sabīla saʻdihā wa-shaqāhā and made clear to them the path to their happiness and to their wretchedness, 291

wa-rafaʻa shaʼnahā wa-aʻlāhā · wa-ballaghahā mina l-jannati munāhā and raised their standing and exalted them, and made them attain, of Paradise, all they wished for, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan lā tuḍāhā and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing that none can match. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yasṭaʻu ʻalā l-akwāni nūruhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing whose light shines over the realms of existence, wa-yadūru ʻalā l-muslimīna surūruhā · wa-yuḍrabu ʻalaynā ḥifẓuhā wasūruhā and whose joy circulates among the Muslims, and whose protection and rampart are set up around us, wa-yuraddu bihā ʻannā sūʼu d-dunyā wa-shurūruhā and through which the harm of this world and its evils are turned away from us, wa-ʻalā ālihi maṣābīḥa d-dunyā wa-nujūmihā 292

and upon his family, the lamps of this world and its stars. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-fātiḥi li-abwābi mughayyabāti asrāri jawāmiʻi l-kalimi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the opener of the doors of the hidden matters of the secrets of the allcomprehensive words, wa-lladhī minhu ʻilmu kulli ʻālimin wa-mā ʻalima and the one from whom comes the knowledge of every knower and of all that he knew, fa-huwa Madīnatu l-ʻilmi wa-ʻAliyyun bābuhā · wa-banūhu l-bararatu aqṭābuhā for he is the city of knowledge, and Ali is its gate, and his pious descendants are its spiritual poles. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī khallaṣa l-qalba rrahīna min rahni l-hawā wa-shahawātihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who redeemed the heart held in pledge from the bondage of desire and its appetites, 293

fa-uʻtiqa bi-āyāti Allāhi wa-kalimātihi · fa-lawlāhu lamā rufiʻa ʻani l-qulūbi rānuhā and so it was set free by the verses of Allah and His words, for were it not for him, the rust of the hearts would never have been lifted from them, wa-lā btahajat bi-l-islāmi l-arḍu wa-sukkānuhā and the earth and its inhabitants would not have rejoiced in Islam. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā tawajjahat ilayhi l-qulūbu li-iṣlāḥihā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as hearts turn to him to be set right, fa-nālat minhu bi-idhni Allāhi khayrahā wa-ṣalāḥahā wa-fatḥahā warabāḥahā and so obtain from him, by Allah’s leave, their good and their soundness and their breakthrough and their gain, wa-saʻdahā wa-najāḥahā wa-uzīla bihi bi-idhni Allāhi sharruhā wa-ṭalāḥuhā and their happiness and their success; and by him, by Allah’s leave, their evil and their corruption are removed. 294

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yanṣaliḥu bihā ḥālī O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which my condition is set right, wa-yahnaʼu bihā maqālī wa-akhluṣu bihā min awḥālī and through which my speech becomes pleasing and I am freed from my quagmires, wa-tataḥaqqaqu bihā āmālī · wa-yaḥsunu bihā maʼālī fī ḥayātī wa-baʻda ntiqālī and through which my hopes come true, and through which my final outcome is made good, in my life and after my passing. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan taṣilu rūḥī bi-rūḥihi waṣlan maʻnawiyyan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing that joins my spirit to his spirit in a spiritual union, ḥattā yufāḍa minhu ilayhā fayḍan ʻilmiyyan until an outpouring of knowledge is poured forth from him into it, 295

wa-tarqā bihi makānan ʻaliyyan · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · wa-qarribnā ilayhi qurban dhātiyyan and it rises through him to a lofty station, and upon his family, and grant peace; and bring us near to him with an essential nearness. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ẓaharat fī l-kawni barakātuhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose graces have become manifest throughout the universe, wa-rufiʻat ʻalā jamīʻi l-khalqi darajātuhu and whose ranks have been raised above all creation, wa-fāqat ʻalā jamīʻi l-aḥyāʼi ḥayātuhu and whose life has surpassed that of all living beings, wa-hadati l-ummata kalimātuhu · wa-baharati l-ʻuqūla muʻjizātuhu and whose words have guided the community, and whose miracles have dazzled the minds, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ahlu l-ʻilmi wa-ruwātuhu and upon his family, and grant peace, [and upon] the people of knowledge and his transmitters. 296

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā gharrada bulbulun bialḥānihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as a nightingale warbles with its melodies, wa-uṭriba sāmiʻun bi-karawānihi · wa-zdahā jīdun bi-ʻasjadihi wa-jumānihi and a listener is moved to rapture by his curlew, and a neck is resplendent with its gold and its pearls, wa-zdāna mawjun bi-luʼluʼihi wa-marjānihi · wa-ʻamara wādin bi-ahlihi wasukkānihi and a wave is adorned with its pearls and its coral, and a valley thrives with its people and its inhabitants, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ḥfaẓnā min sharri l-ʻālami min insihi wa-jānnihi and upon his family, and grant peace; and protect us from the evil of the world, from its humans and its jinn. 297

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ṣadaʻa bi-amri rabbihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who proclaimed the command of his Lord openly, fa-nāla n-naṣra d-dāʼima · wa-l-ʻizza l-qāʼima so he attained lasting victory, and firmly established might, wa-dalla ummatahu ʻalā kulli khayrin and directed his community to every good, wa-ḥadhdharahum min kulli sharrin · fa-sārū fī ṭarīqi Allāhi and warned them against every evil, so they travelled the path of Allah, ʻalā barakati Allāhi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi with the grace of Allah, and upon his family, and grant peace, in every glance and breath, the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses. 298

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan aghshā bihā nūran min anwārihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which I am enveloped in a light from among his lights, wa-anālu bihā sirran min asrārihi and through which I obtain a secret from among his secrets, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim · alladhī ṭalaʻat shamsu nubuwwatihi fī kamāli nahārihi and upon his family, and grant peace, the one whose sun of prophethood rose in the full perfection of its day, wa-tafajjarat yanābīʻu l-ḥikmati fī qulūbi l-muʼminīna min biḥāri ʻulūmihi wa-anhārihi and the springs of wisdom gushed forth in the hearts of the believers from the seas of his knowledge and his rivers. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin as-sarīʻi l-ghawthi li-man tawassala bihi wa-rajāhu 299

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, swift to bring succour to whoever makes him a means of approach and places hope in him, ṣalātan anālu bihā mina t-tawbati wa-l-maghfirati wa-n-najāti with a blessing through which I obtain repentance, forgiveness and deliverance, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi and upon his family, and grant peace, in every glance and breath, the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses, wa-rḍa ʻan aṣḥābihi wa-rḥam ummatahu wa-man wa-l-hu and be pleased with his Companions, and have mercy on his community and on whoever is loyal to him. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalawātaka llatī ṣallayta ʻalayhi bihā fī maqāmin kāna Allāhu wa-lā shayʼa maʻahu ilā an khalaqta Muḥammada bna ʻadnāna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, those blessings of Yours with which You blessed him in a station in which Allah was and nothing was with Him, until You created Muhammad, son of Adnan, 300

wa-lā shayʼa mina l-akwāni fa-kunta wa-lā ilāha siwāka and there was nothing of the realms of existence; so You were, and there was no god besides You, wa-kāna wa-lā makhlūqa siwāhu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-rzuqnā Allāhumma riḍāka wa-riḍāhu and he was, and there was no created being besides him, and upon his family, and grant peace; and grant us, O Allah, Your good pleasure and his. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nūri lladhī aḍāʼa qulūba lʻārifīna sirājuhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the light whose lamp has illuminated the hearts of those who know Allah, wa-baḥri maknūni ʻulūmika lladhī talāṭamat bi-l-asrāri amwājuhu and the ocean of Your concealed knowledge, whose waves surge with secrets, raḥmatuka l-mursalatu li-l-ʻawālimi l-ʻulwiyyati wa-s-sufliyyati Your mercy sent to the higher and lower worlds, 301

wāsiṭatika l-maqbūlu ʻindaka li-kashfi kulli shiddatin wa-baliyyatin Your intermediary, accepted with You for the removal of every hardship and calamity. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan talūḥu bihā ʻalā qalbī bāriqatun min bawāriqa anwārihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which a flash from among the flashes of his lights gleams upon my heart, wa-yaqṭuru ʻalā lubbī qaṭratun min nafāʼisi biḥārihi and a drop from the precious treasures of his oceans drips upon my inmost mind, ḥattā adkhula ilayhi bihi fī ḥaḍarāti asrārihi until, through him, I enter unto him, into the presences of his secrets, wa-akūna minhu lahu min junūdihi wa-anṣārihi and become, from him and for him, one of his soldiers and supporters, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā ashraqat ʻalā l-kawni shamsu nahārihi and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as the sun of its day shines upon the universe. 302

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tastaqīmu bihā nnufūsu mina ʻwijājihā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing through which souls are set straight from their crookedness, wa-tastanīru bi-bāhiri anwārihā · wa-yadhhabu ʻanhā ẓalāmuhā wafasāduhā and are illumined by the dazzling radiance of its lights, and their darkness and corruption depart from them, wa-yaẓharu ʻalayhā hidāyatuhā wa-irshāduhā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā rajaʻati l-arwāḥu ilā ajsādihā yawma baʻthihā wa-mīʻādihā and their guidance and right direction appear upon them, and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as spirits return to their bodies on the day of their raising and their appointed time. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yasurru n-nāẓirīna bunyānuhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing whose edifice gladdens those who behold it, 303

wa-yurawwiḥu l-qulūba rayḥānuhā · wa-yudhhibu r-rawʻa amānuhā and whose sweet-scented herbs refresh the hearts, and whose safety dispels fright, wa-tuzakhrifu l-jannata alwānuhā · wa-yarḍā bihā khazanatuhā wariḍwānuhā and whose colours adorn Paradise, and with which the keepers of Paradise, and Ridwan, are pleased, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā malaʼa l-qulūba birruhā wa-ḥanānuhā and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as its kindness and tenderness fill the hearts. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan bi-lā ḥaddin wa-lā ʻaddin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing without limit or number, mina ṣ-ṣamadi l-fardi l-aḥadi · wa-ahhili Allāhumma rūḥī li-t-talaqqī minhu ḥattā tastamidda from the Eternal Refuge, the Unique, the One, and, O Allah, make my spirit worthy to receive from him, until it draws sustenance, 304

wa-kshif lahā ḥijāba ghaflatihā kā tarā kamāla Aḥmada man ḥamida and lift from it the veil of its heedlessness, that it may see the perfection of Ahmad, the most praising of all who have praised, fa-yanẓura ilayhā naẓratan man wāfathu saʻida so that he may look upon it with a glance that brings happiness to whoever it reaches, ṣalātan taskunu bihā rūḥī fī masākini ḥubbihi a blessing through which my spirit dwells in the abodes of his love, taḥta riʻāyatihi wa-qurbihi · maʻa ahli wuddihi wa-ḥizbihi under his care and nearness, with those who love him, and with his party. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalāta l-wuddi wa-l-karāmati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing of affection and honour, fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ilā yawmi n-nushūri wa-l-qiyāmati in every blink of an eye and every breath until the Day of Raising and Resurrection, 305

wa-ʻajjil lanā Allāhumma bi-jāhihi bi-l-fawzi wa-s-salāmati and hasten for us, O Allah, by his exalted standing with You, success and safety, wa-sallimnā bi-ṣ-ṣalāti ʻalayhi min kulli ḥasratin wa-nidāmatin and keep us safe, through sending blessings upon him, from all anguish and remorse, wa-ftaḥ lanā wijhata t-taʻarrufi bihi ḥattā yarāhu l-qalbu amāmahu and open for us the way toward coming to know him, until the heart sees him in front of it, wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-ballighnā Allāhumma salāmahu and grant peace upon him and upon his family, and let his peace reach us, O Allah. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ṣallā ʻalayhi rabbuhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, upon whom his Lord has sent blessings, wa-malaʼa l-qulūba ḥubbuhu · wa-naʻʻama l-arwāḥa qurbuhu whose love has filled the hearts, whose nearness has brought delight to the spirits, 306

alladhī huwa sulṭānu mulki Allāhi wa-quṭbuhu who is the sovereign of Allah’s dominion and its spiritual pole, wa-ashrafu l-aḥzābi ʻinda Allāhi ḥizbuhu and whose party is the noblest of parties in Allah’s sight; wa-ṣ-ṣalātu ʻalayhi ʻilāju kulli muʼminin wa-ṭibbuhu and sending blessings upon him is the remedy for every believer, and his healing, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā njalā ʻani l-muṣallī ʻalayhi karbuhu wa-mā malaʼa l-ufuqa abābīlu l-qaṭā wa-sirbuhu and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as affliction is lifted from the one who sends blessings upon him, and for as long as the flocks of sandgrouse and their swarms fill the horizon. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bārakta ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā dhurriyyatihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, upon whom, and upon whose descendants, You have granted grace, wa-ḥafiẓta l-kitāba lladhī anzaltahu ʻalayhi and You have preserved the Book that You sent down upon him, 307

fa-huwa bāqin bi-anwārihi wa-barakatihi · wa-ntafaʻa l-muslimūna biḥadīthihi wa-sunnatihi so it remains, with its lights and its grace, and the Muslims have benefited from his hadith and his Sunna, wa-jaʻalta l-ʻulamāʼa l-ʻāmilīna min wa-rathatihi and You have made the practising scholars among his heirs, wa-jaʻalta sādāti ahli l-jannati min dhurriyyatihi and You have made the masters of the people of Paradise from among his descendants, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā ḥaḍarati l-ulūfu li-zawratihi and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as thousands come to visit him, wa-ahdawu s-salāma ʻalayhi fī rawḍatihi and offer the gift of peace upon him in his Garden (al-Rawḍa). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī stanārat bihi d-dunyā baʻda ẓalāmihā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, through whom this world was illumined after its darkness, 308

wa-saʻidat bihi l-awqātu min shuhūrihā wa-aʻwāmihā and through whom times were made joyful, in their months and years, wa-labbat bihi l-ḥujjāju fī ʻArafāti wa-Minan fī khiyāmihā and through whom the pilgrims called out “Labbayk” at Arafat and Mina, in their tents, wa-ghafara Allāhu lahumu l-khaṭāyā min dhunūbin wa-āthāmihā and Allah forgave them their errors, sins and offences, wa-akramahumu Allāhu bi-ṭ-ṭawāfi bi-l-Kaʻbati wa-stilāmihā and Allah honoured them with circling the Kaʻba and touching it, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi man ṭāfa bi-l-Kaʻbati wa-ukrima bi-ḥubbihā wa-ikrāmihā and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of those who have circled the Kaʻba and been honoured with loving it and honouring it. Allāhumma yā dhā l-faḍli lladhī lā yuḍāhā O Allah, O Possessor of bounty that cannot be matched, 309

wa-n-niʻami llatī lā tuḥṣā · yā qadīma l-iḥsāni yā dāʼima l-maʻrūfi and of favours that cannot be counted, O Ancient in beneficence, O Constant in kindness, ṣalli ʻalā nabiyyika wa-ḥabībika sh-shafīqi l-ʻaṭūfi send blessings upon Your Prophet and Your Beloved, the caring and affectionate, ṣalātan yamlaʼu l-mīzāna thawābuhā · wa-yafūqu l-miska ṭībuhā with a blessing whose reward fills the Scale, and whose fragrance surpasses musk, wa-yuftaḥu lahā mina s-samāʼi abwābuhā and for which the gates of heaven are opened, mā rufiʻat suyūfu l-mujāhidīna wa-ḥirābuhā for as long as the swords of those who strive in Allah’s cause, and their spears, are raised, wa-malaʼa bayāḍahā khiḍābuhā · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā khḍarra mina lghabrāʼi turābuhā · wa-amṭara mina s-samāʼi saḥābuhā and their dye fills their whiteness; and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as the soil of the dusty earth turns green, and the clouds send down rain from the sky. 310

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī stanārati l-qulūbu bi-maḥabbatihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, by whose love the hearts were illumined, wa-tanawwarati l-ashbāḥu bi-ruʼyatihi · wa-nālat riḍwānaka bi-ṭāʻatihi and by the sight of whom the bodies were filled with light, and through obedience to whom they gained Your good pleasure; alladhī aqāma l-layla li-ʻibādatika · wa-rakiba l-khayla fī l-ghazawāti linaṣrika wa-iʻlāʼi kalimatika who stood through the night to worship You, and rode horses on campaigns to support You and to exalt Your word, wa-daʻā l-khalqa ilā raḥmatika · wa-dukhūli jannatika wa-raghghabahum fī l-khayri and called creation to Your mercy, and to entering Your Paradise, and made them eager for what is good, wa-baghghaḍahum fī sh-sharri · fa-aṣbaḥa n-nāsu bi-niʻmatika ikhwānan 311

and made evil hateful to them, so that through Your favour people became brothers, wa-ʻalā l-khayri aʻwānan · wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman tudrikunā anwāruhu · wa-tafūḥu ʻalaynā aʻṭāruhu and helpers in what is good; and grant peace upon him and upon his family, with a peace whose lights reach us, and whose perfumes spread over us. Allāhumma yā sarīʻa l-ijābati · wa-yā man ilayhi t-tawbatu wa-l-inābatu O Allah, O You who are swift to answer, and O You to whom repentance and turning back are directed, yā afḍala man dhukira · wa-yā aḥaqqa man ʻubida O Most Excellent of those who are remembered, and O Most Deserving of those who are worshipped, ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi r-raḥmati send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of mercy, alladhī jaʻaltahu shafīʻan li-l-ummati · ṣalātan taḥfaẓunā bihā min kulli niqmatin wa-ghummatin whom You made an intercessor for the community, with a blessing by which You protect us from every retribution and distress, 312

wa-min kulli sāmmin wa-summihi · wa-min kulli daynin wa-hammihi and from every venomous creature and its venom, and from every debt and the worry it brings, wa-taghfiru lanā bihā kulla dhanbin alammahu and by which You forgive us every sin we have committed, yā man bi-arḥami r-rāḥimīna tasammahu O You who have taken the name ‘Most Merciful of the merciful,’ wa-khayruhu li-jamīʻi l-ʻālamīna ʻammahu · wa-anʻama bi-l-faḍli ʻalā ʻibādihi wa-atammahu whose goodness has encompassed all the worlds, and who has favoured His servants with bounty and brought it to completion, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli imāmin wa-man ammahu and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every imam and of all who follow him. Allāhumma yā awwalu bi-lā bi-dāyatin wa-yā ākhiru bi-lā nihāyatin O Allah, O First without beginning, and O Last without end, 313

ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tamunnu bihā ʻalaynā bi-t-tawbati wa-l-hidāyati send blessings upon our master Muhammad, with a blessing by which You graciously grant us repentance and guidance, wa-l-ikrāmi wa-l-ʻināyati · yā afḍala man ʻubida and honour and care, O Most Excellent of those who are worshipped, wa-yā akrama man suʼila · wa-yā man lahu fī l-kawni kullu āyatin and O Most Generous of those who are asked, and O You to whom belongs every sign in the universe, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā rufiʻat laka fī l-jihādi rāyatun and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as a banner is raised for You in jihad, bi-ʻadadi man anʻamta ʻalayhim bi-asrāri l-ʻulūmi bi-lā nihāyatin by the number of those whom You have favoured with the secrets of the sciences, without end, ṣalātan taḥfaẓunā bihā bi-l-ḥifẓi wa-l-wiqāyati with a blessing by which You guard us with Your safekeeping and protection, 314

wa-taqīnā bihā sharra kulli ḍalālatin wa-ghawāyatin and by which You protect us from the evil of every misguidance and error, yā man minhu l-mabdaʼu wa-ilayhi n-nihāyatu O You from whom is the beginning and to whom is the end, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan tamunnu bihā ʻalaynā bi-l-khayrāti wa-lkifāyati and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing by which You graciously grant us good things and sufficiency. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nāʼiri l-jabhati l-hilāliyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, of the radiant, crescent-like brow, dhī l-afʻāli l-marḍiyyati akḥali l-ʻaynayni of well-pleasing deeds, with kohl-dark eyes, wa-jaddi l-ḥasanayni · wa-imāmi l-ḥaramayni · wa-khayri man ṣallā ilā lqiblatayni 315

and the grandfather of al-Hasan and al-Husayn, and imam of the two Sanctuaries, and best of those who prayed toward the two qiblas, al-bashīri n-nadhīri · as-sirāji l-munīri · dhī l-faḍli l-ʻaẓīmi mina Allāhi lmunʻimi the bearer of glad tidings and warner, the radiant lamp, possessor of great bounty from Allah, the Bestower of favours, wa-l-qalbi r-raḥīmi bi-kulli muslimin · alladhī addabahu rabbuhu wa-āwāhu and of a heart that is merciful to every Muslim, whom his Lord refined in conduct and sheltered, wa-aḥsana mutaqallabahu wa-mathwāhu · wa-naṣarahu fī ghazawātihi and made excellent his movements and his resting place, and gave him victory in his campaigns, wa-ānasahu fī khalwātihi · wa-ʻaṣamahu mina n-nāsi and comforted him in his times of solitude, and protected him from the people, wa-ayyadahu bi-l-quwwati wa-shiddati l-bāsi · raḥīmun bi-l-muʼminīna and supported him with strength and formidable might; merciful to the believers, shadīdun ʻalā l-kāfirīna · al-mujāhidu fī Allāhi ḥaqqa jihādihi 316

stern toward the disbelievers, the one who strove for Allah with the striving that is due to Him, wa-l-hādī ilā sabīli rabbihi wa-rashādihi and the guide to the path of his Lord and to His right guidance, wa-ʻalā ṣaḥbihi wa-sallim wa-ʻalā ahli baytihi wa-ahli ḥubbihi wa-widādihi and upon his Companions, and grant peace, and upon the People of his House, and upon those who love him and hold him dear. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī khtartahu fa-kāna mukhtāran O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, whom You chose, and so he was chosen, wa-nabbaʼtahu fa-kāna nabiyyan ṣabbāran wa-arsaltahu fa-kāna li-n-nāsi raḥmatan ʻāmmatan and You made him a prophet, and he was a prophet of great patience, and You sent him, and he was an all-embracing mercy for the people, wa-ḥafiẓtahu min kulli sharrin bi-anwārika l-qudsiyyati wa-kalimātika ttāmmati and You protected him from every evil with Your sacred lights and Your perfect words, 317

fa-huwa n-nabiyyu l-munabbaʼu bi-ṣṭifāʼika · wa-l-mukhtāru bi-khtiyārika so he is the Prophet appointed through Your choosing of him, and the Elect by Your election, wa-l-mursalu bi-amrika wa-d-dāʻī ilayka bi-idhnika and the one sent at Your command, and the caller to You by Your leave, wa-s-sirāju l-munīru · wa-l-bashīru n-nadhīru · ṭibbu l-qulūbi wa-dawāʼuhā and the radiant lamp, and the bearer of glad tidings and warner, the healing of hearts and their remedy, wa-ʻāfiyatu l-abdāni wa-shifāʼuhā · wa-nūru l-abṣāri wa-ḍiyāʼuhā the well-being of bodies and their cure, and the light of the eyes and their radiance; wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi mā lāḥat anwāruhu and grant peace upon him and upon his family, for as long as his lights gleam, wa-ẓaharat fī l-kawni asrāruhu · wa-waqafat ʻinda r-rawḍati zuwwāruhu 318

and his secrets become manifest in the universe, and his visitors stand at the Garden (al-Rawḍa). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-ʻazīzi bi-ʻizzati Allāhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the mighty through the might of Allah, wa-r-raḥīmi bi-raḥmati Allāhi · wa-l-muʼayyadi bi-naṣri Allāhi and the merciful through the mercy of Allah, and the one supported by the help of Allah, wa-n-nāṣiri li-dīni Allāhi · wa-l-maʻṣūmi bi-ʻināyati Allāhi and the supporter of the religion of Allah, and the one protected by the care of Allah, wa-l-mukthiri li-dhikri Allāhi · wa-t-tālī li-kitābi Allāhi and the one who abundantly remembers Allah, and the reciter of the Book of Allah, wa-l-ḥākimi bi-amri Allāhi · wa-sh-shāfī bi-shifāʼi Allāhi and the one who judges by the command of Allah, and the healer by the cure of Allah, wa-d-dāʻī bi-idhni Allāhi · wa-l-munawwiri bi-nūri Allāhi and the caller by the leave of Allah, and the one who illumines with the light of Allah, 319

wa-l-murshidi li-khalqi Allāhi · wa-l-khātimi li-rusuli Allāhi and the guide of the creation of Allah, and the seal of the Messengers of Allah, wa-l-mushaffaʻi ʻinda Allāhi · wa-l-marfūʻi dh-dhikri ʻinda Allāhi and the one whose intercession is accepted with Allah, and the one whose mention is raised high with Allah, nabiyyi Allāhi wa-rasūli Allāhi · ʻalayhi jawāmiʻu ṣalawāti Allāhi the Prophet of Allah and the Messenger of Allah, upon him be the comprehensive blessings of Allah, wa-aʻammu taslīmāti Allāhi · ʻadada makhlūqāti Allāhi and the most encompassing peace of Allah, the number of Allah’s creatures, wa-midāda kalimāti Allāhi · ṣalātan nuḥfaẓu bihā mina l-fitani yawma liqāʼi Allāhi · wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi · wa-sh-shukru li-llāhi and the ink of the words of Allah, with a blessing by which we are protected from trials on the day of meeting Allah; and praise be to Allah, and thanks be to Allah. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī kāna ʻindaka bāṭinan fa-taḍāʼalat amāma anwārihi l-bawāṭinu 320

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who was, with You, inwardly hidden, so that the inner realities dwindled before his lights, wa-ẓahara fa-talāshat amāma ẓuhūrihi ẓ-ẓawāhiru and he became manifest, so that outward appearances vanished before his manifestation, wa-qahara bika laka kulla ʻaduwwin fa-huwa l-qāhiru and through You and for You he overcame every enemy, so he is the conqueror, wa-raḥima bika laka l-muʼminīna fa-huwa r-raḥīmu and through You and for You he showed mercy to the believers, so he is the merciful, wa-shakaraka ʻalā niʻamika fa-huwa sh-shakūru and he thanked You for Your favours, so he is the ever-grateful, wa-rafaʻta dhikrahu fawqa kulli marfūʻin and You raised his mention above all that is raised, wa-jaʻalta lahu lisāna ṣidqin fī l-awwalīna wa-fī l-ākhirīna and You gave him a tongue of truth among the earlier and the later generations, 321

wa-fī l-malaʼi l-aʻlā wa-ʻalā lisāni man “daʻwāhum fīhā subḥānaka Allāhumma wa-taḥiyyatuhum fīhā salāmun” ʻalayhi qabla ʻalayhim and in the Highest Assembly, and on the tongue of those of whom it is said, “Their call there will be ‘Glory be to You, O Allah,’ and their greeting there will be ‘Peace’” (Qur’an 10:10), upon him before it is upon them, idh lawlāhu lamā kānū fīhā wa-mā kānat for were it not for him, they would not have been there, nor would it have existed, fa-huwa l-hādī ilayhā bi-hidāyati “al-ḥamdu li-llāhi lladhī hadānā li-hādhā wa-mā kunnā li-nahtadiya lawlā an hadānā Allāhu” so he is the guide to it, through the guidance of “Praise be to Allah, who guided us to this; we would never have been guided had Allah not guided us” (Qur’an 7:43). fa-ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ahli baytihi l-muṭahharīna azkā salāmin wa-anmā taḥiyyatin So upon him, and upon the People of his House, the purified, be the purest peace and the most flourishing greeting, 322

mā gharradati ṭ-ṭuyūru fī awkārihā wa-aqbalat ʻalayhi mina l-Madīnati zuwwāruhā for as long as the birds warble in their nests, and Medina’s visitors come to him from the city. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika n-nūri lladhī lamaʻa sanāhu fa-qtabasati l-arwāḥu minhu hudāhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the light whose radiance gleamed, so that the spirits drew his guidance from him, fa-htazzat wa-rabat wa-adhʻanat li-dhikri mawlāhu and they stirred, swelled and submitted at the remembrance of his Patron, wa-taqarrabat ilā khāliqihā qurba l-ʻārifīna and drew near to their Creator with the nearness of those who know Allah, fa-saqāhā min makhtūmi raḥīqihā sharāba dh-dhākirīna so He gave them to drink, from their sealed nectar, the drink of those who remember, 323

fa-tadhakkarat mā nasiyat wa-shakarat li-rabbihā wa-adhʻanat and they remembered what they had forgotten, and gave thanks to their Lord, and submitted, wa-staghfarat khāliqahā wa-ilayhi tawajjahat and sought forgiveness from their Creator, and turned toward Him, wa-ṣārat tatlū “innī wa-jjahtu wajhī li-lladhī faṭara s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍa ḥanīfan wa-mā anā mina l-mushrikīna” wa-sallim ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman yalīqu bi-maqāmihi l-ʻālī and they came to recite, “I have turned my face to the One who originated the heavens and the earth, as one upright in faith, and I am not one of those who associate others with Allah” (Qur’an 6:79); and grant peace upon him and upon his family, with a peace that befits his lofty station, bi-ʻadadi taslīmi n-nisāʼi wa-r-rijāli · wa-aṣliḥ yā mawlāya aḥwālī waballighnī mina l-khayri maʼālī by the number of the greetings of peace offered by women and men, and set right my conditions, O my Patron, and bring me, in goodness, to my final destination. 324

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ḥamida n-nāsu sīratahu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose conduct the people praised, wa-ḥafiẓa Allāhu shirʻatahu · wa-qawwā fī Allāhi taʻālā ʻazīmatahu and whose law Allah preserved, and He strengthened his resolve for the sake of Allah, the Exalted, wa-jaʻala afḍala ṣ-ṣilāti ṣilatahu · wa-ashrafa n-nubuwwāti nubuwwatahu and made the finest of bonds his bond, and the noblest of prophethoods his prophethood, wa-aʻlā r-risālāti risālatahu · wa-ashrafa dh-dhurriyāti dhurriyyatahu and the highest of messages his message, and the noblest of descendants his descendants, wa-jaʻala aʻlā l-manāzili manzilatahu · wa-khayra l-umami ummatahu and made the highest of stations his station, and the best of communities his community, wa-aṭhara s-sarāʼiri sarīratahu wa-jaʻala khayra l-jannāti jannatahu 325

and the purest of inner selves his inner self, and made the best of Gardens his Garden, wa-jaʻala l-ʻulamāʼa wa-rathatahu · wa-madaḥa Allāhu taʻālā ṣaḥābatahu and made the scholars his heirs, and Allah, the Exalted, praised his Companions, wa-jaʻala abā bakrin khalīfatahu · wa-faḍḍala ʻalā nisāʼi l-ʻālamīna fī ljannati Fāṭimata baḍʻatahu and made Abu Bakr his successor, and preferred Fatima, a part of him, over the women of the worlds in Paradise, wa-faḍḍala ʻalā nisāʼi l-ʻālamīna Khadījata zawjatahu and preferred Khadija, his wife, over the women of the worlds, wa-jaʻala Allāhu muʻjizatan lahu ʻUmara l-fārūqa wa-ʻadālatahu and Allah made Umar al-Faruq and his justice a miracle for him, wa-ʻUthmāna bna ʻaffāna wa-tilāwatahu · wa-sayyidanā ʻaliyyan washajāʻatahu and Uthman ibn Affan and his recitation, and our master Ali and his courage; ṣalātan tarzuqunī bihā maḥabbatahu · wa-mutābaʻatahu wa-ziyāratahu washafāʻatahu 326

with a blessing by which You grant me love for him, and following him, and visiting him, and his intercession, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim mā shāhada z-zuwwāru rawḍatahu · wa-ghtanama zzāʼirūna naẓratahu and upon his family, and grant peace, for as long as the visitors behold his Garden (al-Rawḍa), and the visitors seize the prize of his glance. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika lladhī aqāma l-layla ḥattā tawaramat qadamāhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, who stood in prayer through the night until his feet swelled, shukran li-rabbihi wa-khāliqihi wa-mawlāhu · fa-nāla mina r-riḍwāni akbarahu out of gratitude to his Lord, his Creator and his Patron, so he attained the greatest measure of good pleasure, wa-mina l-khayri awfarahu fa-sharaḥta ṣadrahu and the most abundant measure of goodness, so You expanded his breast, 327

wa-yassarta amrahu · wa-rafaʻta dhikrahu fa-huwa l-marfūʻu dh-dhikru ʻinda rabbi l-ʻālamīna and You made his affair easy, and You raised his mention, so he is the one whose mention is raised high with the Lord of the worlds, wa-anzalta ḥubbahu fī qulūbi l-muʼminīna and You sent down love of him into the hearts of the believers, fa-huwa n-nabiyyu l-maḥbūbu · wa-ṭ-ṭaybu l-muṭayyabu lladhī huwa bi-lfawzi maṣḥūbun so he is the beloved Prophet, and the pure and purified one, who is accompanied by success, alladhī idhā mashā bi-l-layli aḍāʼati l-fijāju the one for whom the mountain passes would light up whenever he walked by night, al-muʼayyadu bi-l-isrāʼi wa-l-miʻrāji · dhū l-khuluqi l-ʻaẓīmi supported by the Night Journey and the Ascension, the possessor of a great character, wa-l-qalbi r-raḥīmi · alladhī kāna laka kamā turīdu and of a merciful heart, who was for You just as You wish, 328

wa-kunta lahu kamā yurīdu · fa-ayyadtahu wa-naṣartahu wa-ātaytahu sabʻan mina l-mathānī wa-l-Qurʼāna l-ʻaẓīma and You were for him just as he wishes, so You supported him, and helped him, and gave him seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the Great Qur’an, wa-athnayta ʻalayhi bi-qawlikawaʼinnaka la-ʻalā khuluqin ʻaẓīmin” and You praised him with Your words, “And truly, you are of a great character” (Qur’an 68:4); wa-sallim Allāhumma ʻalayhi wa-ʻalā ālihi salāman tuʼammina bihi khawfahu ʻalā ummatihi wa-asʻidnā Allāhumma fī d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirati biruʼyatihi and grant peace, O Allah, upon him and upon his family, with a peace by which You allay his fear for his community, and make us happy, O Allah, in this world and the Hereafter through seeing him, yā man lā yaḍīʻu man rajāhu O You, whoever hopes in You is not lost, wa-lā yaḍillu man tamassaka bi-dīnihi wa-hudāhu and whoever holds fast to Your religion and Your guidance does not go astray. 329

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʻabdika wa-nabiyyika warasūlika imāmi l-qiblatayni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the imam of the two qiblas, wa-jaddi l-ḥasanayni · wa-ṣāḥibi ṭ-ṭayyibayni abī bakrin wa-ʻUmara and the grandfather of al-Hasan and al-Husayn, and companion of the two pure ones, Abu Bakr and Umar, wa-ṣāḥibi dhī n-nūrayni ʻUthmāna wa-abī l-ḥasanayni l-abarri and companion of the Possessor of the Two Lights, Uthman, and of the father of al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the most righteous, ṣalātan taṣrifu bihā ʻannā l-hamma wa-l-kadara with a blessing by which You turn away from us worry and gloom, wa-dawāʻiya l-hawā wa-l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani · wa-taḥfaẓunā bihā mina lfawāḥishi mā ẓahara minhā wa-mā baṭana and the promptings of desire, worry and grief, and by which You protect us from shameful deeds, those of them that are apparent and those that are hidden, wa-tuwaffiqunā bihā ilā iqāmati l-farāʼiḍi wa-s-sunani 330

and by which You grant us success in establishing the obligations and the Sunnas; yā man tusabbiḥuhu l-amlāka wa-tuṭīʻuhu dawratu l-aflāki O You whom the angels glorify and whom the revolving of the celestial spheres obeys, wa-khāṭaba nabiyyahu fī qawlihi “lawlāka lawlāka mā khalaqtu l-aflāka” Allāhumma bi-jāhihi ḥfaẓnā bi-luṭfika ẓ-ẓāhiri wa-l-khafiyyi and who addressed His Prophet in His saying, “Were it not for you, were it not for you, I would not have created the celestial spheres”; O Allah, by his exalted standing with You, protect us with Your gentle kindness, the apparent and the hidden, yā Allāhu yā raʼūfu yā raḥīmu yā ʻaliyyu O Allah, O Compassionate One, O Ever-Merciful, O Most High, yā man huwa maʻanā yubṣiru wa-yasmaʻu O You who are with us, seeing and hearing, wa-hā hiya āyātuhu fī l-kawni talmaʻu wa-lahu fī kulli shayʼin āyatun tadullu ʻalā tawḥīdihi and behold, His signs gleam in the universe, and in everything He has a sign that points to His oneness; 331

fa-smaʻ ukhayya ilā naghami hādhā ṭ-ṭayri wa-taghrīdihi so listen, my dear brother, to the melody of this bird and its warbling; laʻallaka an tuʼmina bi-tasbīḥihi li-llāhi taʻālā wa-tamjīdihi perhaps you will believe in its glorifying of Allah, the Exalted, and its extolling of Him. fa-asʼaluka Allāhumma an tusallima ʻalā nabiyyika sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʻalā ālihi salāma aḥbābika So I ask You, O Allah, to grant peace upon Your Prophet, our master Muhammad, and upon his family, the peace of Your beloved ones, alladhīna wa-qafū ʻalā abwābika · yarjūna raḥmataka l-wāsiʻata who have stood at Your doors, hoping for Your vast mercy, wa-yasmaʻūna kalimātaka n-nāfiʻata and hearing Your beneficial words; yā man tajallā ʻalā l-jabali fa-tadakdaka min haybatihi bārik ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʻalā jamīʻi ummatihi O You who disclosed Yourself to the mountain, so that it crumbled in awe of You, grant grace upon our master Muhammad and upon all his community. 332

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī khatama n-nubuwwata wa-r-risālata bi-nubuwwatihi wa-risālatihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who sealed prophethood and the message with his prophethood and his message, wa-rafaʻta l-ʻadhāba ʻani l-khalqi min ajlihi and for his sake You lifted punishment from creation, wa-arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʻālamīna fa-lā yakhlū marḥūmun min raḥmatihi and You sent him as a mercy to the worlds, so no one who is shown mercy is devoid of his mercy, mufarriju l-karbi yawma l-qiyāmati ʻani l-khalāʼiqi ajmaʻīna bi-faḍli shafāʻatihi the reliever of affliction on the Day of Resurrection from all creatures together, through the bounty of his intercession, ḥabībika lladhī yustasqā l-ghamāmu bi-wajhihi l-karīmi Your Beloved, by means of whose noble face the clouds are asked for rain, fakam anzalta min ghaythin ʻalā man tawassalū bi-jāhihi wa-daʻwatihi 333

so how much life-giving rain You have sent down upon those who sought a means of approach through his exalted standing with You and his supplication, wa-kam aẓharta ʻalā yadayhi min muʻjizātin bāhirātin tadullu ʻalā ʻaẓīmi qadrihi wa-rifʻati wilāyatihi and how many dazzling miracles You have manifested at his hands, pointing to the greatness of his rank and the loftiness of his friendship with You, fakam shafayta bi-jāhihi min marīḍin taḥayyara l-aṭibbāʼu fī ʻillatihi and how many a sick person, whose illness left the physicians bewildered, You have healed by his exalted standing, wa-kam radadta min gharībin ilā wa-ṭanihi baʻda ṭūli ghurbatihi and how many a stranger You have returned to his homeland after his long exile, wa-kam aghathta min faqīrin qad ḍajja min fāqatihi and how many a poor person who cried out in his destitution You have helped, wa-kam farrajta ʻan makrūbin qad shakā min kurbatihi and how many an afflicted person who complained of his affliction You have relieved, wa-kam radadta ʻan aḥbābika min ʻaduwwin ghāshimin fī nuʻratihi 334

and how many an oppressive enemy, in his arrogance, You have turned away from Your beloved ones, wa-kam yassarta bi-jāhihi li-l-muḥibbīna l-wuṣūla ilayhi ʻinda rawḍatihi and how many times You have made it easy, by his exalted standing, for those who love him to reach him at his Garden (alRawḍa). Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalayhi ṣalātan bi-ʻadadi ṣalātika anta ʻalayhi wa-ṣalāti malāʼikatika wa-ṣalāti jamīʻi khalqika O Allah, send blessings upon him, with a blessing by the number of Your own blessing upon him, and the blessing of Your angels, and the blessing of all Your creation, wa-sallim ʻalayhi mithla dhālika wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-dhurriyyatihi and grant peace upon him in like manner, and upon his family and his descendants, wa-rḍa Allāhumma ʻan aṣḥābihi l-muhājirīna wa-l-anṣāri lladhīna fāzū biʻaẓīmi bayʻatihi and be pleased, O Allah, with his Companions, the Emigrants and the Helpers, who attained success through their great pledge of allegiance to him, 335

wa-rḍa Allāhumma ʻan awliyāʼika ṣ-ṣāliḥīna fī mashāriqi l-arḍi wamaghāribihā min insin wa-jinnin mimmani ttaṣalū bi-anwāri ʻināyatihi and be pleased, O Allah, with Your friends, the righteous, in the eastern and western regions of the earth, from among humans and jinn, who have been connected to the lights of his care, wa-rḥam Allāhumma ummatahu aḥyāʼan wa-amwātan wa-ghfir lahum waʻfu ʻanhum bi-jāhihi ʻindaka wa-adkhilhum fī faḍli barakatihi and have mercy, O Allah, on his community, the living and the dead, and forgive them and pardon them, by his exalted standing with You, and admit them into the bounty of his grace, wa-qḍi Allāhumma ḥājatī fa-innaka taʻlamuhā wa-qādirun ʻalā qaḍāʼihā yā man lā yaruddu khāʼiban man jāʼa Allāha li-ḥājatihi and fulfil my need, O Allah, for You know it and are able to fulfil it, O You who never turn away, disappointed, anyone who comes to Allah for his need, wa-l-ṭufi Allāhumma bī bi-luṭfika l-khafiyyi wa-ẓ-ẓāhiri lladhī man talṭuf bihi kāna fī ḥifẓi Allāhi wa-ʻināyatihi 336

and deal gently with me, O Allah, with Your gentle kindness, the hidden and the apparent, through which whoever You treat gently is in the safekeeping of Allah and His care, wa-aghithnī Allāhumma “yā mughīthu” (thalāthan) bi-ghawthika s-sarīʻi lladhī man aghathtahu bihi fa-qad najā min shiddatihi and help me, O Allah, O Helper (three times), with Your swift help, by which whoever You help has been saved from his hardship, wa-ʻajjil Allāhumma lī bi-l-faraji l-qarībi yā qarība l-faraji yā man amruhu idhā arāda shayʼan an yaqūla lahu kun fa-yakūnu fa-lā taʼkhīra li-shayʼin baʻda kalimatihi and hasten for me, O Allah, the near relief, O You whose relief is near, O You whose command, when He intends a thing, is only to say to it ‘Be,’ and it is, so there is no delay for anything after His word, ajibnī Allāhumma bi-asmāʼika l-ḥusnā kullihā wa-biḥaqqi smika l-ʻaẓīmi laʻẓami lladhī huwa asraʻu asmāʼika ʻindaka ijābatan li-ʻaẓamatihi answer me, O Allah, by all Your Most Beautiful Names, and by the right of Your Great Name, the Greatest, which is the swiftest of Your Names with You in answering, because of its greatness, 337

yā Allāhu yā raḥmānu yā raḥīmu yā ḥayyu yā qayyūmu bi-raḥmatika astaghīthu fa-aghithnī bi-ḥaqqi l-Qurʼāni l-ʻaẓīmi wa-ḥikmatihi O Allah, O Most Merciful (Raḥmān), O Ever-Merciful, O EverLiving, O Self-Subsisting, through Your mercy I seek help, so help me, by the right of the Great Qur’an and its wisdom. 338

Wird Yawm as-Sabt Saturday J U M P T O P R AY E R 1–10 11–20 61–70 21–30 31–40 71–80 41–50 81–90 51–60 91 O P E N I N G · R E C I T E D E A C H D AY al-ḥamdu li-llāhi wa-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʻalā sayyidinā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadin rasūli Allāhi wa-ʻalā ālihi fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā wasiʻahu ʻilmu Allāhi All praise is for Allah, and blessings and peace be upon our master and patron Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, and upon his family, in every glance and every breath, by the number of all that the knowledge of Allah encompasses, wa-raḍiya Allāhu ʻan shaykhaynā sayyidī Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi and may Allah be pleased with our two shaykhs: my master Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, wa-sayyidī ʻabdi l-ghaniyyi Ṣāliḥin al-Jaʻfariyyi wa-arḍāhumā 339

and my master ʻAbd al-Ghanī Ṣāliḥ al-Jaʻfarī, and may He make them well pleased, wa-jaʻala l-jannata mutaqallabahumā wa-mathwāhumā and make Paradise their resort and their abode. wa-nfaʻnā Allāhumma bi-jāhihimā ʻindaka yā Allāhu And benefit us, O Allah, through their standing with You, O Allah. Allāhumma innī uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday kulli nafasin walamḥatin wa-ṭarfatin yaṭrifu bihā ahlu s-samāwāti wa-ahlu l-arḍi wakulli shayʼin huwa fī ʻilmika kāʼinun aw qad kāna uqaddimu ilayka bayna yaday dhālika kullihi O Allah, I offer to You, in the presence of every breath, every glance and every blink with which the people of the heavens and the people of the earth blink, and of everything that is in Your knowledge, whether it is yet to be or has already come to be — I offer to You, in the presence of all of that, [the prayers that follow]. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin awwali khalqika wa-khātami anbiyāʼika wa-rusulika 340

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the first of Your creation and the seal of Your Prophets and Messengers, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi maʻlūmātika · wa-midāda kalimātika and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the things known to You, and the ink of Your words. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin raḥmati Allāhi li-l-ʻālamīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the mercy of Allah to the worlds, wa-rasūlihi ṣ-ṣādiqi l-amīni · wa-ʻalā ālihi bi-ʻadadi khalqi Allāhi ajmaʻīna and His Messenger, the Truthful, the Trustworthy, and upon his family, by the number of all of Allah’s creation. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-bashīri n-nadhīri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the bearer of glad tidings and warner, as-sirāji l-munīri · wa-ʻalā ālihi bi-ʻadadi kulli fatīlin wa-qiṭmīrin the radiant lamp, and upon his family, by the number of every thread and every husk of a date-stone. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-ḥusni wa-l-kamāli 341

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of beauty and perfection, wa-l-khayri wa-l-ifḍāli · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi l-ḥaṣā wa-r-rimāli and of goodness and the bestowal of bounty, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the pebbles and the sands. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin dhī l-khuluqi l-ʻaẓīmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, possessor of a great character, wa-l-qalbi r-raḥīmi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli ʻābidin wa-ʻalīmin and of a merciful heart, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every worshipper and every knowledgeable person. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin dhī r-rūḥi l-ʻāliyati lmuhayminati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, possessor of the exalted, commanding spirit, 342

wa-sirāji l-qulūbi l-muṭmaʼinnati l-muʼminati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim biʻadadi kulli shahrin wa-sanatin and lamp of the tranquil, believing hearts, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every month and every year. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ṣallat ʻalayhi l-amlāku O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, upon whom the angels have sent blessings, wa-lawlāhu mā khuliqati l-aflāku · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli ḍāḥikin wa-bākin and had it not been for him, the celestial spheres would not have been created, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of everyone who laughs and everyone who weeps. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī mā ḥalla ḥubbuhu fī qalbin illā jalāhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose love has never settled in a heart without burnishing it, 343

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā taḥarrakat bi-dhikrihi l-afwāhu and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of times mouths have moved in mentioning him. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin qiblati qulūbi l-mutawajjihīna ilayka O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the qibla of the hearts of those who turn toward You, wa-imāmi l-mutawakkilīna ʻalayka · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli khayrin minka wa-ilayka and the leader of those who put their trust in You, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every good that comes from You and goes to You. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḍāmini sh-shafāʻata li-zāʼirīhi wa-fātiḥi l-khayra li-qāṣidīhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the guarantor of intercession for those who visit him and the opener of goodness for those who set out toward him, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli ʻilmin yadrīhi 344

and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every piece of knowledge that he knows. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-jihādi wa-l-futūḥi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of jihad and of conquests, al-ʻafuwwi ṣ-ṣafūḥi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli faḍlin minka mamnūḥin the one who pardons and graciously overlooks, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every bounty from You that is bestowed. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-hudā l-hādī ilā ṣirāṭi Allāhi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of guidance, the guide to the path of Allah, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī kulli lamḥatin wa-nafasin ʻadada mā aḥṣāhu lawḥu Allāhi and upon his family, and grant peace, in every blink of the eye and every breath, the number of all that Allah’s Tablet has enumerated. 345

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-aḥkāmi sh-sharʻiyyati O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of the rulings of the Sacred Law wa-l-hibāti l-ilāhiyyati · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli dharratin habāʼiyyatin and of the divine gifts, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every mote of floating dust. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-yumni wa-l-barakati wa-l-falāḥi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of good fortune, grace and success, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā tadhrūhu r-riyāḥu and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all that the winds scatter. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī kāna li-l-muʼminīna ẓilan ẓalīlan 346

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who was for the believers a deep and cooling shade, wa-qulta lahu “wa-tawakkal ʻalā Allāhi wa-kafā bi-llāhi wa-kīlan” wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-jʻal lī fī ḥaramihi maqīlan and to whom You said, “And put your trust in Allah; Allah suffices as a Guardian” (Qur’an 4:81, 33:3, 33:48); and upon his family, and grant peace; and make for me a resting-place in his sanctuary. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī jāʼa bi-l-Qurʼāni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who brought the Qur’an, wa-hadā l-insa wa-l-jānna wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā yakūnu wamā kāna and guided humankind and the jinn; and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all that is to be and all that has been. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-maʻṣūmi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the divinely protected Prophet, 347

aẓ-ẓāhiri l-maʻlūmi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli ʻilmin mafhūmin · wa-ghaybin maktūmin the manifest, the well-known, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every kind of knowledge that is understood, and every unseen matter that is kept hidden. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin bābi Allāhi l-muwaṣṣili li-kulli qāṣidin O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the door of Allah that brings every seeker to his goal, wa-sirājihi l-muḍīʼi li-kulli ʻābidin · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan taṣrifu bihā ʻannā kulla ʻaduwwin wa-ḥāsidin and His shining lamp for every worshipper, and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing by which You turn away from us every enemy and every envious person. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī jaʻaltahu ḥabīban wanabiyyan O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom You made a beloved and a prophet, 348

wa-rafaʻtahu fī d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirati makānan ʻaliyyan and whom You raised, in this world and the Hereafter, to a lofty station, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bukratan wa-ʻashiyyan and upon his family, and grant peace, morning and evening. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yadūru ʻalā l-muṣallīna sharābuhā O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a blessing whose drink is passed around among those who send blessings, wa-yashulu bihā ʻalā ummatihi ḥisābuhā and through which the reckoning becomes easy for his community, wa-ʻalā ālihi mā rtafaʻa bi-ḥubbihi ʻani l-qulūbi ḥijābuhā and upon his family, for as long as the veil is lifted from hearts through love of him. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan yamlaʼu thawābuhā lufuqa 349

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad with a blessing whose reward fills the horizon, wa-yaghlibu ḍiyāʼuhā l-falaqa · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā awjada Allāhu wa-mā khalaqa and whose radiance outshines the daybreak, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all that Allah has brought into being and all that He has created. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-faraji l-qarībi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of imminent relief wa-s-sirri l-ʻajībi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan tuyassiru lanā bihā ziyāratahu ʻan qarībin and of the wondrous secret, and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing by which You make it easy for us to visit him before long. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā janna laylun O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as night draws its veil, wa-mā ṣuffat li-l-jihādi fursānun wa-khaylun 350

and for as long as horsemen and horses are drawn up in ranks for jihad, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan tuʻīdhunā bihā mina l-hawā wa-l-mayli and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing by which You grant us refuge from vain desire and deviation. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī man raʼāhu yusarru O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom whoever sees is gladdened, wa-man aḥabbahu yabarru · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā fī kulli baḥrin wa-barrin and whoever loves him grows in virtue, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all that is in every sea and every land. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-fātiḥi li-l-qulūbi bi-ḥikami ʻallāmi l-ghuyūbi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the opener of hearts through the wisdoms of the Knower of all that is unseen, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli maḥfūẓin wa-maktūbin and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of everything that is preserved and everything that is written. 351

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī sārat fī l-aqṭāri sharīʻatuhu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose Sacred Law has travelled through the lands, wa-ʻammati l-anāma risālatuhu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan tadūru bihā ʻalaynā bi-idhni Allāhi barakatuhu and whose message has embraced all beings, and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing through which, by Allah’s leave, his grace circulates around us. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī idhā samiʻa l-adhāna sāraʻa ilā ṣ-ṣalāti O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who, whenever he heard the call to prayer, hastened to the prayer, yuqaddimu dhikra rabbihi wa-yulabbī nidāhu putting the remembrance of his Lord first and answering His call, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā qāla muʼadhdhinun ḥayya ʻalā ṣ-ṣalāti and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of times any muezzin has said, “Come to prayer.” 352

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin dalīli l-ḥayrānīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the guide of the bewildered, wa-maʼmani l-khāʼifīna · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim fī kulli waqtin wa-ḥīnin and the safe haven of the fearful, and upon his family, and grant peace, at every hour and every moment. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-ḥākimi bi-amrika O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who judges by Your command, wa-d-dāʻī li-sharʻika wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā fī ʻilmika and who calls to Your Sacred Law; and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all that is in Your knowledge, ṣalātan taḥfaẓunā bihā min shirāri khalqika with a blessing by which You protect us from the evil ones among Your creation. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin imāmi l-qiblatayni O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the imam of the two qiblas, 353

wa-jaddi l-ḥasanayni · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim and the grandfather of al-Hasan and al-Husayn, and upon his family, and grant peace; wa-arinī Allāhumma ahla badrin wa-uḥudin wa-ḥunaynin and show me, O Allah, the people of Badr, Uhud and Hunayn. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī kānat tukhāṭibuhu ljamādātu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whom inanimate things used to address, wa-sabbaḥat fī kaffihi l-ḥaṣayātu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi mā maḍā wa-mā huwa ātin and in whose palm the pebbles glorified [Allah], and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all that has passed and all that is yet to come. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kathīri l-ḥamdi wa-sh-shukri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, abundant in praise and gratitude, 354

wa-ʻaẓīmi th-thawābi wa-l-ajri · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi qaṭarāti kulli baḥrin wa-nahrin and great in reward and recompense, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the drops of every sea and river. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi l-isrāʼi wa-l-miʻrāji O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of the Night Journey and the Ascension, an-nūri s-sāṭiʻi lladhī malaʼa l-fijāja the brilliant light that filled the mountain passes, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli muʻtamirin wa-ḥājjin and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of everyone who performs ʻumra and everyone who performs Hajj. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin khātami r-rusuli wa-l-anbiyāʼi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Seal of the Messengers and Prophets, 355

wa-mumiddi l-ʻulamāʼi wa-l-awliyāʼi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan tamlaʼu l-arḍa wa-s-samāʼa and the bestower of succour upon the scholars and the friends of Allah, and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing that fills the earth and the sky. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātaka llatī ṣallayta ʻalayhi bihā fī l-azali O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad with Your blessing, the one with which You blessed him in pre-eternity, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim wa-ḥuffanā bi-luṭfika l-khafiyyi fīmā nazala and upon his family, and grant peace; and surround us with Your hidden gentle kindness in whatever has befallen us. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī huwa akramu mina ssaḥābi idhā haṭala O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who is more generous than the clouds when they pour down, wa-min kulli karīmin yuḍrabu bihi l-mathalu and more generous than every generous person who is held up as a byword, 356

wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi l-amni wa-l-wajali and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of the instances of security and of fear. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin shajarati n-nūri wa-miftāḥi ssurūri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the tree of light and the key to joy, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan ʻalaynā barakātuhā tadūru and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing whose graces circulate around us. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin bahjati n-nufūsi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the delight of souls, wa-manbaʻi l-ʻulūmi wa-d-durūsi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan taḥfaẓunā bihā min kaydi n-nufūsi and the wellspring of knowledge and lessons, and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing by which You protect us from the scheming of souls. 357

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī bi-ẓuhūri anwārihi muḥiyati l-jahālātu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, through the appearance of whose lights ignorance was wiped away, wa-binafāʼisa ʻulūmihi ndatharati ḍ-ḍalālātu · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim warzuqnā Allāhumma l-yaqīna wa-th-thabāta and through the precious treasures of his knowledge misguidance was obliterated, and upon his family, and grant peace; and bestow upon us, O Allah, certainty and steadfastness. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kathīri l-anwāri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, abundant in lights, zāʼidi l-waqāri · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan nanālu bihā raḥmata rraḥīmi l-ghaffāri of surpassing dignity, and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing through which we attain the mercy of the Ever-Merciful, the Ever-Forgiving. 358

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī jadduhu Ibrāhīmu lkhalīlu O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose forefather is Abraham, the Intimate Friend, wa-nazala waṣfuhu fī t-tawrāti wa-l-injīli and whose description was sent down in the Torah and the Gospel, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli zamanin wa-jīlin and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every era and generation. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī saʻidati l-ummatu bibaʻthatihi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, through whose mission the community found happiness, wa-ʻammati r-raḥmatu bi-risālatihi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi iḥsāni Allāhi wa-raḥmatihi and through whose message mercy spread to all, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of Allah’s acts of beneficence and of His mercies. 359

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin al-kāmili l-mukammali O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the perfect, the perfected, wa-l-fāḍili l-mufaḍḍali · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi man nabbaʼa Allāhu wa-arsala the excellent, the preferred, and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of all whom Allah has made prophets and sent as messengers. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī ḥubbuhu kanzun mina l-ajri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose love is a treasure of reward, wa-ṣ-ṣalātu ʻalayhi amānun mina l-faqri and sending blessings upon him is a safeguard against poverty, wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli madarin wa-ṣakhrin and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every clod of earth and every rock. 360

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin aṭ-ṭayyibi l-mujābi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the pure one, whose supplications are answered, al-awwāhi l-awwābi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan tarzuqunā bihā ḥusna lmaʼābi the tender-hearted, the ever-returning, and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing through which You bestow upon us a good final return. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin alladhī kāna nabiyyan qabla Ādama wa-dh-dhabīḥi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who was a prophet before Adam and before the one offered in sacrifice, wa-Ibrāhīma wa-l-masīḥi · ʻalayhi wa-ʻalayhim aṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu biʻadadi mā ḥurrima wa-ubīḥa and before Abraham and the Messiah, upon him and upon them be blessings and peace, by the number of all that has been forbidden and permitted. 361

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʻalā ikhwānihi mina lanbiyāʼi wa-l-mursalīna O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his brothers among the Prophets and Messengers, wa-ʻalā ahli baytihi wa-aṣḥābihi ajmaʻīna and upon the People of his House and his Companions, all of them, wa-ʻalā l-awliyāʼi wa-ṣ-ṣāliḥīna · wa-sallim ilā yawmi l-faṣli l-mubīni and upon the friends of Allah and the righteous, and grant peace until the manifest Day of Decision. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi r-rafīqi O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the gentle Prophet, ar-raʼūfi sh-shafīqi · wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim ṣalātan tukhalliṣunā bihā min kulli karbin wa-ḍīqin the compassionate, the deeply caring, and upon his family, and grant peace, with a blessing by which You deliver us from every affliction and hardship. 362

Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-abarri O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the most virtuous Prophet, wa-ʻalā abī bakrin wa-ʻUmara wa-ʻUthmāna wa-ʻAliyyin wa-kulli taqiyyin waṢāliḥin wa-barrin and upon Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman and Ali, and upon every Godfearing, righteous and virtuous person. Allāhumma ṣalli ʻalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mā taḥarraka fulkun wasabbaḥa falakun O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad for as long as a ship moves and a celestial sphere glorifies [Allah], wa-ʻalā ālihi wa-sallim bi-ʻadadi kulli mālikin wa-mā malaka and upon his family, and grant peace, by the number of every owner and all that he owns.
